#### New Features

- **Database side peek** — Added a resizable panel for editing row pages beside their database. Added navigation through visible rows and switching between side peek, center peek, full page, and a new tab while preserving edits.

#### Improvements

- **Charts and lists** — Refreshed chart settings, labels, and tooltips, and corrected calculations using currency and percentage values. Adapted list rows to narrow windows, with properties below the title when space is limited.
- **Database loading** — Opened cached views and row pages without waiting for server refreshes, and loaded initial board cards without fetching every row. Improved recovery from interrupted downloads and displayed available rows while missing rows recovered. Local databases completed loading without remote requests.
- **Cloud creation** — Saved new pages and database rows on the server before exposing them for editing, with loading feedback and recovery for interrupted creation requests.
- **Updates and errors** — Unified desktop update prompts with release notes, download links, and server compatibility guidance. Replaced technical error text with clearer localized messages and guidance when an action's outcome was uncertain.
- **Date formulas** — Avoided unnecessary recalculation of `today()` formulas while retaining refreshes when the date or time zone changed.

- Fixed row edits and access restrictions across peek navigation, and restored Escape dismissal after editing.
- Fixed relation-picker searches by database name and restored icon and image-upload choices on row pages and templates.
- Fixed opening supported local attachments, fullscreen video playback, and YouTube audio downloads while preserving the video's default audio track.
- Fixed workspace selection after deleting the active workspace and allowed failed space-creation dialogs to close without a server connection.

release.name: v14.0.0
release.notes:
GSYVideoPlayer **14.0.0**

本版覆盖 `v13.2.1..v14.0.0` 的全部 **27 条提交（含 2 条合并）**，完整更新说明与逐提交清单见下方链接。

- **IJK / FFmpeg**：`ex_so` 与独立 arm64 / armv7a / x64 使用 **FFmpeg n5.1.10 + OpenSSL 3.5.9**，FFmpeg/player/SDL 成套重编，补齐 MJPEG、HEVC seek/replay 和 FFmpeg 5 API 兼容修复。
- **TLS / HLS**：修复 ARMv7 HTTPS 证书加载崩溃；针对 NDK r22b / Clang 11 修正 OpenSSL 编译选项和缓存身份。嵌套 HLS 与 keepalive 重连保留显式证书、主机名校验和代理配置。
- **音频**：软件变速支持 **0.25×–4×**，平台倍速支持范围取决于设备；修复重采样、起播、变速引擎排空与切换、EOF 完成和终止错误状态。
- **RTSP / 会话**：支持初始化 OPTIONS / DESCRIBE / SETUP / 初次 PLAY 的重定向，透传 `timeout`（微秒）和传输配置；新增可选直播队列上限，隔离旧会话回调、已排队消息和看门狗。
- **Codec2**：保留原解码器选择，Android 10+ 在原选择为空时补充普通硬件 `c2.*` 解码器筛选，排除纯软件及安全/隧道模式必需解码器。
- **GL 管线与滤镜**：新增 FBO 多 pass、高斯模糊、降采样金字塔、Bloom、LUT 调色、保边美颜、Glitch、CRT 和老电视信号干扰；支持 `uTime` 与额外纹理生命周期，修正旧 shader 并移除多余 `glFinish`。
- **折叠屏 Demo**：新增 XML / Compose 的 FLAT、BOOK、TABLETOP 布局，处理铰链、旋转、全屏和姿态测试注入，Compose 可运行 Demo 增至 **25** 个。
- **Compose**：修复 #4259 宿主卸载时的资源释放和 #4261 轮询缓冲进度同步；新增动态显示比例 API，补齐 IJK/EXO 缓存切换、缓存命中及缓冲展示。
- **R8 / 工具链**：精简 Demo 和 FAQ 的 JNI/反射保留规则；Gradle **8.12**、AGP **8.9.1**、R8 **9.4.14**，新增 **13 个接入 skills**，CI 纳入会话与 Compose 回归。

**升级说明：** 默认整包与 `gsyvideoplayer-ex_so` 包含 `arm64-v8a` / `armeabi-v7a` / `x86_64` 三个 ABI。迁移后的独立 ABI 模块与整包使用相同编解码配置，按 ABI 和包体积选择；旧 `armeabi` / `x86` 仅按需通过独立模块提供，未升级到 FFmpeg 5。Compose、投屏与 AliPlayer 为可选模块，核心最低 API 23，投屏模块要求 API 26。

```gradle
implementation "io.github.carguo:gsyvideoplayer:14.0.0"
```

Maven Central 使用 `io.github.carguo`，GitHub Packages 使用 `com.shuyu`。2026-10-10 已核验 Maven Central 的全部 15 个模块 POM / AAR 可以公开下载。

**发布验证：** Debug/Release（含 R8）、48 项会话回归、36 次单测执行（18 个独立用例 × 两种构建）、双渠道本地发布和三 ABI 静态/打包检查通过。原受影响的 Redmi M2104K10AC / API 33 上，最终 ARMv7 与 ARM64 各通过独立 CA 加载及 15 项 GSY/JNI 播放检查，覆盖 HTTPS、嵌套 HLS 错误 CA/SAN 拒绝、RTSP 初始化重定向、seek/完成、倍速和重采样。

当前 x86_64 与 16 KiB 页设备运行、硬解画面及新库完整声学回归仍未覆盖；当前设备检查使用静音输出且不设置视频 Surface。注入姿态矩阵不替代实体折叠屏传感器验收，历史旧库证据不替代最终发布库的验证。

release.name: v1.78.0
release.notes:
- filamat: completely remove the DIR variant bit [⚠️ **New Material Version**]
- matc: the `directionalLighting` variant filter is deprecated and ignored; it will be removed in
  a future release
- matc: remove the deprecated `dynamicLighting` variant filter
- engine: `Texture::setImage()`, `Texture::setImageAsync()` and `Texture::generateMipmaps()` are
  now non-const; the const overloads are deprecated
- engine: `Material::getDefaultInstance() const` is deprecated; use the non-const overload
- engine: `FrameHistoryStream::getNewFrames()` now consumes the new frames when it returns, rather
  than as the range is iterated: frames that aren't iterated are no longer returned by the next
  call, and a range can be iterated more than once. Missing frame IDs just before a PENDING frame
  are now returned with that frame [⚠️ **API Change**]
- engine: `Engine::Builder::build()` now also validates the `Engine::Config` when the engine is
  created asynchronously
- engine: fix the const `DebugRegistry::getPropertyAddress()` templates, which didn't compile
- engine: fix a dangling reference to the caller's string in `DebugRegistry::getDataSource()`
- libs: the `IBLPrefilterContext` filters (`EquirectangularToCubemap`, `IrradianceFilter` and
  `SpecularFilter`) now take a non-const input `Texture*`; the overloads taking a
  `Texture const*` are deprecated
- engine: `TransformManager` now incrementally reorders its components during
  `Renderer::endFrame()` / `Renderer::skipFrame()`. `TransformManager::Instance` values must not
  be kept across frames (or across `create()`, `destroy()`, `setParent()`); keep the `Entity` and
  call `getInstance()` again instead. [⚠️ **API Change**]
- engine: children orphaned by `TransformManager::destroy()` now have their world transform
  updated to their local transform, as documented.

release.name: AnkiDroid 2.25.1
release.notes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> GitHub does not auto-update apps


## For regular users

Install `arm64-v8a` from the **Assets** section below. If it fails to install, use `Parallel.A`.

`Parallel` builds install side-by-side with the main APK, allowing you to use different settings and profiles (via the `AnkiDroid directory` advanced setting and a different AnkiWeb login).


## For testers

The builds with `full`, `play` and `amazon` are useful for testing our builds for different app stores:

- **`full`**: F-Droid & GitHub `Parallel` apks
- **`play`**: Google Play - does not have `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permission as it is forbidden by Google, on uninstall the user is invited to delete data.
- **`amazon`**: Amazon - currently same as full, historically removed `CAMERA` permission


## ABI variants

We perform ABI splits to reduce APK size. In rare cases, a phone may not be using the `arm64-v8a` ABI. You can find your phone's ABI using [kamgurgul/cpu-info](https://github.com/kamgurgul/cpu-info). If disk space isn't an issue, use the `full` apk.

release.name: v2.1.0
release.notes:
本次更新重点提升模拟定位的兼容性、稳定性和操作体验。

## 新增功能
- 新增“圆形摇杆”和“按钮摇杆”两种控制样式，可在移动设置中切换。
- 支持向 GPS、网络和融合定位 Provider 同步提交模拟位置，提升应用兼容性。
- 消息已读状态支持版本跟踪，公告或客服消息更新后会重新显示为未读。
体验优化
- 统一使用 WGS-84 坐标存储和处理，改善地图搜索、坐标输入、历史记录及路线坐标的一致性。
- 优化模拟定位服务生命周期，减少真实位置与模拟位置之间的回跳。
- 模拟位置提交失败时自动尝试恢复定位 Provider。
- 优化位置更新节奏和运行时权限检查，提升连续模拟的稳定性。
- 统一操作结果提示样式，使成功和错误提示更加清晰。
- 优化摇杆锁定、拖动和路线控制交互。
## 问题修复
- 修复轻触圆形摇杆时控制点发生意外移动的问题。
- 修复部分使用融合定位的应用无法及时获取模拟位置的问题。
- 修复消息回复或内容更新后仍显示为已读的问题。
- 修复部分页面生命周期切换后位置显示不同步的问题。
- 增强运行环境与敏感路径检查。
## 升级提示
由于坐标存储结构升级，从 2.0.2 升级至 2.1.0 时会重建本地数据库，本机保存的以下内容将被清除：
- 位置历史
- 路线历史
- 地图搜索历史
账号、会员及其他服务端数据不受影响。

release.name: DashBeam 0.7.1 - Trusted Devices
release.notes:
Dashbeam now works with phones running Android 12 and older, you can mark a device as trusted so its files arrive without a prompt, and the mobile UI has had a round of fixes.

## Highlights

### Trusted devices

Mark a device you own as trusted and its transfers land automatically, with no accept prompt and no waiting by the screen. Incoming files are sorted into a folder named after the device that sent them, so you can tell at a glance where something came from.

- Auto-accept is now a clearly labelled switch in pairing settings
- Unattended receives raise a notification so you know something arrived
- Trusting a device, or removing one, asks for confirmation first
- Trusted invites are queued rather than accepted inline, and the whole queue drains at once

### Support for Android 12 and older

Sending now works on Android 12 and below. If Dashbeam previously failed to send from an older phone, it should just work.

### Android UI and UX

- Settings and History pages are padded correctly for the system bars
- The send-to-device sheet fits the phone screen instead of overflowing
- Settings sidebar rows are tappable on mobile
- Larger sharing pulse animation
- The main activity is no longer declared non-resizeable, so split screen and foldables behave
- Update checks now run on Android release builds, and diagnostics export works again

Builds also changed on the Android side: there's a Play Store AAB build with its own CI workflow, and a separate workflow for developer-verification APKs.

## Other changes

**History**
- The list refreshes when a transfer lands while you have it open
- Open a transfer's files straight from its history row
- Disk-write timing dropped; the delete action is now inline

**Settings**
- Relay status in the footer is behind a General toggle

**Updater**
- Download progress is shown, and you're asked to confirm a restart if one lands mid-transfer

**Core**
- Desktop temp stores now live in the stan

release.name: App Manager v4.1.1
release.notes:
App Manager v4.1.1 improves permissions, installation, ADB connectivity, and several other parts of the application. Visit Settings > About > Version/Changelog for details.

**Revoke Internet Permission**
App Manager can now block internet for individual applications utilizing the eBPF rules in root or ADB mode. To block internet for an application, go to the "Uses permissions" tab and click on the toggle button next to `android.permission.INTERNET` to revoke the permission.
  
_Known Limitation._ The eBPF rules are lost after a reboot. App Manager attempts to restore the rules right after a reboot. However, in ADB mode, it might take a while to connect to wireless debugging depending on the availability of a Wi-Fi connection. This might allow applications that start after a reboot to use internet.  

**Others**
- Added support for editing `.bat` files  
- Improved installation reliability and performance  
- Improved permission management  
- Improved ADB pairing, connections, and mode handling  
- Improved settings transitions and startup messages  
- Fixed displaying profiles after creating a profile for the first time  
- Fixed intercepting browser URLs  
- Fixed listing applications on Android 17  
- Fixed title ordering in What's New dialog.

Public preview for compatible BYD Android head units. Android 7.1+ (API 25) remains the minimum; Android 7.1–8.1 still needs vehicle testing. This update focuses on wired USB stability, Wi-Fi Direct stutter, voice notes in messaging apps and update notices. USB and wireless remain available, subject to the head unit's firmware and hardware.

## Highlights

- Wired CarPlay no longer reconnects when the head unit delivers one damaged USB network block, which dropped sessions 1–2 s after the picture appeared on several head units. Older iPhones get a second identification attempt, and USB auto-confirm recognizes the Android 10+ and Chinese permission prompts. repo.description: ServerBox - server status & toolbox

release.name: v1.0.1816
release.notes:
### Added

- **Icon packs:** icons chosen apart from the theme, and themable icons in the Files window, looked up by file extension.
- **Markdown preview:** Markdown files open rendered in the file editor, with an Edit button for the source.
- **Reconnect button in the terminal,** for a connection that looks alive but no longer answers.
- **System groups** beside system users, in the app and the Monitor panel.
- **Screen readers:** the terminal can be read with a screen reader, the benchmark log is read as text, icon-only buttons have names, and the Monitor panel can be used with a keyboard and a screen reader. The panel's terminal reader mode is opt-in.
- The app and the Monitor agent check that they speak the same protocol version, and say which one needs updating when they do not.

### Changed

- Saved private keys are hidden by default in the editor and can be shown after app-lock authentication.
- Agent: thinking levels follow the selected model, and favorites and the composer show which provider a model is from.

### Fixed

- Remote desktop: KDE Plasma's built-in RDP server (krdp) no longer disconnects right after login, and xrdp logs on with the saved password instead of showing its own login screen.
- Server details: cards with more than six rows (sensors, GPUs, batteries, BMC, custom commands, disk health) can show every row.
- When the status script cannot be placed in `/tmp`, the fallback directory in the user's home now works. Memory that could not be read shows the reason instead of "100% of 1024 B".
- Monitor: disks are read on machines whose language is not English.
- A launch that fails shows why instead of opening no window, and an unreadable preferences file no longer stops the app from starting. On Windows and Linux, preferences are written atomically, so an interrupted write no longer damages them.

release.name: Operit AI V1.12.2
release.notes:
本次更新重点围绕模型兼容性、工具调用、聊天稳定性和数据管理展开，同时补充 ToolPkg、统计、恢复与性能监控能力。

## 增加

- 新增 Token 用量账本、统计看板、活动视图、价格覆盖、缓存命中率、生成速度和安全删除能力
- 新增独立 TTS/STT 服务档案，支持创建、复制、切换、删除和旧配置迁移
- 新增按窗口或指定日期范围重建聊天记忆
- Compose DSL 文件选择器新增文档、图片、视频、媒体、目录和相机模式
- 新增 `AiChat`、`AdaptiveSidePanel`、Compose DSL 对话框和聊天消息长按菜单
- 新增 DeepSeek Harness 运行时侧栏和完整 ToolPkg 运行时支持
- 新增 MiniMax、OpenCode Zen/Go、xAI Grok 和 OpenAI Codex OAuth 提供商，并支持 Codex 配额查询和 PDF 输入
- 新增按提供商和模型动态配置思考深度，补充 DeepSeek Responses、Qwen、Gemini 等端点规则
- 新增 DeepSeek Responses Web Search、服务端工具记录和 reasoning 回放
- ToolPkg 新增版本化 API、包依赖、加载顺序、运行态 Hook、消息持久化 Hook 和聊天消息菜单
- 新增数据库、DataStore 配置健康检查和手动修复流程，并在修复前归档原始文件
- 新增主进程、插件 QuickJS、终端和设备 CPU/内存/网络性能监控
- 新增日语本地化、xAI 绘图自定义 API 地址、ToolPkg Logo 和已选聊天记录导出

## 修复

- 修复并行或分段工具结果在流式展示、历史记录和下一轮请求中的顺序不一致问题
- 修复 Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini、Kimi、OpenAI 等 Provider 的工具调用与结果配对问题
- 修复未匹配工具结果被误报为“用户取消”，并补充缺失结果的诊断信息
- 修复 DeepSeek Responses commentary/reasoning 回放、工具历史和正文流式输出问题
- 修复 OpenAI Responses 中 `video_url`/`input_video` 内容丢失问题
- 修复长工具结果、超大聊天导出、被中断的流式回复和多工具结果被提前丢弃的问题
- 修复群聊编排重复发送用户消息，以及消息变体事件使用旧快照的问题
- 修复 Compose DSL 文本框光标跳动、复制预览回弹、输入法遮挡和 Markdown 表格链接点击问题
- 修复 MCP 工具发现成功后未及时注册，以及并发权限描述注册的数据竞争
- 修复媒体能力测试把“已连通”误判为“能力已验证”的问题
- 修复浏览器桌面 viewport、截图尺寸、Provider 历史图片和模型列表刷新问题
- 修复悬浮窗非法尺寸、初始化竞态和连续崩溃保护问题
- 修复 Web Chat JavaScript 模块 MIME 类型错误
- 修复备份恢复、SQLite 参数数量限制、偏好迁移和 ToolPkg manifest 解析问题
- 修复 OpenCode、Codex、DeepSeek 和 OpenAI 的思考参数映射与历史兼容问题

## 优化

- ToolPkg 发布、API 版本展示、依赖检查、包排序、manifest 选择和隐藏目录排除更加可靠
- 摘要支持分区配置、独立标题、启用状态和对话回顾设置
- Token 统计的迁移、恢复、重试、价格计算和长时间运行稳定性得到提升
- 状态卡片改用内置完整 Material Symbols 字体，离线环境下也能正常显示
- APK 逆向工具升级至 1.1.0，JADX 支持隔离进程、串行任务和更完整的错误诊断
- 改进聊天复制、长历史浏览、流式滚动、LaTeX 渲染和大消息处理
- CI 拆分 Android/JVM 检查并优化缓存、原生依赖和 Nightly 构建流程
- 市场贡献者内容、Logo、包来源、版本信息和审核流程更加完整
- README 默认切换为英文，并保留 `README.zh-CN.md` 中文版本
- 补充日语及多种语言的模型、市场、ToolPkg、统计和设置文案

release.name: Bitchat Android 2.0.1
release.notes:
## Bitchat Android 2.0.1

### Highlights

- **Bitchat for Wear OS:** join the nearby mesh from your watch, use public chat and encrypted direct messages, browse People, manage favorites and verification, receive notifications, record voice notes, and receive images and files.
- **New chat styles:** choose the classic Matrix layout or peer-colored message bubbles, including bubble-aware media, timestamps, and delivery indicators.
- **Live push-to-talk:** stream voice in public channels and encrypted direct messages on Android and Wear OS, with improved recording feedback, waveforms, haptics, and slide-to-cancel controls.
- **Cashu support:** recognize and preview Cashu eCash tokens, use `/pay`, and redeem with a compatible external wallet or web flow. Cashu tokens are bearer instruments; anyone who obtains a token may be able to redeem it.
- **Persistent private conversations:** keep conversation history, unread state, aliases, favorites, and previews across restarts, with clearer controls for deleting conversations.
- **Offline geohash globe:** explore geohash channels with a native animated 3D globe, country borders, cities, polar coverage, and adjustable render quality.
- **Language picker:** change the app language from within Bitchat, with expanded translations.
- **Local-first APK sharing and updates:** share an installed APK nearby and resume signature-verified update downloads with clearer progress and rate-limit handling.
- **Reliability and privacy:** stronger queued-message delivery and ordering, Noise session recovery and identity binding, more reliable receipts and peer lifecycle handling, safer Wi-Fi Direct cleanup, bounded payload processing, quieter sensitive logging, and a more complete panic wipe of in-memory networking state.

### First reproducible full-app release

This is Bitchat Android's first reproducible full-app release. The unsigned phone and Wear OS APKs and Android App Bundles were built twice in independent GitHub Action

release.name: v1.7 — 支持 WhatsApp，分析结果改为常驻卡片
release.notes:
**新增**
- 支持 WhatsApp 一对一聊天（测试中）：读取聊天、判断、候选回复、填入整条链路。群聊不读；WhatsApp 里不截屏。读取规则来自 @smgonthebeat（#73）。
- 分析结果改成一张常驻小卡片：收起时只显示风险等级和对方意图，点标题展开看完整分析和候选回复，再点收起。卡片可以拖到屏幕任意位置，每个 App 分别记住位置。
- 候选回复下方新增「换一组」：判断不变，只重新生成一组候选，不会和上一组重复。
- 设置里可以选候选回复条数（1 / 2 / 3 条）；只要 1 条时不做排序，出得更快。
- 判断接口新增「Vercel」「OpenCode Zen」两个预设。

**改进**
- 只有对方发来新消息才重新分析。上下翻聊天记录不会清空卡片、不会重新分析，也不会弹来弹去；更新时旧结果先留着，标题旁显示已等待的秒数。
- 候选回复的语言跟随对方：对方说英文就用英文回复。
- 判断和回复各自最多等 30 秒，超时就停下并给出「重试」。
- 无障碍服务的注册名称改为 Jev 自己的名称。
- 截屏识别更流畅（感谢 @ahxoeh）；兼容更多中转网关（感谢 @xuancanhit99）。

**修复**
- 候选回复偶尔一直显示「生成中」。
- QQ 群聊上下滚动时分析面板卡成空白。

**已知限制**
- 从 v1.4 或更早版本升级后，需要到系统设置里重新打开一次 Jev 助手的无障碍开关。
- 隐藏界面内容或禁止截屏的 App 不支持；界面目前只有中文。
- 在第三方聊天 App 里使用可能不符合其用户协议，账号有被限制的风险，请自行判断。

**安装**
- 下载下方附件 `jev-assistant-v1.7-release.apk`，Android 11 及以上，arm64 机型。装过旧版的可以直接覆盖安装，设置和密钥都会保留。
- 完整更新记录见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis/blob/main/cn/CHANGELOG.md)。

# ArchiveTune v15.1.0

ArchiveTune **15.1.0** focuses on improving YouTube playback reliability, account synchronization, library management, podcasts, Android Auto, the immersive player, Home discovery, and overall application stability.

This release integrates **YouTube Music community content**, **featured playlist cards**, **podcast library management**, **podcast episode search**, **Android Auto support**, **automatic updates**, **Canvas backdrop capture**, improved **local-media reconciliation**, **Last.fm authentication**, and expanded **Browse** functionality.

It also includes improvements to Always-On Display handling, playback error reporting, account sessions, library refresh behavior, JavaScript runtime stability, and the immersive player experience.

---

## ✨ Highlights

### ⚡ YouTube Playback & JavaScript Runtime

The YouTube playback system continues to receive reliability and stability improvements.

- Integrated an updated YouTube JavaScript runtime bundle.
- Improved YouTube playback error mapping for `YoutubeiException`.
- Improved account session synchronization.
- Improved authentication-state handling during playback and library synchronization.
- Hardened JavaScript worker execution to prevent crashes from recursive array conversions and thread stack exhaustion.
- Simplified playback error handling and authentication checks.
- Improved handling of restricted authentication data during stream resolution.

**Contributors:** @rukamori, @mikooochi

---

### 🏠 Home & Community

The Home screen now includes more content discovery options.

- Integrated **featured playlist cards** into Home.
- Integrated the **Community** section into the Home feed.

- Added filtering and loading support for community content.

- Improved Home state handling and concurrency.

release.notes:
## What's Changed

### Added

- **Icon background** — the plate behind an adaptive icon. A transparent image defaults to white. Pick a color when the mark needs a dark plate, or pick fully transparent `#00000000` to keep an empty plate. An opaque image keeps the color of its own edges. Export again (#1273, #1281, closes #1094, #1279)
- **Privacy policy** — a public page for the builder, in English and 中文, for the Play listing. Apps built with WebToApp still need their own policy (#1268, closes #1267)

### Changed

- **Export source** — the zip is a Gradle project Android Studio can open: manifest, a WebView activity, config, and local files. The keystore, `node_modules`, `.git`, and the full shell runtime stay out (#1261, closes #1260)
- **HTML load mode** — Automatic, Local file, or Local server. Local file keeps `fetch` and `localStorage` on disk and omits the internet permission. A page that needs a CDN, ES modules, or WASM still uses the local server (#1257, closes #1254)
- **Page zoom** — the percent locks the layout viewport, so text, layout, images, and canvas scale together. A page's own viewport meta cannot pin the scale back to 100%. GeckoView applies the same script when the page finishes loading. Export again (#1266, closes #1264)
- **Sponsor** — the Swiftproxy card, logo, and referral link are removed from the builder and the READMEs (#1271, closes #1270)

### Fixed

- **Android 12 Gecko preview** — creating the downloaded engine no longer overflows the stack in `registerComponentCallbacks`. The separate-task recents label uses `TaskDescription.Builder` only on Android 13+ (#1275, closes #1274)
- **Host launcher glyph** — the adaptive foreground is the white mark on a transparent field, so an icon pack can extract the glyph. The mark is sized for the 66dp safe zone after #1269 left it filling the canvas (#1269, #1281, closes #1177, #1279)

- Apps that continue to use Flutter's existing `material.dart` widgets should stay on `easy_refresh: ^3.5.1`.

| --- | --- |
| [easy_refresh](https://pub.dev/packages/easy_refresh/versions/4.0.0) | 4.0.0 |
| [easy_paging](https://pub.dev/packages/easy_paging/versions/4.0.0) | 4.0.0 |

- Built-in indicators resolve `Theme` and localizations from `package:material_ui` / `package:cupertino_ui`.

release.notes:
## Advanced theming It's now possible to create advanced themes for FUTO Keyboard! Check out the [Themes page](https://keyboard.futo.tech/themes) which will be expanded in the future.

This sits in addition to the already-existing simple in-app editor that was introduced in v0.1.27. So to recap: * **Simple theming** by typical end-users, for personal themes and whatnot, is done directly inside the app. It's fairly limited and stays inside the app, so there are no sharing options, beyond you sharing a background picture. * **Advanced theming** by artists or developers is done via the new web editor with a desktop device, and is more complicated. It produces ZIP themes which can be shared anywhere and imported into FUTO Keyboard via the theme menu. The advanced theme editor requires using a desktop device, you can't use it from your phone. This is an intentional scope decision. If you want to make themes from your phone, you should consider simple theming instead. Advanced theming allows modifying all 44 colors of the keyboard individually, as well as applying custom bitmap borders and icons to keys via a matchrule system. The advanced theme editor will continue to be worked on over time. You can access it here: https://keyboard.futo.tech/theme-editor To learn how the editor works, I recommend downloading some of those themes and importing them into the editor. This way, you can see a real example of how the various features are used. If you make something cool, share it with us in the Discord, Zulip, or email it to us! The themes page will be updated to allow user theme submissions next. We're still figuring out how to allow advanced customization of a mobile keyboard without destroying performance or flexibility, so consider this functionality to still be somewhat of a preview. release.name: Flow v3.0.0
release.notes:
# Flow v3.0.0

**Release date:** 2026-10-18
**Status:** Stable

Enjoying Flow? Consider supporting its development on [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/flow-tube) or [Patreon](https://patreon.com/A_EDev) to help keep the app free, open source, ad-free, and improving!

## Highlights

- The whole app is redesigned on Material 3 Expressive, with real tablet and foldable layouts
- Flow now runs on its own native InnerTube client everywhere, NewPipe's extractor is gone
- New on-device music taste engine: Quick Picks, Daily Mixes, endless radio and new shelves
- Home recommendations rebuilt to learn from what you actually watch (#907)
- Flow Recap: private monthly and yearly stats, plus a Recap story you can share
- New Equalizer page with AutoEQ and EqualizerAPO presets
- Word by word lyrics, a rebuilt music player and a new queue
- Big upgrades to Downloads, Local media and subtitles
- In-app updates, private notes, and themes shared with Flow Desktop

## Behavior changes

- Background Play is now on by default, you can turn it off in Playback settings (#1298)
- Backups now carry your settings and library only. The recommendation engine and sync identity stay on the device, so a reinstall starts the engine clean (#907)
- The Flow Control Center is now called Your taste
- Explore's Movies tab is gone because YouTube stopped serving its chart (#1254)

## Native innertube client

- Search, channels, Explore, Shorts, comments, descriptions and the player all run on Flow's own InnerTube client
- Video search makes one request per page instead of thirteen, with filters and sorting done by the server
- The player resolves videos through one client instead of racing two, and fetches the watch page once per video
- Channel pages handle scheduled streams and premieres correctly
- Explore uses YouTube's own destinations instead of the trending endpoints YouTube retired

## Search, explore and channels

- New Material 3 search bar, filters in a sheet and a grid/list togg

release.name: ReadAny v1.3.6
release.notes:
ReadAny v1.3.6 来啦。这一版重点完善了 **桌面端与移动端的 RAG / 知识检索能力**，新增 **PDF 深色与 Sepia 主题适配**，并集中改善 AI 对话、引用跳转、移动端输入以及 EPUB / PDF 阅读体验。

> 说明：本版本说明只列用户可感知的新增、优化和修复。开发过程中的内部验证、联调和边界问题收敛不单独列出。

## 新功能

- **PDF 支持深色与 Sepia 主题**：桌面端和移动端的 PDF 页面可跟随全局主题，并逐页识别内容，尽量避免对照片或深色页面错误反色
- **新增 Atlas Cloud AI 服务商**：可在 AI 模型设置中配置和使用 Atlas Cloud
- **AI 对话显示选中文本原句**：从阅读器选中文字并进入 AI 对话后，可在顶部直接对照原文提问
- **移动端补全本地与远程向量检索**：支持远程 Embedding，并为中文和英文提供本地模型选择

## 优化

- **RAG 检索更完整可靠**：统一桌面端和移动端的查询向量配置，校验书籍向量来源与维度，减少模型或服务切换后检索结果异常
- **AI 工具调用与引用跳转更稳定**：工具参数兼容性、超时处理和状态展示更可靠；缺少精确位置的引用也会尝试根据章节和原文恢复跳转
- **AI 对话反馈更清楚**：超长输入会提示分段提问，输出达到长度限制或工具调用未完成时不再把残缺回答显示为正常完成
- **移动端输入体验更完善**：设置、首次引导、笔记、书籍详情、新建分组等输入区域会自动避让键盘
- **阅读器书籍样式兼容性更好**：书籍字体设置可正确作用于正文，同时尊重书籍对行内图片高度的显式设置，并继续限制大图溢出
- **阅读器交互更稳**：优化 iOS 长按选词、划线和翻页的冲突，链接点击、目录跳转与正常点按翻页之间的判断更准确

## 修复

- 修复 iOS 选词或划线结束后可能误触翻页，以及选中状态下翻页行为不稳定的问题
- 修复点击 EPUB 目录或正文链接后可能闪回原页、跳到上一章的问题
- 修复部分 EPUB 缺少样式表链接时书籍样式完全丢失的问题
- 修复部分 EPUB 行内小图标被异常放大，以及行内标记式注脚无法预览或跳转的问题
- 修复 macOS Retina 屏幕上 PDF 文本层错位、跨行选中和复制不准确的问题
- 修复移动端 PDF 在深色主题下出现色差、白边等显示问题
- 修复 AI 聊天中超长连续文本无法换行、深色模式下 Markdown 可读性较差的问题
- 修复部分 AI 工具参数无法生成 Schema、引用未登记或点击后无法跳转的问题
- 修复 Android TTS 音色选择器崩溃，以及小米 MiMo TTS 偶尔无法继续朗读的问题
- 修复卸载外部 AI / CLI 接入后残留配置或反馈不明确的问题

---

## English Release Notes

ReadAny v1.3.6 improves **RAG and knowledge retrieval across desktop and mobile**, adds **dark and Sepia themes for PDFs**, and delivers a focused set of improvements to AI chat, citation navigation, mobile input, and EPUB / PDF reading.

> Note: these release notes only list user-facing additions, improvements, and fixes. Internal validation, integration, and edge-case cleanup are not listed separately.

## New Features

- **Added dark and Sepia themes for PDFs** on desktop and mobile, with per-page content detection to avoid incorrectly inverting photo-heavy or already-dark pages

- **Added selected-text context to AI chat** so the original passag

## Vectras VM 4.5.0-3dfx — Github/Community Version

This release is functionally unchanged from **4.4.9**. It fixes server and download configuration issues and updates the branding for the GitHub Community Version. No new emulation features are introduced.

### 🔧 Changes

- Fixed server links and online resource configuration.
- Updated branding for the Community Version.

### 🎮 3dfx Support

Our 3dfx-patched QEMU builds are currently available only for **ARM64 (`arm64-v8a`)** and **x86_64** devices.

**ARMv7 (`armeabi-v7a`)** and **32-bit x86** devices use standard QEMU without the 3dfx modification and currently do not support 3dfx.

[Download 3dfx-Wrappers for 4.1.1](https://github.com/xoureldeen/Vectras-VM-Android/raw/refs/heads/master/3dfx/4.1.1+/3dfx-wrappers-i686.iso)

Other versions:
[3dfx Wrappers](https://github.com/xoureldeen/Vectras-VM-Android/tree/master/3dfx)

### 📥 Manual QEMU Downloads

Download the archive matching your Android device’s architecture, then choose **Select QEMU** during setup:

- [ARM64 - vectras-vm-arm64-v8a.tar.gz](https://github.com/xoureldeen/vectras-vm-bucket/releases/download/v1.0.0/vectras-vm-arm64-v8a.tar.gz)
- [x86_64 - vectras-vm-x86_64.tar.gz](https://github.com/xoureldeen/vectras-vm-bucket/releases/download/v1.0.0/vectras-vm-x86_64.tar.gz)

For ARMv7 and 32-bit x86, setup installs standard QEMU through Alpine when the corresponding archive link in the setup JSON is empty.

2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people

release.notes:
# 🚀 ClipCascade v3.2.0 Release

**ClipCascade**, the lightweight, open-source clipboard sync tool, is now faster, leaner, and more powerful than ever!

### 📥 Available Downloads
| Platform              | File Name               |
|-----------------------|-------------------------|
| **Windows**           | Installer (`ClipCascade.msi`), Portable/Standalone Executable (`ClipCascade.exe`)—No startup option   |
| **macOS**             | ARM M-Series (`ClipCascade-Apple_macOS(ARM_M-Series).zip`), Intel (`ClipCascade-Apple_macOS(Intel-Series).zip`) |
| **Android**           | `ClipCascade.apk`       |
| **Linux (GUI/CLI)**   | `ClipCascade_Linux.zip` / `ClipCascade_Linux.tar.xz` |
| **Docker**            | `docker-compose.yml`    |

---

### 🔑 Key Features
* Cross-platform clipboard sync for **Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android**
* **Dual-mode sync**: Peer-to-Server (P2S) or Peer-to-Peer (P2P)
* Full **self-hosting** support for privacy and control
* **End-to-end encryption** with zero-knowledge access
* Fully configurable: set clipboard limits, encryption salt, and hash complexity

---

### ✨ What's New in v3.2.0

#### **Desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux)**:
* **P2P**: Refreshed signaling and data-channel handling, with fixes for race conditions, incorrect peer counts, and peers dropping after **system sleep**; WebSocket ping/pong and data-channel heartbeats for idle sessions; a bounded wait when closing peer connections after sleep
* **Linux**: Optional **Wayland** clipboard watch (`wl-paste --watch`) alongside polling; longer **wl-clipboard** timeouts for reliability; new CLI overrides: `--gui` / `--xmode` (`true` or `false`) and `--polling` (seconds) for the clipboard polling interval
* **macOS**: Pasteboard access locking for safer reads; **Dock icon hidden** when running as a tray app
* **Windows & macOS**: Dedicated **PyInstaller** spec files for reproducible builds
* **Login & networking**: Optional **custom SSL CA** path (GUI and CLI)

repo.description: Turn any Android device into a beautiful, dedicated Home Assistant kiosk. Purpose-built for Home Assistant from the ground up.

release.notes:
## What's new in Kiosk Satellite 2026.10.37

This release sends motion events over ONVIF so NVRs such as UniFi Protect can record on motion, splits Full screen into separate switches for the status bar and navigation bar and adds an option to show the dashboard over a secured lock screen.

### New Feature: ONVIF motion events

- **Record on motion (#1098).** With the ONVIF protocol, the new **Send motion events** switch under **Camera > RTSP & ONVIF Streaming > Motion Events** reports motion to ONVIF clients over PullPoint subscriptions, so NVRs such as UniFi Protect can record on motion.
- **Pick the motion source.** **Motion source** picks the sensor from **Camera motion sensor**, **Person sensor** and **Home Assistant sensor**. Person sensor is listed on devices that have one, such as the Meta Portal. Home Assistant sensor follows one of your motion, occupancy or presence sensors. A note under the picker says when the picked sensor is off and where to turn it on.

### Improvements

- **Hide the status bar and navigation bar separately (#1102).** **Full screen** under **Screen & Audio > Screen** is now two switches, **Hide status bar** and **Hide navigation bar**, so a tablet can keep its taskbar in view while the clock and notification icons stay hidden. A hidden bar shows for a moment with a swipe from its edge. A kiosk that had Full screen off keeps both bars, and Kiosk mode and Lockdown still hide both.
- **Show over lock screen (#1105).** A new **Show over lock screen** switch under **Screen & Audio > Screen** shows the dashboard on top of a lock screen that has a PIN, pattern or password. When the screen comes back on after Kiosk Satellite turned it off, the dashboard shows instead of the lock screen. Home, Recents and other apps still ask for the PIN, pattern or password. It is off by default.

release.name: Release v1.11.9
release.notes:
## 新功能

**外挂字幕编辑框与多字幕交互** ([#933](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/933))

播放界面支持多条外挂字幕同时加载，各字幕拥有独立时间轴。长按字幕文字可弹出编辑框，拖动编辑框可同步调整全局字幕位置偏移。切换视频或跳转到下一句台词时编辑框自动收起，避免弹幕层因编辑框持续重绘而出现闪烁。字幕轨道菜单和字幕设置菜单同步提供 Cupertino 与 NipaPlay 两套主题样式。关联：[#920](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/920)、[#922](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/922)

**VobSub (.sub+.idx) 图形字幕支持** ([#957](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/957))

新增对 VobSub 图形字幕格式的完整支持，包括本地文件选择器、WebDAV/SMB 等远程来源及自动配对下载。加载视频时自动优先选择简体中文或日语字幕轨道，其余候选字幕堆叠在轨道菜单中供手动切换，切换时不会打断当前正在播放的字幕。远程缓存的字幕文件始终以原始文件名显示，冷启动后也能正确还原。

**播放器快捷调节与媒体库 NEW 标识开关** ([#945](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/945))

在"设置 → 播放器"新增"播放器菜单快捷调节"开关，开启后可在播放器菜单顶部直接调整倍速和音量增强，默认关闭。在"设置 → 外观"新增"媒体库 NEW 标识"开关，关闭后隐藏桌面、手机和电视媒体库卡片上的 NEW 角标，新内容追踪与排序逻辑不受影响，默认开启。两项设置重启后均保持选择。

**首页新番回顾板块** ([#953](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/953))

首页新增限时开启的新番回顾板块，可在设置中关闭。

**Linux 平台启用 Erika 播放内核** ([#972](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/972))

Linux 源码构建现在支持使用 Erika 原生播放内核。Wayland 环境下视频、字幕和弹幕通过原生视图渲染，Flutter 控件以透明层叠加；X11 使用兼容纹理视图。新安装默认使用 Erika，已保存的内核选择不受影响。源码构建安装器支持 `NIPAPLAY_WSL_GPU_COPY=1` 选项，可在 WSL 环境下启用 D3D12 GPU 帧直传，减少解码帧在 GPU 与 CPU 之间的往返传输。

**升级 Erika 至 0.2.1，Linux 发布包内置 Erika** ([#982](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/982))

将 Erika 播放引擎升级至 0.2.1，Linux 正式发布包现在随包携带 Erika 内核，新安装默认启用，已有用户的内核选择保留。amd64 和 arm64 均静态链接 FFmpeg 8，并启用 NVDEC、VA-API 和 Vulkan 互操作。

**媒体信息页剧集多版本绑定** ([#971](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/971))

新版媒体信息页支持将同一剧集绑定多个视频文件版本，播放前弹窗供用户选择对应版本，也可快速解除匹配。同时新增剧集自动定位，修复鼠标滚轮在剧集列表中滚动速度过慢的问题。

**Jellyfin 剧集添加日期排序** ([#979](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/979))

新增 Jellyfin 的"剧集添加日期"排序选项，使近期新增剧集的番剧可以排在前面，支持升序和降序。同时修复 Emby/Jellyfin 旧排序存档字段缺失时打开排序菜单或加载媒体库触发空值异常的问题。关联：[#795](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/795)

release.name: v1.18.0
release.notes:
本次正式版在 v1.17.0 基础上完成大范围架构重构，收束阅读器、漫画源、同步与运行时的职责边界，并新增图片原始像素尺寸、章节阅读进度、自动阅读屏幕常亮与跳过不可用图片。同步修复 WebDAV 应用数据同步、日志持久化、AVIF 识别及图片去混淆性能问题，修复 Rust 依赖安全告警并更新相关依赖。经 v1.18.0-rc.1 至 rc.5 逐版验证，Windows 与 Android 的 WebDAV 手动上传、云端下载覆盖及自动同步已通过实机验收。

### 新增

- 阅读器可选显示图片原始像素尺寸，支持单页、多页、连续阅读及宽图拆分；缩小解码和缓存命中仍保留原始尺寸，开关支持全局／设备／单本设置（#95）。
- 收藏、追更及漫画卡片显示章节和页码进度，阅读时持久化章节／分组名称，图源不可用后仍可查看；旧历史兼容序号回退，长标题支持省略、完整提示和读屏（#93）。
- 自动阅读默认保持 Android／iOS 屏幕常亮，提供全局／设备／单本开关；停止自动阅读、切后台和退出时恢复系统休眠，旋转与迟到的原生回调不会遗留常亮状态（#96）。
- 自动阅读新增默认关闭的「跳过不可用图片」选项：失败图片按正常节奏跳过，加载中的图片在 1–60 秒可调的前台等待后继续；覆盖单页、并排页及连续／瀑布流视图，保留操作暂停和章节加载保护，修复瀑布流短错误占位在末章提前可见时的停止定位（#98 后续建议）。

### 修复

- 应用数据同步恢复 v1.17.0 的 WebDAV SDK 上传、下载及旧备份清理流程，沿用日期与数据版本文件名，不再要求条件 PUT、强 ETag 或内容基线；修复候选版上传已返回 201、却因下载／CDN 的 ETag 无法授权清理而持续报错并阻断后续同步的问题。
- 恢复 WebDAV 文件下载重定向兼容：仅允许 GET 受控跟随，跨源不传递 WebDAV 认证、Cookie、自定义请求头和默认查询参数，限制跳转次数并拒绝循环及 HTTPS 降级，恢复 123 云盘等服务的下载域名跳转。
- 修复 Android 数据目录经过系统路径别名时，同步初始化误报 `Upload data path contains a link`，以及备份已下载成功却在覆盖导入 `history.db` 等文件时报 `Import filesystem entry is an alias` 的问题；统一使用解析后的物理根目录，保留归档内部链接与越界检查。
- 修复阅读器横竖屏切换后自动阅读被中断的问题，旋转或每页图片数量变化时会清理失效的页面动画状态。
- 修复手动同步下载无法再次导入同版本备份的问题，支持确认后覆盖本地修改并强制导入远端归档。
- 修复 Hitomi 图片响应缺少可识别文件头时无法保存的问题，改用图片 URL 的扩展名作为安全回退。
- 信息、警告和错误日志按批次追加并刷新到磁盘，补写启动早期日志；重启保留记录，超过 2 MiB 时轮转到 `logs.previous.txt`，退出／导出等待写入完成，避免常驻文件句柄及未处理的写入异常（#88）。
- 修复 AVIF 的主品牌／兼容品牌和动画品牌识别，支持不同 ISO-BMFF 盒长度并拒绝截断或伪匹配；新增固定来源的测试样本与解码探测工具（#94）。
- 去混淆的独立像素缓冲区改为按行／连续块批量复制，保留共享缓冲区原有脚本语义；PNG 输出只读取有效子视图，返回 Dart 字节后立即释放原生缓冲区，避免额外复制及等待 GC，新增可复现的像素复制基准（#91）。
- 将纵向连续／瀑布流的边距设置明确标为「条漫缩小（每侧边距）」，补充平板使用说明、宽度比例表和 FAQ 入口；既有缩小功能保留当前阅读进度（#85）。
- 修复阅读、同步、图片下载及 CI 校验的其余问题，收束源操作、弹窗与收藏交互的原宿主归属。

### 维护与文档

- 发布版本更新为 `1.18.0+234`，同步应用版本、发布配置与更新记录。
- 定向升级 Rhttp 的 Rust 依赖，修复 10 条 GitHub 告警及全量扫描发现的 HTTP/2、QUIC 和内存安全问题；工具链更新至 1.92.0，补齐 Cargo 每周更新和完整锁文件审计，漏洞及 unsound 告警均阻断 CI（#101、#102、#103）。
- 更新 battery_plus、Dio、enough_convert、url_launcher 等 Dart 依赖及 Rhttp 常规依赖，保留 Flutter Rust Bridge 2.11.1 与本地取消回调补丁；将 libc 暂时固定为 0.2.189，并增加 PR 的 iOS Rhttp 原生编译门禁与依赖锁定回归检查。
- 在 WebDAV 同步关键代码

release.notes:
## OpenClaw Android v2026.9.14

Standalone Android app, no Termux required.

> **If setup failed for you on a recent version, please try again.** The previously published APKs were missing one of `proot`'s required libraries, so setup could not complete at all on a fresh install. That is fixed in this release.

### Setup was broken, and is fixed

`proot` declares `Depends: libandroid-shmem, libtalloc`, but the script that bundles the proot binaries into the APK only fetched `libtalloc`. Every published APK therefore shipped a `proot` binary the Android dynamic linker refused to load:

```
CANNOT LINK EXECUTABLE ... library "libandroid-shmem.so" not found
```

Nothing downstream could run: no rootfs configuration, no Node.js, no OpenClaw. CI now **fails** rather than publishing an APK with incomplete proot libraries.

| [#124](https://github.com/mithun50/openclaw-termux/issues/124) | **Custom gateway port is honoured.** `18789` was hard-coded in eight places, so setting `gateway.port` left the app probing the wrong address and eventually declaring a healthy gateway dead |
| [#81](https://github.com/mithun50/openclaw-termux/issues/81), [#95](https://github.com/mithun50/openclaw-termux/issues/95) | **Node device commands are actually authorised.** The app wrote `gateway.nodes.allowCommands`, which OpenClaw does not read. | [#133](https://github.com/mithun50/openclaw-termux/issues/133) | **OpenClaw install no longer fails** with `ENOTEMPTY` after an interrupted attempt, and Node.js moves to 22.23.2 to satisfy `undici` |

release.notes:
## PaperKnife v1.1.0 (10100)

### Compress rebuilt — #16
Medium and High tiers did little on real files. They now shrink embedded photos in place, leaving text sharp and selectable, with a full rebuild only as fallback. Smallest is untouched, and a file that can't shrink ships unchanged instead of growing.

### Unlock rebuilt — #30, #60
Unlock now performs real decryption: native engine on Android, qpdf on web, verified before reporting success. Every tool decrypts locked files in memory through one shared path; outputs of locked inputs are disclosed as unlocked. Repair refuses locked files and points at Unlock instead. Wrong passwords name the file.

### Viewer zoom — #9 (zoom half; hyperlinks intentionally not built)
100–300%: header buttons, smooth continuous pinch, double-tap 100%↔200%, gapless edge-to-edge pages, live page numbers, progressive rendering so heavy files stay smooth.

- PDF→Image quality picker (Draft 72 / Standard 150 / Print 300 DPI) and separate-files export alongside single ZIP — #22, #23

Notable changes in version 93:

* fit the preview to any window instead of deriving its height from its width
* follow the window rotation while the activity handles it itself
* re-fit the settings panel when the preview underneath it is resized

A full list of changes from the previous release (version 92) is available through the [Git commit log between the releases](https://github.com/GrapheneOS/Camera/compare/92...93).

----

This app is [available through the Play Store with the `app.grapheneos.camera.play` app id](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.grapheneos.camera.play). Play Store releases go through review and it usually takes around 1 to 2 days before the Play Store pushes out the update to users. Play Store releases use Play Signing, so we use a separate app id from the releases we publish ourselves to avoid conflicts and to distinguish between them. Each release is initially pushed out through the Beta channel followed by the Stable channel.

Releases of the app signed by GrapheneOS with the `app.grapheneos.camera` app id are published in the [GrapheneOS App Store](https://github.com/GrapheneOS/AppStore/releases) which provides fully automatic updates. ## v4.62.0 — 2026-10-22

### Added

- **Demo app: 3D Scan can scan one part again and add it to a copy of the scan ([#4736](https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/issues/4736)).** "Re-scan this part" now starts a live scan of that part. The new session is lined up on the first scan from its floor and walls, then refined point to plane, with no cloud service. Once it is lined up, the part is framed in amber on the camera and a line says how much of it is filled. On saving, the re-scan's points are added inside the part to a copy of the scan, kept as a new scan; the original stays as it was. When the two cannot be told apart for sure (another room, one flat wall, a corner that fits several places, a room that looks the same turned round), the re-scan is refused with "couldn't line up this part" and nothing is merged.
- **Demo app: the 3D Scan result shows the parts worth scanning again ([#4736](https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/issues/4736)).** A stretch of wall never seen, floor never seen with nothing standing on it, and floor seen only sparsely are each framed in amber on the model, in 3D and in the Plan view, and counted in a pill beside the tour's. A tap lists them with their reason. Each part's "Re-scan this part" is shown but disabled until a part scanned on its own can be lined up with the first scan. Recordings opened from `.rrd` files carry no normals, so they show floor parts only.
- **3D Scan (demo): the plan follows the room's real shape ([#4744](https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/pull/4744)).** Walls of any layout (L, T, U, oblique), doors and windows with their sizes, and the ceiling height; a wall never seen is drawn as deduced, not invented.

release.notes:
## 1.6.1 (CH)

发布的是 Pre-release 难道不就是，还需要一些测试吗，我自己没办法测试到所有的 case，这仅仅是一个免费开源的项目

希望大家都能友好反馈

在 Issue 中建议”撤销发布“，也许还有诸多人都有类似的想法

说难听点，这群不友好反馈的人，只是只会逼逼赖赖的伸手党而已，说那么多废话，自己有能力自己写一个我来用

但我就要发布！有问题好好反馈！我又不是不改！给你惯的！

- 优化 code-server 的拷贝逻辑，修复自定义版本失效的问题
- 修复 QEMU 相关的报错
- 优化 UI 样式，增加进度条信息展示，优化状态栏沉浸，修改了 App 图标
- 代码上的诸多优化，增加一些双语注释，优化进度条逻辑，不再使用`魔数`等
- 支持 I18n，目前支持中文和英语
- 升级 proot-distro 到 4.28.0
- 升级 code-server 到 4.103.1
- 升级 ubuntu 到 noble-aarch64-pd-v4.18.0

注意: 我打包的版本会收集以下信息
```json
{
    "app": "Code LFA",
    "time": "$TIME",
    "platform": "Android",
    "unique_key": "",
    "app_version": "",
}
```
其中 unique_key 是随机生成的，并非设备唯一 ID

这些信息仅仅用来观察我个人的软件的日活等，我需要根据这些数据来分配我的时间

如果你比较介意，后续我会同时带上不带数据上报的版本，或者自行编译

目前的接口是 HTTPS，后续我尝试用 HTTP 来上报，保证数据上的透明

这和垄断的 alist 上报数据并不一样，未涉及任何用户相关信息

很抱歉我个人有些强迫症，改了一些 git 的历史记录，fork 仓库的朋友需要执行以下代码或者重新 fork
预计近期还会改一些代码，等到正式发布 v1.6.0 的 Release 的时候，大家再操作
```bash
# 1) 备份当前分支（可选）
git branch backup/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

# 2) 添加/确认 upstream 指向你的仓库
git remote -v
git remote add upstream https://github.com/nightmare-space/code_lfa.git 2>/dev/null || true

# 3) 拉取最新（包含重写后的历史）
git fetch upstream --prune --tags

# 4) 切到要同步的分支（如 main），硬重置到 upstream
git checkout main
git reset --hard upstream/main

# 5) 强制推回自己的 fork（origin）
git push origin main --force-with-lease

# 若需要同步标签与清理已删除的标签
git push origin --tags --force --prune
```

## 1.6.1 (CH)

Isn’t a Pre-release meant for further testing? I can’t possibly cover every case myself; this is just a free, open-source project.

I hope everyone can provide feedback in a friendly manner.

Some people suggested “revoke the release” in Issues; perhaps many others feel the same.

To be blunt, those who don’t provide constructive feedback are just freeloaders who only complain. If you’re that capable, write something yourself for me to use.

But I’m going to release it anyway! If there are issues, provide proper feedback! It’s not like I won’t fix them!

Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either  [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people

# Levyra 3.0.0

## Highlights

This is the biggest update Levyra has had so far, which is why it's called 3.0.0.

The headline is skins. Until now you could change colours, player styles and a lot of small details, but the app always kept the same basic shape. Skins change that. Each one restyles Home, Explore, Library, Settings, the mini player and the full player, so switching skin feels like switching to a different app that still has all your music in it.

There's also personalised discovery on Home, a much better radio section, smarter matching when you import playlists from other services, and a player that handles Canvas and video more gracefully.

## Seven new skins

You'll find them under Settings → Design → Skin. Levyra Default is still the default, and your customisations are kept when you switch back and forth.

- Nocturne 78 brings the warmth of a vintage hi-fi.
- Prism pairs deep black with raspberry accents.
- Torque goes for bold graphite shapes and sharp angles.
- Ivory is soft and bright, with a dark mode of its own.
- Spotify Style, Apple Music Style and YouTube Music Style follow the layouts people already know from those apps.

## The player

Velvet, in the Default skin, now uses the same player as Apple Music Style: same artwork, controls, spacing and motion, in portrait, in landscape and on the inner screen of a foldable.

When a song has a vertical Canvas, it now plays full screen behind the controls on phones. Before, this only worked when the Canvas came with its size already known, which wasn't often. Songs without a Canvas keep the classic artwork view. Under the seek bar you'll now see the format that is actually playing, such as AAC and its bitrate, or Dolby Atmos and Lossless when the stream really is one of those.

release.name: v0.30.0
release.notes:
### GeckoView 155.0

This release brings together eleven updates since the last stable version. It gives you more control over when links open in other apps, adds website notifications without needing Google, makes bookmarks and the home screen far more customizable, and improves how WebLibre connects through Tor and proxies.

## Highlights

- **App Links** — decide when links open in other apps, with rules per site and per container
- **Website Notifications** — get notified by websites via UnifiedPush, without Google's involvement
- **Bookmarks Rewritten** — large bookmark collections load fast, and imports run smoothly in the background
- **Redesigned Home Page** — customize your sections, add a wallpaper, and choose where the search bar sits
- **Clearer Connections** — see at a glance how each tab is connecting, with more reliable Tor/proxy startup
- **Bangs Overhaul** — pin your favorite search shortcuts and use them right from the address bar
- **Customizable Browser Menu** — reorder or hide the menu items you don't use
- **Settings Export & Import** — copy your settings to another device in a few taps
- **Engine Upgrade** — GeckoView 155.0 for better compatibility and security

## App Links (New)

The web is full of links that could open in another app — a YouTube link opening the YouTube app, for example. WebLibre now lets you decide what happens when a page tries to do that.

- **Three modes** under Settings > Browsing > Open Links in Apps: **Ask before opening** (default), **Always**, and **Never**.
- **Remember your choice for a site** — tap "Remember for this site" in a prompt, and revisit or undo any saved choices later from a "Remembered site rules" list.
- **Per-site override** in a site's settings: always open in app, always keep in browser, or follow your default.
- **Advanced: per-container rules** — containers with their own cookies can have their own App Links setting and remembered sites, separate from the rest of the app.

# YumaPlayer v1.2.0-RC.1

A massive milestone update representing over a month of intensive development and a complete architectural overhaul. This release introduces a dedicated low-level audio DSP engine, the YDS 2.1 design system with a draggable Telegram-spec navigation island, native Spotify browsing, Canvas loops, robust proxy networking, and deep performance optimizations.

---

### ✨ Major Highlights

#### 🎛️ Audio Engine & Smart Automix (`:core:audio-dsp`)
* **Dual-Deck Continuous Crossfade:** True gapless playback using two independent, synchronized audio deck controllers with atomic role swapping. Zero silence between tracks.
* **DJ Transition Intelligence:** Automated outro/intro cue detection, energy cliff analysis, BPM matching, and complementary bass-swap filters (0.45–0.55 window).
* **Audiophile Codec Pipeline:** Dedicated 24-bit packed PCM processing, Kopus-first Opus decoding with MediaCodec fallback, and native FLAC length resolution.
* **Stall Guard & Recovery:** Intelligent fallback to hard cuts during network drops, background stream revival upon reconnection, and strict source-scoped cache identities.
* **N+1 Prefetching:** Seamless background caching of upcoming tracks into the local download cache.

#### 🏝️ YDS 2.1 & Gesture Physics
* **Draggable Navigation Island:** Compact, draggable floating dock inspired by Telegram specifications, featuring dynamic corner morphing, scroll-hide sync, and local haptic feedback.
* **Unified Player Sheet V2:** Re-engineered gesture physics with GPU-accelerated backdrop blur (`Haze`), isolated drag layers, and independent artwork scaling.
* **Canvas Backdrop Engine:** Hardware-accelerated background video loops supporting up to 4K resolution, backed by an isolated cache to prevent ghosting during track changes.
* **Spoiler Veil:** Interactive Telegram-grade particle engine to obscure tokens and sensitive settings.
* **Particle Splash Screen:** Customizable startup burst physics with shap

release.name: Convx v1.5.2
release.notes:
## Convx 1.5.2

Bug-fix release. 40+ fixes across login, playback, downloads, local-only mode, the player, and theming.

### Login & accounts
- Fixed the HTTP 500 on login and every authenticated request — the session id was being sent in a form the API rejects.
- Login validation now actually retries on failure instead of silently getting stuck.
- Saved-account switcher no longer stays empty for existing sessions.
- Channel switching no longer silently reverts to your primary channel.

### Playback
- Fixed a bug where songs would fail to play — a missing field in the stream response was discarding an otherwise-working stream instead of using a sane default.
- One playback error could previously cancel unrelated in-flight operations app-wide; fixed.
- Fixed a crash on some devices (Android 16 / One UI) where the player's foreground notification could be refused by the OS and kill the service.
- Crossfade timing now stays correct when playback speed is changed.

### Downloads
- Fixed downloaded stream links expiring incorrectly, causing repeated failures.
- Auto-download-on-like now works from every screen (song menu, queue, swipe-like), not just the player's like button.

### Local-only mode
- Excluding a folder now actually keeps it excluded on refresh.
- Excluded-folders screen rebuilt: permission prompt, scan button, per-folder song counts, and a folder picker for folders MediaStore hasn't indexed yet.
- Local library screen gained a fast-scroll bar and auto-refreshes when opened.

### Player & UI
- Fixed the player's "more" button and queue button not responding reliably.
- Custom player icon settings now apply everywhere they should.
- Your chosen text color now applies consistently across Home, Library, Search, Settings, and the player — instead of some screens staying on the old accent color.
- Fixed hero backgrounds (artist/playlist pages) sometimes rendering solid black instead of a color.
- Artist name now wraps to two lines and displays with correct capit

Android 直接安装 APK 覆盖升级，设置和数据不会丢失。

## 本次更新

频道面板改为左右两栏：左边是栏目列表，右边是当前栏目下的频道

repo.description: App which allows you to use your health devices beyond subscriptions. Supports Workout Tracking, Nutrition Tracking, Wellness Excercise, Sleep, Recovery, Strain, and Many more.

release.name: v0.11.3
release.notes:
## What's new in the app

### New look
- Four tabs: Today, Sleep, Activity, Health.
- One name per score, and every trend tells you how today compares with your usual range.
- Heart-rate zones are labelled rows with their bpm ranges.
- Profile opens from your avatar on every tab. Detailed charts moved to an Advanced screen.

### Report an issue
- Settings > Report an issue: pick what went wrong, describe it, add a screenshot if you like.
- "Create ticket" packs app info, sync state and recent logs, encrypts them on your phone so only the maintainers can read them, and gives you a ticket ID (OS-XXXXXX) to quote on Discord or GitHub.
- Your health database is included only if you switch it on. "Share locally" builds the same file and lets you share it yourself; nothing is uploaded.
- You can delete a ticket any time from My reports. Reports are deleted automatically after 30 days (14 if they include your database).

### Scores
- Recovery is calibrated to your own normal range and combines HRV with resting heart rate.
- Every screen shows the same recovery number, and it's only locked in after a full night.
- When recovery isn't scored, the app tells you why.
- Nightly HRV is more accurate, and the HRV sent to Apple Health now matches what Apple Watch reports.
- Strain is measured against your own resting level.
- A day's strain is never lower than a workout on that day, and days with no detected sleep still get a strain.
- Naps and broken sleeps under 3 hours no longer push resting heart rate up.
- WHOOP 5: nightly skin temperature compared with your usual, in °C.

### Your data, more of it
- History from older WHOOP 4 firmware that was stored but never read now gets decoded, so some people get missing days back.
- New users see "Recovery starts in N nights" while their baseline builds, with resting HR, steps and sleep from night one.

### New
- Nutrition: search past foods, meal times, edit entries, today's protein.
- Heart rate: zoomable day chart and minute-by-minu

release.notes:
# fqapp 1.0.121

版本：1.0.121（126），仅支持 Android arm64。源码提交：11d762a。
APK SHA-256：`2db1a41f8696f7a8ccbdff1ad5857cc8c3e528b9841e36d1be0eb3fa62be552b`

自上个正式版 v1.0.96 以来的汇总（含 v1.0.105 / v1.0.106 预发布内容）。

## 致谢

感谢 @liuqianhe 贡献本项目的第一个外部 PR（[#55](https://github.com/ch6vip/fqapp/pull/55)）：墨水屏阅读优化（正文纯黑、海信 EPD 整屏刷新、滑动直翻、单手模式）与音量键翻页修复。

## 阅读

- 连续阅读：分页与滚动模式到章末自动进下一章（分页模式可在排版面板开关）。
- 点击书籍直接进入阅读：设置 → 阅读可开启，点书直接进上次位置。
- 阅读背景延伸到刘海 / 挖孔区域；翻页动画跨章节；阅读时隐藏系统栏。
- 滚动模式滑到章节顶部继续下拉，回到上一章末尾。
- 墨水屏模式：正文强制纯黑；海信设备每翻 N 页整屏刷新压残影（默认 10 页，排版面板可调，0=关闭）；新增滑动直翻（无过渡动画）、单手模式（点左三分之一也翻下一页）。
- 音量键翻页：后台 ↔ 前台切换后不再失效（改走原生拦截）。
- 阅读信息展示、相关系列导航、目录对比优化。

## 听书与音频

- 持续听书：听书会话独立于页面，底部可恢复 / 暂停 / 关闭；边读边听支持跟章。
- 系统 TTS：小说与本地书可用系统朗读；本地书听书跟随。
- 音频迷你条、听书跨页面状态修复。

## 播放

- 清晰度切换拉伸修复；解码器初始化失败回退；MT6895 / 天玑 8100 兼容渲染路径。
- 软件解码绿条修复（软解切 SurfaceTexture）。
- 短剧切画质转横屏不再往上全屏拉伸。
- 横屏双击：中间暂停 / 播放，左右 ±10 秒。
- 短剧里点进阅读 / 听书，视频暂停；返回后同一集继续播。
- 弹幕设置入口（短剧 feed 更多面板）；浅色面板弹幕开关即时刷新。

## 书架、导入与备份

- 本地 TXT / EPUB 导入；修复仅标题章节导致正文空白（需先删除旧书再重新导入）。
- 收藏与进度文件备份；备份 / 恢复导出为 JSON（不含本地文件本身与缓存、统计、高亮、偏好）。
- 日志查看器重做，App 与核心日志可合并导出。

## 搜索与排行

- 搜索按分类、评分筛选，无封面列表视图；评分筛选只作用于已加载结果。
- 排行页新增短剧榜 / 漫剧榜；短剧榜上不出现小说分类 chips。

## 去品牌化

The Command-line tools can be used to run qaul from the terminal. For example on an embedded computer without a screen such as a Raspberry Pi or on a Server in the internet.

**qaul-cli** is the interactive qaul CLI client for communicating over the qaul net via the terminal.

**qauld** is the qaul daemon to be run in the background and work as a _Community Node_ in the network.

**qauld-ctl** is the control client for the qauld daemon. It connects to a running daemon to inspect and configure it, from single commands, an interactive shell or a terminal UI.

release.notes:
KartPad 0.8.3 (build 265) supports Retro Rewind 6.13.3.

### Changed

- **Retro Rewind 6.13.3:** KartPad compiles the new Retro Rewind game code and downloads the official 6.13.3 pack. Retro WFC only accepts the current pack. Retro Rewind's own `version.txt` in this release still reads 6.13.2; KartPad expects that and checks the exact pinned game code, XML and download.
- **Android:** short touch taps are no longer lost when two parts of the game read the same press. The game window stays fullscreen when SDL tries to restore windowed mode after the system bars hide ([#202](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/202), still to be confirmed on an AYN Thor). The vertex repack does the same work with less CPU time ([#470](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/470); no FPS change is claimed). The runtime also carries a developer-only bone-index experiment for invisible characters; it isn't selectable in the app yet.
- **iPhone and iPad:** the game chooser shows **Update needed** for an older installed Retro Rewind pack instead of **Ready to play**; Set Up Game then updates it in the app.
- **Mac builds:** setup keeps using PadMint's own Python instead of switching to another Python on PATH ([#475](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/475)).
- **Runtime:** every platform gains the double-precision fused floating-point operations the new Retro Rewind code uses. Without them the game code could not be built.

### Updating

- **Android:** **Update available → Update Now**, or install the APK over your current KartPad. Then choose **Set Up Game** on the Retro Rewind card to download the 6.13.3 pack (about 1.9 GB; about 4.2 GB free space is needed while it installs). Saves, licenses and ghosts stay.
- **iPhone, iPad and Mac:** build 0.8.3 with the latest [PadMint](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/padmint/releases/latest) and install it over your current KartPad. Mac players reuse their imported game data; see the [Mac instructions](../INSTALL_

release.name: v0.31.0
release.notes:
Any model from Hugging Face, checked before the download. Compute backends as modules on every OS, and no table of architectures left in the engine.

## Highlights

**Any gguf from Hugging Face, in every UI.** Type a model's name or a repository: the server searches the site, lists the repository's gguf files, and before a byte is downloaded reads the model's header through a range request and says what it is (MoE or dense, how many experts, what stays resident) and whether it fits this machine's memory and disk. The catalog shrinks to the two reference models, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B. The logic lives in `bmoe-server`; the web UI and the app render its answer.

**Compute backends as modules, on every OS.** Each release carries the engine and, beside it, one module per backend and one CPU module per instruction-set tier, loaded at start-up only where their driver exists. The APK carries Hexagon, Vulkan and OpenCL; the Linux and Windows archives carry Vulkan; macOS carries Metal. The same archive serves a machine with a GPU and one without, and the planner probes whichever devices registered, each in a process of its own.

**No table of architectures.** Which tensors are a model's routed experts is read from the file, so a new MoE architecture streams without an engine change. `RunConfig` holds only tunables, every bound is a named constant, and the UIs read the server's facts instead of naming parameters.

**iOS rides with every release** as a harness app for the simulator.

**llama.cpp moves to upstream master of 2026-10-18**, still a submodule plus one commit.

Hardened along the way: the server against malformed requests, the release workflows against injected text, the app's conversations against other apps on the phone, direct reads aligned to the filesystem's own block size.

> **Android Common vs Full:** Common uses Android's system folder picker and copies selected dictionaries/audio into app-private storage, so it does not require broad storage access. release.name: Yuzic 2.17.0
release.notes:
### **Version 2.17.0**

TestFlight build **138** · Play version code **159**

#### Buttons that work both ways
- **A headphone or car button unpauses again.** Pressing an AirPod stem paused the music and then did nothing at all — every press after it was read as another pause. Yuzic asked the system which state it was in, and that is a question the system is not obliged to answer truthfully; it goes by what it last said itself now

#### Crossfade
- **Album segues stay hard-cut.** With crossfade on, a record mastered to run straight from one track into the next was faded through its own join — the overlap doubled, and the seam it was covering sounded worse than it does bare. Turning "Fade through segues" off has always promised this and never delivered it: the engine implemented it and waited on a flag the app never set
- **A crossfaded track counts as fully listened to.** The fade-out is time you can still hear the song, and it was not being counted, so tracks at the boundary quietly fell short of the scrobble threshold. Measured at four seconds lost on an eight-second crossfade, on both platforms

#### Settings that only offer what your server can do
- **Loudness normalisation appears where your server measures loudness.** It was offered to everyone while only Navidrome reports the figure it needs — on Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and local files the switch corrected against nothing
- **Streaming quality appears where the stream obeys it.** Plex plays the file it is pointed at and takes no quality request, and a local file has nothing to transcode, so on both of them setting cellular quality to Low still pulled the original

#### Your library
- **Jellyfin and Emby: an artist's top songs,** ranked by what you have played. The section was built for it and only ever appeared on Subsonic servers; the adapter contract had promised the fallback since it was written
- **Playlists are found when search asks your server.** Switching Search from this device to your server quietly dr

repo.description: 💽 Fast SQLite library for React Native built using Nitro Modules

release.name: NitroSQLite 10.2.0
release.notes:
NitroSQLite 10.2.0 improves repeated queries, async result delivery, and Android writes. It also adds runtime error constants and an errors-only entry point for shared code and Node.js tests. This minor release includes compatibility changes to SQL validation and query result objects, so review the upgrade notes before rebuilding your app.

## Performance improvements

Each connection now caches its 32 most recently used query and data-change statements. Repeated calls to `execute()` and `executeAsync()` can reuse compiled SQL when the query text stays the same. Bind values as parameters to benefit from this cache. Statements such as `PRAGMA`, `ATTACH`, and transaction commands still compile on every call. See the [performance guide](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/guides/performance).

Async queries, batches, and file imports now run on a dedicated worker thread per connection. Large managed async queries convert rows to JavaScript in batches while SQLite reads the remaining rows. The promise still resolves once with every row in order; paginate large queries to limit the final result size.

Android builds now use `fdatasync()` and enable batch atomic writes on supported F2FS filesystems. These changes reduce commit I/O without lowering `PRAGMA synchronous`. SQLite falls back to its rollback journal when atomic writes are unavailable. See the [Android configuration guide](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/configuration/android) for details and build-time opt-outs. [#440](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-nitro-sqlite/pull/440)

## Breaking changes and migration

### One SQL statement per query

SQL strings containing more than one statement now throw or reject instead of running the first statement and silently ignoring the rest. This affects `execute()`, `executeAsync()`, `prepare()`, each batch command, and each nonempty SQL-file line. Trailing whitespace, comments, and extra semicolons remain allowed. [#439](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-nitro-sqli

release.notes:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.3 and X360 Companion 0.1.0

X360 Mobile 0.6.3 introduces local wireless multiplayer through the new X360
Companion application, alongside Android Home shortcuts, a clearer driver
catalog and a unified touch-control system.

## X360 Companion 0.1.0

- Added X360 Companion, a separate Android application that turns a phone on
  the same local network or a paired Bluetooth device into a remote XInput
  controller.
- Up to three companions can be assigned independently to P2, P3 or P4. P1
  remains protected from remote assignment unless the host explicitly enables
  remote-only play.
- Added user-confirmed pairing, trusted-host management, connection recovery,
  per-player rumble and GamerProfile selection on the host.
- Added a shared, localized touch-control editor with compatible TOML
  import/export, presets, Xbox player indicator and controller artwork.
- LAN gameplay was validated between Odin3 and Honor through Gears of War 2.
  Bluetooth remains experimental and device-dependent.

## Library, shortcuts and input

- Added per-game Android Home shortcuts. A shortcut uses a title image embedded
  in supported game content when available, opens the direct-game loading
  screen, applies the game's saved settings and returns to the launcher when
  the game exits.
- Unified the host and Companion touch artwork, layout model and edge-aware
  factory placement. Standard layouts now preserve intended controls that
  extend partially beyond a screen edge on every supported aspect ratio.
- Expanded the integrated driver catalog with release descriptions so users can
  review maintainer compatibility notes before downloading a driver.

## Packages

- **X360 Mobile:** `emu.x360mobile.com`, version `0.6.3` (`versionCode 6039000`),
  asset `x360-mobile-0.6.3.apk`.
- **X360 Companion:** `emu.x360mobile.controller`, version `0.1.0`
  (`versionCode 11002`), asset `x360-companion-0.1.0.apk`.

Both APKs are signed with the established X360 Mobile Release identity.

It strips Google tracking, telemetry, and AI integration while keeping browser extensions and uBlock Origin. It adds background video playback, saving media from sites that normally block it, your choice of download manager, and more.

release.name: Bare 1.0.0
release.notes:
# Bare 1.0.0

The first stable release. Bare moves from Chromium 153.0.8010.27 to **156.0.8078.25**, picking up
upstream's security fixes, and the series is now 160 patches. There are no more alpha or beta
releases; updates from here are stable ones.

Bare is Chromium with the Google parts taken out, kept as a patch series rather than a fork so
every change stays readable.

## Which APK should I download?

- `Bare-1.0.0-arm64-v8a.apk` is for most Android phones from the last several years. If you are
  unsure, take this one.
- `Bare-1.0.0-armeabi-v7a.apk` is for 32-bit ARM devices only. It is not lighter or better on a
  64-bit phone.

## What’s new since 1.0.0-alpha.3

- **Chromium 156.** Bare is now built on Chromium 156.
- **uBlock Origin 1.75.0.** Bare includes the version published by uBlock Origin’s author. If you already use uBlock Origin, Bare moves your settings to the new copy during the update. If you removed it, Bare won’t reinstall it. We also fixed cases where Android could stop filtering until Bare restarted.
- **Extensions are easier to manage on a phone.** The Extensions page fits phone screens. You can load an unpacked extension or a downloaded CRX, check for updates, and allow individual extensions in Incognito directly from their cards. You no longer need to turn on Developer mode first.
- **A new welcome flow.** Choose your search engine, ad blocker, address bar position, download behavior, background audio, notifications, default browser, and update settings. After an update, the welcome shows your existing choices so you can review what’s new.
- **Developer tools on phones.** Open them from the menu, along with View page source and Inspect. The tools still have small controls on a phone screen.
- **A cleaner Google new tab page.** Google search still works, without the broken Discover card, doodle request, or theme promotion.
- **Privacy and reliability fixes.** We removed several unnecessary requests to Google, including the DNS lookup trigge

release.name: v5.1.3
release.notes:
## What's changed

### Fixes

- No more Reanimated 4.6 `dependencies should only be used in web implementation` warnings: hook dependency arrays are now passed on web only, where older Reanimated versions still need them.
- `ImageBackground` (deprecated in React Native 0.87) replaced with a `View` and an absolutely positioned `Image` in Panel2, Panel3, HueCircular and Preview.
- Input widgets no longer read shared values during render (Reanimated strict-mode warning) and no longer remount their inputs on every render.
- `ColorPickerRef.setColor` accepts every supported color format, not only strings.
- Panel2 and OpacitySlider animated styles declare the right dependencies.
- ExtraThumb worklets always call the latest `onChange` / `onComplete` callbacks, and negative hue transforms wrap around 360.
- Web keyboard handlers use the latest callbacks.
- LuminanceCircular normalizes the gesture angle after `rotate` is applied.
- Preview formats its initial color from the `value` prop.
- Panel2 accessibility label, and percentage spin scaling by hue.
- colorKit: decimal percentages are kept when parsing color strings; negative `spin` wraps below 0; manipulation methods are covered by tests.
- Deprecated `addWhitelistedNativeProps` call is guarded (no-op on Reanimated 4, still needed on Reanimated 3).

### Examples and docs

- ExampleLatest upgraded to React Native 0.87.1, ExampleExpoLatest to Expo SDK 57, ExampleOldArch builds with Xcode 26.
- The React Native examples run in the browser on the documentation site, and the docs are also published as markdown for LLMs.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alabsi91/reanimated-color-picker/compare/v5.1.2...v5.1.3

Suit-matched morph balls, the full Flaahgra theme, a beam-stacking option, much lower memory use on Android, and fixes for savestates, PAL menus and doors.

**You need your own disc image:** Metroid Prime USA (`GM8E01`, revisions 1.00, 1.01 and 1.02) or the experimental PAL release (`GM8P01`). No disc image or game assets are included.

### Remastered visuals
- Remastered particle effects now evaluate their spawn tables, random values, movers, selectors, cones, rotations, swooshes and blend modes as the Switch game does, instead of approximating them. - The Power Beam's charged-release flash faces forward, and with rapid charge a Power shot releases at the same moment as in Prime.
- "Full import (no reuse)" next to the Remastered Import button converts everything again instead of reusing the previous import.
- The Remastered effects are re-imported once on the first start.

### Gameplay
- Gravity and Phazon Suit morph balls, and a Power Suit spider ball, are generated from your disc, so the ball matches the suit instead of reusing the Power or Gravity look. (Useful for randomizer)
- New setting "Stack beams" (`stack_beams`, off by default): every shot also fires the projectiles of every other beam you own, at the slowest owned beam's rate.
- Full Flaahgra theme: the USA discs cut it to 36 seconds. Pick a PAL, JP or Trilogy disc you own (F1 > Settings > Audio), or run the PAL language import, and the whole 114-second track plays.
- Increaseed max FOV to 120.
- Archipelago: after dying, most pickups you already checked don't respawn.
- Remastered movement: an L-strafe jump into a steep slope no longer hovers on or climbs the face.

### Controls
- Gyro (#118): Recalibrate counts down 5 seconds so you can put the pad down; auto-calibrate can be Off, Always or Only in menus; a new bindable "Reset

repo.description: Control your Pi coding agent from your phone. Pair with a one-time QR code and chat with your local agent, even when you're away from your computer.

release.name: Remote Pi Cockpit 2.1.15
release.notes:
**Four agent skills instead of one, installed on every machine (including
remote hosts), and a design kit for `.panel` dashboards.** Pair with
cockpit-server 2.1.15 so hosts get the skills too.
### Added
- **Skills split by purpose**: `cockpit-cli` (tabs, tasks, exec),
  `cockpit-db` (SQL, Redis, Mongo, connections), `cockpit-telemetry` (the
  error store) and `cockpit-design` (files the human reads: `.panel`, `.html`,
  `.kanban`, `.notebook`, `.ckp`, `.http`, `.dbq`). Each is short, with
  references read on demand, so the right one triggers for the right task.
- **Skills everywhere**: `cockpit install-skill` installs all four into every
  harness found on the machine (Claude Code, Codex, Pi), keeps a manifest per
  skill (updates and removals are exact, your own files are left alone), and
  the remote `cockpit-server` installs them on the host at boot.
- **`cockpit panel new --template dashboard|list-detail|form <file>`**:
  scaffolds a working `.panel` from a bundled template and opens it.
- **`cockpit panel screenshot [<tab|file>] [--out x.png]`**: a PNG of an open
  `.panel`, so an agent can look at what it built and iterate.
- **`cockpit.css` page anatomy**: `.page`, `.toolbar`, `.kpis`, `.split`,
  `.empty`, `.skeleton`, `.status-dot`, `.kv`, responsive in narrow panes.
  The Gallery's "panel" template is now a real dashboard.

---

Sparkle/WinSparkle). Se o passo de publish falhar, o fallback manual

release.name: Hermes Android v2.1.30
release.notes:
## Keyboard and composer fixes

- **Return adds a new line.** The keyboard no longer replaces Enter/Return with Send. Use the on-screen Send button when your message is ready.
- **Keep typing after Send.** The text box stays editable while Hermes prepares the request, uploads attachments, replies or reconnects. Delayed setup and reply callbacks do not clear a follow-up draft.
- **Protect newer drafts.** A definite send failure restores the original prompt only if you have not edited the cleared composer. Newer text and deliberately cleared drafts stay untouched.
- **Keep an unsent prompt when leaving during setup.** If no newer draft was entered, reopening the chat restores the prompt that never reached submission.
- Rapid Send callbacks cannot submit the same captured draft twice. Existing Send, attachment and recovery safety gates remain in place.

This update enables drafting during a running turn. It does not add the separate mid-turn Steer feature, which is not present in the current stable code.

See [PR #163](https://github.com/rusty4444/hermes-android/pull/163) and the [changelog](https://github.com/rusty4444/hermes-android/blob/v2.1.30/CHANGELOG.md).

## Validation

- Static analysis: no issues. Full suite: 1,488 tests passed, none skipped.
- Independent specification and quality reviews passed, including controlled disposal, delayed upload and rejection races.
