- **مسیریابی هوشمند ایران:** یک کلید در تنظیمات › شبکه؛ سایت‌ها و برنامه‌های ایرانی (بانک‌ها، اسنپ، دیوار، بله…) روی همهٔ موتورها مستقیم و بدون VPN
- **دامین‌فرانتینگ دوباره وصل می‌شود:** بررسی اتصال گواهی فرانتینگ گوشی را نمی‌شناخت و هر اتصال را رد می‌کرد؛ روی خطی که کانفیگ‌های ایران هیچ سایتی باز نمی‌کنند، یوتیوب، گوگل، اینستاگرام و ردیت را باز کرد
- **وینداسکرایب در ایران، با همهٔ پروتکل‌ها:** وایرگارد، OpenVPN TCP و UDP، Stealth و WStunnel از راه وارپ کلادفلر وصل می‌شوند؛ دکمهٔ «تست همهٔ سرورها با همهٔ پروتکل‌ها» بهترین ترکیب را با سنجش واقعی نشان می‌دهد
- **رفع همهٔ کرش‌ها و هنگ‌های گزارش‌شده:** کمبود حافظه با فهرست‌های بزرگ کانفیگ، هنگ موقع باز شدن و صفحهٔ خانه، و کرش‌های چند بخش؛ همهٔ ایشوهای کرش بسته شدند.

Red Earth. Until now these were stuck in Lockstep, which is the worst place for
a fighting game to be.

The problem was size. To rewind, rollback keeps dozens of snapshots of the
machine in memory, and a CPS-3 snapshot was enormous — it carried the entire
game loaded from the CD, tens of megabytes of code, graphics and samples that
never change while you play. Snapshots now leave all of that behind and keep
only what the game actually writes to. What used to be far past any sane limit
now fits with room to spare.

Games that already fit benefit too: smaller snapshots mean less memory and less
work on every correction.

## More games run in rollback

The host now hands its machine state to the joiner by default, so games that
used to refuse rollback because both sides could not be trusted to boot
identically now qualify.

## Sessions that used to break

**Joining and resyncing.** A drop-in join or a mid-game resync would sometimes
leave one machine frozen, or the joiner on a black screen, with nothing to do
but disconnect. The snapshot was being taken wherever the emulation happened to
be at that instant, sometimes in the middle of a frame with work still pending.
It is now always taken at the end of a frame, once the video chip has finished
and the interrupt queue is drained. The state that arrives is one the other
machine can actually resume from.

**Brief network drops.** Lose enough packets in a row and one frame would stay
a guess forever: the game kept running, quietly wrong, and the two sides drifted
apart over the next minutes. Th

7) click on Application Mode and set to "Developer". Also go to the bottom of the developers settings and make sure "Unknown Sources" is checked.
8) click back, and then go to the three dot menu. Click "Start head unit server".
9) connect the phone to the computer, enable "USB debugging" in your phone's developer settings. This is different from Android auto developer settings.
10) open a command shell
11) type "adb forward tcp:5277 tcp:5277"
12) navigate to <sdk>/extras/google/auto. This is usually found at "c:\users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\extras\google\auto"
13) start the desktop head unit with the command "desktop-head-unit"
14) accept all the permissions, etc.

At this time you should see the typical head unit display that you would see in your car.

15) click on the lower right speedometer symbol (to return to Sync, or other OS).

you should see 'Carstream' listed. If it is not, click on "All car apps".

16) Click on Carstream. Your phone should prompt you to grant root access. Accept root access.
17) Stop the Desktop head unit (click the x on the top right).
18) go to your car. Turn on your car and connect your phone to start Android Auto. Accept all the permissions requests, etc.
19) Turn off your car. Disconnect your phone from Android Auto. 
20) Now, go to your apps, and start Carstream

- **Version:** `1.190`
- **VersionCode:** `190`

- Release: `f995e2f1418314812552b0eeaf418997619c620938303ac01f0fe799c03bf3c3`
- Debug: `00c106f5e0fe189d3f452fa3e4f422f9f8507faf9ba705b8f8f8fca1bdc0319c`
- Zygisk release: `f995e2f1418314812552b0eeaf418997619c620938303ac01f0fe799c03bf3c3`

## Message

```text
fix(native): Bound FUSE invalidations and drain session teardown Meow

这次把 FuseHide 的 FUSE 缓存失效调度收紧了喵。原来根目录 entry、指定 entry 和 inode 失效会按请求创建 detached 线程，大量目录项同时被过滤时容易堆积线程；线程还会持有原始 fuse_session 指针，MediaProvider 销毁 session 后存在继续访问旧指针的风险喵（尾巴警觉地竖了起来）

Native 这边改为进程内共享的单 worker 和有界任务队列，保留原来的 entry 25 ms、根目录 entry 和 inode 50 ms 延迟，并对排队中的同类目标去重。队列最多容纳 4096 个任务，超出时限制警告日志频率并拒绝继续入队，避免高负载下无上限地消耗线程与内存喵（一个一个来，不许偷偷分身）

生命周期方面新增 fuse_session_destroy 的 ELF 导入槽 Hook，兼容文件映射与 APK 内嵌 ELF 的安装路径。销毁前先阻止新任务、清空待执行队列，再等待正在执行的通知退出；新 session 被识别时更新代际并清理旧的跟踪状态。未能安装销毁 Hook 时不安排异步通知，避免继续使用无法保证生命周期的 session 指针喵（认真守住销毁顺序）

```

Big update.  Below are slightly technical bullet points if you don't want to read this entire text. Reworked the cloud sync to prevent save files being overwritten with a new save. Now it uses progress-based checks instead of timestamp-based checks if auto-sync is on. Also added manual push/pull from cloud if you want to leave the auto sync off. 

Automatic save backups can now be turned on for both cloud and local saves, and are stored in an external folder (storage/emulated/0/StS2Launcher/Saves/). This does require external storage permissions but it is NOT necessary if you don't care about save backups. If you do want to enable save backups, tap on one of the push/pull buttons and it will ask you for read/write permissions.

Mod compatibility is also included in this release. Currently only works for v0.98.x of the game. StS2 v0.99.x removes the requirement of a .pck file so it may be necessary to update this again when v0.99.0 drops publicly. If you'd like to test out mods, place them in the storage/emulated/0/StS2Launcher/Mods/ folder that gets created after enabling storage permissions indicated above.

The Steam session has been reworked. Instead of a persistent connection at launch, it now uses an on-demand connection in case the user backgrounds the app or the network drops. Validation of game ownership has been changed from every 30 days to now only required once at first download. I removed the requirement for every 30 days since it seemed a bit excessive - I was trying to prevent people from buying the game and refunding it within 2 hours. release.notes:
**Please note:** this release changes how the game draws nearly everything, and it has had only limited testing: one phone and automated checks. It may run slower, or look wrong, on a computer, phone or Mac it has not been tried on. If it does, keep the previous version and send the game's log file with a short description of what you saw. The log says what the game chose for your device.

## New

- The log now lists, every 10 seconds, how many drawing steps the game takes for each picture, which steps take the graphics card longest, and what kind of graphics card the game found (named in the first lines). If the game is slow, send the log with your report.
- On Android phones and handhelds and on Apple Silicon Macs, the fog, some see-through effects and the glow blur are drawn in fewer steps, with the same picture.
- The 3D scenery, the shadows and the glow are drawn in fewer steps that give the same picture; the game's log says which steps each device takes.

## Fixed

- Blending between see-through things and what is behind them now uses the graphics card's own mixing on every computer, phone and Mac, as the game did up to v0.5.2. A few mixed colours can come out one shade lighter than on the PlayStation 2, which the eye cannot tell apart. The more exact mixing of v0.6.0 to v0.7.9 took many more drawing steps on some cards and is now a developer switch. On cards that used it, the game also has fewer graphics programs to prepare at the first start.
- With the Original picture, textures that have several detail levels are now filtered by the graphics card instead of by a hand-written filter. The picture is the same to the eye; at the edges of cut-out textures such as leaves and grilles a single pixel can differ from the PlayStation 2.
- On computers, the 3D scenery is drawn by a leaner method that gives the same picture; a driver that cannot handle it is noticed at start and the old way is taken. Phones and handhelds draw it as before.

### Windows
#### MSIX

1. Download **destiny_windows.msix**

#### ZIP

1. Download **destiny_windows.zip**
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `destiny.exe`
**Note**: might require additional libraries


### macOS (M1 or Intel chip based)

1. Download **destiny_macos.dmg**
2. Open downloaded DMG file
3. Drag and drop Destiny icon in Applications folder

#### AppImage

1. Download **destiny_linux_amd64.AppImage**
2. Run chmod u+x `destiny_linux_amd64.AppImage && ./destiny_linux_amd64.AppImage`
**Note**: If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```
     ./destiny_linux_amd64.AppImage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/AppRun
    ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **destiny_linux_amd64.tar.gz**
2. Extract`tar xzvf destiny_linux_amd64.tar.gz`
4. Go inside directory `destiny_linux`
5. Run `./destiny`

> [!WARNING]
> armeabi-v7a is not supported in this release. Support is planned for the next release.

> [!NOTE]
> ACSIDE (ACS Lite) now uses Termux Packages for the terminal backend and no longer uses PRoot by default. PRoot is not completely removed and can still be installed via PRoot-Distro.
>
> This change was made because Android's Bionic performs significantly faster than PRoot's glibc layer, without the overhead PRoot introduces. Performance after migrating to Termux Packages has been noticeably better.

## Highlights

- **Windows 11 Fluent 2 Look** – New optional visual style with smooth animations, transitions, and press feedback. Enable it in General Settings.
- **XML Layout Real Preview** – See your layouts rendered directly in the IDE, as a static image or a short video, without leaving the editor.
- **Compose Preview** – See your Compose previews directly inside the IDE, with adjustable size and density.
- **Guided Git Workflow** – Step-by-step repository onboarding, remote setup guidance, merge conflict resolution controls, and a redesigned Source Control drawer.
- **MCP Assistant Enhancements** – Edit approval mode with a diff review screen, plus "Ask AI" integration to diagnose Git errors and resolve merge conflicts.
- **Dependency Updater** – Get notified about outdated dependencies right in your build files. Long-press a notice to update all outdated dependencies at once.

---

## Editor

**Added**
- Format Java code from the editor quick actions menu
- Visible password flag toggle in Editor settings to enable soft keyboard word suggestions
- Search results can now locate the matched file in the file tree
- Unsaved changes confirmation dialog when closing single or all tabs
- Syntax highlighting for TOML and Java properties files

**Improved**
- Detects files modified by external tools (e.g., Termux, Git) and prompts to reload or keep your edits
- Open tabs reload automatically when the MCP assista

release.notes:
Better Endfield Next **4.0.8** 与 BEM Tools **1.6.1**，修复 1.6.0 冻结包无法导入 `bem_v15` 导致 CLI 校验与打包失败的问题，补齐 BEM 1.5 回归覆盖，并改进安装升级清理。

## Windows 4.0.8 & Android 4.0.8

- **安装升级清理**：升级时清理旧的 `tools/BemConverter/_internal` 运行时目录，避免旧 Python、DLL 与 GUI 文件残留。
- **Android 4.0.8（40008）**：沿用现有安装身份与发布签名，本次不涉及桌面语音模块调整。

## BEM Tools 1.6.1

- **冻结包修复**：清除 `bem_v15.py` 中的裸 NUL 字节，恢复模块导入；为 PyInstaller 补齐 `bem_v15` hidden import。

repo.description: 逆向复活锤子天气，使用现代 Android 技术栈重写，并更换天气数据源

release.name: v0.3.0
release.notes:
## 现代化重写

本版本使用 *GPT-6 Astra* 完成了锤子天气 UI 从 XML / Kotlin View 到 Jetpack Compose 的全量迁移与现代化重写。迁移覆盖主天气、城市搜索、城市管理、天气预警、首次说明、应用内弹窗和桌面小组件配置页。

Compose 使用声明式 Kotlin API 描述界面，减少了 XML 布局与 View 控件之间的样板衔接，让 UI 状态管理、组件复用和后续交互迭代更加直接。

迁移过程中保留原版视觉资源与核心交互，并完善了定位权限、定位刷新及现代 Android 系统适配。

## 主要更新

### Jetpack Compose

- 全部应用页面使用 Compose 重新实现，保留多 Activity 页面结构。
- 使用 Compose Foundation、Canvas 和自定义 Smartisan 组件呈现标题栏、天气卡片、列表、弹窗及温度动画。
- 保留原版 PNG、NinePatch、按压反馈和日夜资源。
- 移除旧页面布局 XML、View 控件、Adapter 及冗余映射代码，清理 312 个未使用资源。

### 功能与交互

- 保留城市滑动切换、边界阻尼、温度滚动、摄氏／华氏切换及天气背景过渡。
- 保留城市拖拽排序、浮层阴影、边缘滚动、取消恢复和确认保存。
- 保留城市搜索的弹性滚动、回弹和按压反馈。
- 修复统一弹窗在 Compose 迁移后圆角裁剪不一致的问题。
- 修复深色天气卡片底部黑边。

### 定位与刷新

- 修复无法申请精确定位权限的问题，同时支持大致位置授权。
- 完善定位权限说明、精度提升和系统定位服务提示。
- 优化多定位来源的并发获取与结果筛选，减少过期位置对刷新结果的影响。
- 修复重新定位到同一城市时天气未及时刷新的问题。
- 完善返回前台后的定位更新，以及定位失败时的天气刷新处理。

### 系统与工程

- 统一系统导航栏沉浸显示，完善系统栏、刘海与输入法避让。
- 大窗口下背景铺满窗口，天气内容保持最大 480dp 居中显示。
- 使用生命周期感知的状态收集与协程任务管理，完善后台取消和前台恢复。
- 更新 Android 构建工具链与 Compose 依赖。

完整变更：https://github.com/Mangi-11/SmartisanWeather-Revived/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0

### 歌词

- 立体歌词与边缘虚化改用单一图层的原生图像滤镜，移除递归录制歌词内容的多层渲染链，修复图层树递归导致的 RenderThread 栈溢出风险。
- 多选列表支持长按后连续拖选，覆盖歌曲、专辑、艺术家、分类、歌单、文件夹歌单、搜索和最近播放；支持边缘自动滚动与回拉收缩范围，保留此前选择与排序把手。
- 多选界面、歌词分享、备份类型和模块排序等选择面板增加反选；仅反转当前可选范围，保留其他范围的选择及数量上限。
- 绘光主歌词唱完后保持正常排版，装饰词片沿光场缓慢漂移并在有限时间内淡出，避免长期散落堆积在一侧。
- #716：恢复原有底栏交互，页面左右滑动完成后及时同步气泡位置，不再触发模拟按压放大；底栏拖动仍在松手后切换页面。
- 平板首页默认显示 8 个快捷按钮，功能块排除快捷区已有项目；保留手动配置。海报卡片修正标题分隔符，左右切歌复用已加载封面并避免旧播放状态覆盖新卡片。
- 艺术家传记增加名称匹配替换规则，可单独开关并指定数据源；按别名、原名、繁转简名称依次匹配，接入备份恢复。
- 液态底栏从 Miuix 0.9.4 的 Apache-2.0 示例重新适配，替换旧 GPL 动画与手势文件，保留外观设置与电视交互；增加来源与许可证检查。

- 海报墙点击封面只展开卡片，暂停时滑动切歌仍保持暂停；隐藏底部迷你播放条。堆叠布局缓存几何数据，弹窗与滑动使用稳定布局的图层动画，降低重复排版和解码开销。
- 凝彩、绘光、回环和商籁补齐逐字羽化扫光；凝彩黑白字按实际背景区域反转，回环保留英文词间空格，商籁保持歌词正常阅读角度，时计相邻歌词支持换行。
- 自定义分类条目使用卡片，删除按钮与箭头垂直对齐。
- SMB、WebDAV、FTP / FTPS 和 SFTP 音乐库扫描只建立目录索引，按需读取当前歌曲元数据；SMB / FTP / SFTP 播放流增加 256 KiB 有界缓冲以减少小块读取的网络往返，WebDAV 移除目录预取并沿用 HTTP 流缓冲，清理旧的大量元数据缓存。

- 歌词页补回立体歌词开关，并与播放页歌词显示菜单共用实时设置；角度也同步。补齐 AM 普通、沉浸、横屏和独立歌词页的立体效果；顶部信息区与底部控制区的边缘虚化固定在视口，立体旋转后仍有柔和过渡。

- 首页在线音乐移除 WebDAV；音乐来源只显示当前来源设置。频谱查看新增每次询问，内置频谱可调用其他应用。
- 海报墙堆叠保留适当间隙并错落排列；下层封面长按松手可置顶，拖动可在同组任意层插入或换组，每组最多 10 张并保存层序。播放保留原完整弹窗，后方叠放相邻弹窗，左右滑动切歌，移除上一曲和下一曲按钮。
- 对照 Folia 重做凝彩的大色块逐字拼贴、绘光的光场与飘散径迹、回环的倾斜椭圆字素环；新增商籁的大小字穿插与几何线稿。保留全局字体和独立歌词配色。
- 全局搜索返回进入前的底栏页面，悬浮底栏的返回图标与目标一致；远程曲库搜索、音质和红心筛选合并后台标签更新，保留完成结果，避免筛选进度反复重置。

- 修复 TTML 重叠演唱和逐字 LRC/ELRC 的多行高亮；拉长音文字与发光同步逐字羽化，限制旧播放采样停滞时的时钟提前。
- Beautiful Lyrics 背景支持非当前行歌词模糊，补齐设置与音频信息页面的应用字体。
- 歌词分享新增旧版 1.2.7、Spotify、杂志、电影感、拍立得、书法等样式；旧版补齐圆角，网易云样式支持 Halcyon 或自定义署名。

- 彩虹色歌词改为整句渐变：当前高亮行共用一条七彩光谱，每个字只取自己所在位置的色段，逐字不再各自循环一遍彩虹，长时间观看不再晃眼睛。

### 音乐库与扫描

- 空曲库可以下拉刷新，修正空状态说明；音质筛选使用底部面板并实际应用到曲库。
- 曲库分析与音质筛选复用缓存，减少重复构建；双指缩放进入详

release.name: HyperChanger v1.2.0
release.notes:
# HyperChanger v1.2.0

**HyperChanger 1.2.0 正式版发布！**

这是一个面向小米 HyperOS 4（Android 17）系统的 LSPosed 自定义模块。本版本在 1.1.3 的锁屏歌词、通知限制和应用内更新基础上，全面扩展 iOS 风格通知与控制中心、锁屏胶囊、应用导航和 Rust 桌面原生 Dock，并完善首次使用引导、关于页和多项系统兼容性处理。

**新增**

* `Feature` 新增 iOS 风格通知中心，可使用圆角壁纸面板、锁屏时钟与景深效果，调整通知底部偏移，并配置隐藏清除按钮的功能。
* `Feature` 新增控制中心大时钟、日期间距、运营商文本、网络标识和顶部区域高度调节，补充控制中心快捷按钮、图标和通知颜色适配。
* `Feature` 新增 Rust 桌面原生 Dock，支持纯色、高级材质、柔光玻璃、入场动画、高度、边距、圆角、颜色、透明度和模糊调节，并优化文件夹间距与最近任务布局。
* `Feature` 新增应用底部导航 Hook，支持 HarmonyOS 风格导航以及 Apple Music、微博、小红书、瑞幸咖啡等应用的导航样式、标签和颜色自定义。
* `Feature` 新增背屏 AI 功能解锁和自定义背屏应用导入，扩展背屏音乐控制与主题壁纸相关设置。
* `Feature` 新增首次使用引导、增强版关于页、用户协议、免责声明、隐私政策和开源项目声明页面。

**变更与优化**

* `Optimize` 优化通知中心、控制中心和锁屏媒体的玻璃材质、背景、动画、壁纸取色及视图层级处理，提升动态位置和系统重建后的表现。
* `UI/UX` 扩展锁屏编辑页背景、手势提示条、锁屏时间尺寸、迷你窗口提示条及锁屏组合限制等设置，并增加更多动画与交互反馈。
* `Optimize` 重构 System UI、导航栏、锁屏胶囊、通知中心和桌面 Dock 的 Hook 发现、延迟安装、异常保护与配置恢复流程，适配不同 HyperOS 构建和 ClassLoader 结构。
* `Optimize` 引入桌面原生补丁与 ARM64 Hook 支持，完善 Dock、文件夹布局和桌面材质配置的传输与迁移。
* `Optimize` 完善应用内更新下载安装、Root 静默安装回退、作用域重启提示和系统环境检测；更新 CI 与本地构建配置以使用 JDK 21。

**修复与重构**

* `Fix` 修复通知中心、控制中心和玻璃材质在视图重建、动态壁纸、媒体通知及不同系统版本下的显示错位、重复安装和状态残留问题。
* `Fix` 修复锁屏胶囊、锁屏组合、动画、编辑页背景、媒体播放器和通知避让在状态切换或重建后的布局与恢复问题。
* `Refactor` 拆分通知中心、锁屏胶囊、桌面原生 Dock、导航栏和背屏功能模块，统一设置同步、作用域处理和多版本反射保护，降低系统界面崩溃风险。

---

## 问题反馈须知

欢迎提交 Bug 和改进建议。涉及应用崩溃、异常报错、白屏或功能失效时，请附上完整的 **Logcat 日志**、设备型号、Android/HyperOS 版本、启用的作用域和复现步骤。

> 🚨 **NO LOG, NO FIX.**
>
> 无日志、无复现步骤且只有一句描述的 Issue 将不予受理并直接关闭。

感谢每一位参与测试和反馈的用户，让 HyperChanger 变得更好！

release.name: v1.6.9
release.notes:
# Release v1.6.9

> 数据安全版本：未编辑的「打开 → 保存」不再改动文件；修复 frontmatter、图片路径/标题、列表与结尾换行的 round-trip 损坏；代码块改为按需挂载，冷启动创建耗时 1058→281ms。

## 更新日志 2026-10-22

### 🛡️ 文件安全与 round-trip

- **打开再保存不再改写文件**：未做任何编辑时，保存直接跳过写盘，换行与序列化规范化都不会落到用户文件；round-trip 判据 41/41 逐字节一致。编辑过的块仍只做语义等价的规范化（不改变渲染），未触及内容由增量合并保留。
- **Frontmatter 原样保留**：修复首篇文档在编辑器创建前走 `ensureEditor`、绕过 frontmatter 拆分的问题——此前 YAML 头会被当成分隔线和正文渲染，保存后写成 `***` + 列表。
- **图片行不再被写坏**：相对图片只把路径改写成渲染用代理 URL，序列化时还原；旧逻辑会把 `"图片标题"` 一并吞进路径，导致图片加载失败、标题丢失、保存后路径永久损坏。
- **列表与结尾**：紧凑/松散列表、任务列表、有序列表起始号（`3.` 不再变 `1.`）保持原样；以列表结尾的文档不再多出空行。
- **第一笔编辑不再丢失**：修复打开文档后立即输入或点工具栏时，第一笔修改被初始化闸门静默吞掉的问题。

### ⚡ 性能

- **代码块按需挂载**：离屏代码块不再在打开文档时创建 CodeMirror，进入视口或点按时才挂载；受控 A/B 中 `crepe.create()` 1058→281ms。
- **渲染收尾消除布局抖动**：冷路径 sync 251→63ms。
- **HTML 块改真节点**：不再为每个 HTML 块创建 CodeMirror，挂 DOM 成本 +4.26→+0.03ms/块。
- **同步路径减负**：去掉每个代码块的 ProseMirror 反查与重复样式写入；activeHints 改为 O(1)。

### 🧩 渲染修复

- 切换 UI 档位后 HTML 块不再整片空白（overlay 与 MutationObserver 不再缓存旧 `.milkdown`）。
- HTML 块占位高改按 border-box 回写，消除逐块累积的位移；异步重渲染抹掉高度时由观察者按内容哈希补回。

### 🧪 测试与验证

- 新增/扩充判据：round-trip 41 条、coldpath-bench 分段归因、overlay D 组（删中间块）、样式基线；`vitest` 31/31。
- 真机验证：未编辑保存 84KB 文档后 hash/size/mtime 均不变；编辑保存 25→26B，diff 只有目标字符；列表结尾文件无额外空行。

### 🧰 工程

- 移除未使用的 vendored Milkdown monorepo（931 个文件）。
- 关闭 Android Kotlin 增量编译，规避跨盘缓存崩溃。
- profile/release 构建支持 `MILKDOWN_URL_STAMP` 缓存戳，避免同版本号装到旧 bundle。
- 纯扫描函数外移并建立等价性测试网，删除未使用的 import。

### ✅ 下载

> 建议使用 arm64-v8a 版本

- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-armeabi-v7a.apk` - 适用于大多数 32 位设备
- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-arm64-v8a.apk` - 适用于 64 位设备（推荐）
- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-x86_64.apk` - 适用于 x86 模拟器
- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-universal.apk` - 通用包

* **FIX**: iOS 26: the fixed toolbar's automatic back button is now a 44-point circle like the native one, instead of a 38-point rounded square, and sits level with the title. The page-owned toolbar's back button is circular too (@Anderzzon, #171)
* **FIX**: iPhone Duo: in Split View, an app in the left pane now shows its controls and tab bar in a vertical bar on the left edge, as native apps do. It used to fall back to horizontal bars. The side now comes from the system's vertical bar edge (iOS 27.1) instead of the safe-area insets alone (@sergi-labhouse)

* **IMPROVEMENT**: iPhone Duo: when the system gives no inset for the strip, its width now matches the system's 84 pt (it was 60 pt) (@sergi-labhouse)

release.name: v1.11.27
release.notes:
# 汉唐中医 v1.11.27 发布说明

> 发布日期：2026-10-19
> 内部版本：1.11.27+4032（Android versionCode=4032）

## 一句话

民俗文化参考层一次补齐三个术数小模块（**三山国王灵签 92 签 / 小六壬双口径 / 梅花易数**），四个排盘结果页支持**一键存图与分享长图**，梅花易数新增**摇一摇起卦**。

## ✨ 新增（Added）

- **三山国王灵签**：收录广东揭西三山国王祖庙传承 92 签，每签含签号 / 签题 / 签诗原文 / 吉凶等级四字段。「求签」页签默念所问之事后摇取签文；「签谱」页签支持按吉凶（上 42 / 中 31 / 下 17 / 无事 2）筛选 + 签题与签诗全文检索。
- **小六壬**：时间起课，月 / 日 / 时三宫顺数，六宫（大安 / 留连 / 速喜 / 赤口 / 小吉 / 空亡）配主事六神与歌诀。术内对「月初一落宫」本有口径分歧，故**「通行掌诀」与《多能鄙事》双口径并列**由使用者自选，页面同时展示推算过程便于自核。
- **梅花易数**：时间 / 数字 / 随机三种起卦，输出主卦、互卦、变卦三卦与动爻爻辞；以动爻定体用，按《体用总诀》五关系断吉凶，结合月建旺相休囚死修正力度；互卦遵循「乾坤无互，互其变卦」特例。**零新建卦数据**，直接复用易经库，与易经模块同源。
- **排盘结果存图 / 分享长图**：八字排盘、紫微斗数、五运六气、梅花易数四个结果页 AppBar 新增图片入口，进入长图预览页（可滚动查看），提供「保存图片」（存本机，无需存储权限）与「分享长图」（系统分享面板，可转存相册 / 文件 / 微信）两个出口；导出内容与各页结果区同源，统一附带免责脚注。
- **梅花易数「摇一摇起卦」**：输入区新增「摇一摇随机起卦」开关（默认开启，可随时关闭）。摇动手机即自动切到随机起卦并重摇一卦（不动已输入的时间 / 数字），触觉反馈确认；一次摇动只出一卦，缓慢倾斜不误判。

## 🔧 改进（Changed）

- 长图预览页底部按钮带漏出内容：供截图的底层全量布局副本溢出部分会画到底栏上，卡片标题从半透明按钮后漏出、被实心按钮截断。现将溢出裁在视口内并给底栏加不透明背景。
- 小六壬双口径不冒充唯一正解：页面并列呈现，口径出处随结果展示。

## ⚠️ 边界（Known Issues）

- 三个术数模块均属**民俗文化参考**，页内固定免责声明，与经方医疗模块在界面与文案上清晰分隔，不构成任何吉凶指令或医疗建议。
- 小六壬不署作者名（「李淳风」署名无可靠版本学证据）。
- 灵签数据未收录「典故 / 现代解读」层（参考开源项目命语自带的该层为现代 AI 生成内容，未采用）。

## 📜 数据与实现

- 签谱正文整理参考开源项目**命语**（`github.com/Brhiza/mingyu`，AGPL-3.0）的 `ssgw-data`，仅取祖庙签谱的传统文本字段，其自带的现代解读内容一律未采用；全部代码与数据层为本项目自行撰写（Apache-2.0），生成脚本 `tool/gen_sanshan_lingqian_data.py` 可完整复现。
- 本版新增依赖 `sensors_plus`（加速度计，Android / iOS 均无需传感器权限）；存图功能零新增依赖（复用已有 `path_provider` + `share_plus`）。

## ✅ 验证（Verification）

- 新增测试 **56 例全绿**：小六壬 12（双口径已知答案 + 4320 组落位穷举）、梅花易数 22（主互变三卦已知答案 + 纯乾特例 + 12×12 穷举 + 摇一摇 3）、摇一摇检测器 7（触发 / 防抖 / 重新武装 / 边缘值 / 倾斜不误判）、长图导出 7（渲染 / 全量布局 2400px / 宽度不塌 / 空安全 2 / 端到端 / 底栏回归守卫）。
- `flutter analyze` 对新增 / 改动文件 **0 issue**。
- 全量 `flutter test`：**771 passed / 4 failed**，4 个均为既有问题（2 个登记基线 + 2 个全量并发下的对话框抖动，单独复跑均通过），**无新增回归**。
- 四包版本一致（versionName 1.11.27 / versionCode 4032），签名与既往版本一致，升级可直接覆盖安装。

release.notes:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.1.0 DEV

New audio, rendering, and Android startup fixes are here. Huge thanks to
[Andrew Nakas](https://github.com/andrewnakas) and contributors for the underlying
work, and [AlanConstantino](https://github.com/AlanConstantino) for integrating
it and testing on Retroid Pocket 6 in [PR #123](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/pull/123).
Alex McHugh's Skate3Recomp and ReXGlue/Xenia remain the foundation of this port.

## Download

Most players want **Skate3-Mobile-Android.apk**. Install over your existing
main app. Do not uninstall first. Android will ask you to approve the update.
Your extracted game files stay in place.

[Download the main APK](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/releases/download/v2.1.0/Skate3-Mobile-Android.apk)
or [get the separate QA Build](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/releases/download/v2.1.0-qa1/Skate3-Mobile-QA.apk).
The debug APK is for users of the separate developer app.

Older QA and developer builds used the main app's update address. Install the
matching v2.1 APK once, without uninstalling. From this version onward, each
app receives updates for its own package only.

## What changed

- Audio decoding, stereo playback, rendering, and startup improvements from PR #123.
- Safer handling of unknown game calls and unfinished GPU cleanup. These stop
  a failed session instead of allowing unsafe operations to continue.
- Package, version, checksum, and signing-key checks for app updates.

Original Skater is still the default. Seiyu and the Mod Store are included.
System Driver is recommended. Custom drivers remain optional.

The hardened build reached native gameplay and passed a short Home/resume test
on RG406V. Eight host test suites, APK signing checks, and native-library
alignment checks passed. Alan's RP6 gameplay report applies to his original
AV3 contribution build; this exact release still needs reports on other devices.
See the [test record](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/blob/mai

repo.description: 磷光终端风的 Android 天气 App：没有广告，不用登录，打开就是天气。Kotlin + Jetpack Compose，和风 / 小米 / Open-Meteo 三源融合，免密钥公共版开箱即用。

release.name: 枳生天气 0.1.5 Beta10.5 公共版
release.notes:
# 枳生天气 0.1.5-beta10.5-public

0.1.5 Beta10.5 公共版

天气来源、地点搜索、预报回看和桌面组件持续完善；新增早晚天气提醒与无雨时的云间小鸟。以下为自公开版10.3以来的累计更新。

## 天气来源

- **按模块选择天气来源**：在设置的“天气来源”中，可分别为实况、逐时与逐日预报、短时降水、气象预警、生活指数和空气质量选择来源。默认跟随主源，需要时再单独调整。
- **选源窗口重新整理**：主源、模块列表和单模块选择放在同一窗口中，切换时保留当前选择。采用居中玻璃面板，优化上下边缘衔接，文字、选中状态和缺数据提示更清楚。
- **恢复高德与百度天气接入**：可在数据接入中配置自有服务凭据，查询区县天气。高德提供实况和逐日预报；百度的数据范围以服务授权为准。
- **增加国内天气来源**：腾讯天气、中国天气网可独立选择，无需 Key；它们使用城市网站通道，覆盖与稳定性受上游影响。新增心知个人免费版 Key 与墨迹个人订阅接入，验证后保存到本机；两者只在主动选用时查询，不自动加入融合或来源比较。
- **来源比较更好操作**：比较窗口统一为居中玻璃面板，长内容可以滚动，关闭和重试保持可操作。暂时没有城市时给出选择提示，比较结束后回到原模块列表；读数统一小数位，减少多余尾数。
- **缺失读数如实保留**：不同来源只对照共同返回的真实小时，缺失或无效值不补画，也不作准确率排名。

## 桌面小组件

- **显示内容可以取舍**：组件编辑页增加显示选项，可按组件类型关闭时钟和日期、天气预报等内容，为主要读数腾出空间。
- **数字与说明文字分别调节**：温度、时间和天气读数最高可调至 200%，实际大小随组件空间调整；说明文字可单独调字号、加粗。修正小尺寸下部分数字裁切的问题。
- **清晰阅读与透明护字**：新增两种显示预设，方便选择清楚的底色或透明的背景。透明显示时可增强文字轮廓，也可按壁纸明暗调整字色。
- **全景缩放与五款预览**：全景组件支持缩得更小，并按可用空间安排内容。编辑页可一起浏览五款组件预览，已有组件和保存的配置继续保留。
- **时间点击打开系统时钟**：选择时钟动作后，点击组件时间优先打开系统时钟或闹钟；没有可用入口时给出提示，修正误跳回天气页的问题。
- **全景增加短时降水柱图**：可在全景组件的内容设置中开启降水柱图，查看有效的短时降水数据。缺少数据时显示说明，较小尺寸会自动隐藏这一块。
- **大字体下点击选项更清楚**：按实际文字宽度安排点击动作选项，较窄屏幕自动换行，选项和触点保留完整空间。大字体或较短屏幕采用紧凑头部，款式名称与预览操作分行，正文留出空间。
- **说明文字调大不再反向缩小**：修正组件空间限制与说明字号相互影响的问题；空间不足时保留可读性，数字字号继续独立调节。
- **尺寸提示与壁纸预览完善**：组件因宿主尺寸隐藏温差、预报或短时降水时，编辑页提示如何拉宽或拉高。预览随所选壁纸变化，短屏可以滚动查看，完成按钮保留。

## 预报与回看

- **缺失预报与预警处理修正**：修正缺少小时数据时仍显示小时预报的问题；来源没有返回可确认的预警信息时，保留已有预警。
- **无雨时的云间小鸟**：有效的完整两小时短时预报、剩余时段无降水时，主页文字和右侧箭头都打开游戏，降水详情在游戏底部。云柱接到画面上下边缘，远山与河流固定；每过10根在山谷、旷野、群峰、海湾和星河间换景，领取逐级升级的羽翼徽章、星光庆祝与飞行尾迹，结果页显示本局奖励。保留随机柱高与间距、渐进难度、暂停重玩、最高记录和可关闭的振翅震动，静音离线、后台暂停。有雨、缺数据、预报过期或仅小时数据时仍显示天气信息。
- **两套界面都能看当日小时温度**：经典逐日详情补齐所选日期的小时温度，沿用真实预报曲线；没有这一天的数据时明确说明。
- **逐时详情按日期看完整预报**：详情保留来源返回的完整逐时数据，可以切换日期查看。只有一个真实小时也展示读数；主页仍保留简短速览。缺失处断线，“现在”不借用未来预报补值。选定日期后横轴只显示时刻，大字体时减少刻度，避免文字拥挤。
- **天气回看按日期对照**：过去7天与往年同日采用可横滑的温度图，点击日期查看详情；缺失日期留空，只有平均温度时明确标记为平均，不补成高低温。日期选择可以确认或取消，今年预报风速与历史最大风速分开说明。

## 刷新与提醒

- **停留主页也会自动刷新**：前台刷新间隔可选 5、10、15 或 30 分钟。修正到达间隔后仍重复等待的问题，刷新失败后会重新尝试。
- **独立后台刷新**：可在设置中开启后台刷新，没有小组件或常驻通知

- True Ultrawide Fullscreen HUD & Effects: Removed legacy 16:9 safe zone clamping (hudSafe) in Vulkan and OpenGL ES renderers when fullscreen mode is active (port_is_fullscreen_aspect()). - Smooth Radial Right Analog Deadzone: Replaced abrupt deadzone cutoffs with smooth radial deadzones and proportional velocity scaling for precise Star Pointer control on external gamepads.
- In-Game Settings Drawer Touch Scrolling: Fixed touch drag gesture propagation in the in-game settings menu drawer so all graphics, audio, and gameplay options can be smoothly scrolled on touch screens.

release.notes:
## What's Changed

### Settings & Core Features
* **Settings Search:** Added a dedicated search bar within the app settings to quickly find and jump to specific configurations.
* **Folder Sharing:** You can now share entire folders directly from the app. Because Android does not natively support sharing directory trees via the share sheet, folders are automatically packaged as `.zip` files to preserve directory structure.
* **Camera Enhancements:** Improved hardware camera integration, focusing on reliable flash control and lens switching.

### Archive Management Overhaul

release.name: Lemon-Project v1.2.1
release.notes:
## Lemon-Project v1.2.1

A fix release. Thanks to **BitRanger** for the Quick Save/Load work and the save corruption fix (GitHub pull requests #9 and #10), each tested save by save on a real device.

### Fixed
- **Games no longer sit on a black screen when Nextendo Network does not answer.** With Nextendo on, a game waited for the server before it started: up to a minute while the server was down. It now gives up after a few seconds and starts offline, with the usual notice.
- **Game saves no longer get corrupted after a Quick Load.** After a Quick Save and Load, a game's own saves could end up with bytes of the previous save at the end, or with their end missing (Hollow Knight reported "Save Corrupted"). The game's own flushes now reach the file. (BitRanger)
- **Quick Save/Load works in many more places and fails much less** (BitRanger):
  - Loads are no longer refused in games that map memory, remap GPU buffers or reserve GPU address space as they play.
  - After a load, the 3D scene is no longer black, the audio no longer buzzes, scene changes no longer wait forever, and frames are no longer dropped.

release.name: v2.1.0
release.notes:
# Metadator 2.1.0

A feature release: every song now has a visible edit history, and online search finds and ranks matches better.

## New
- **Edit history.** Open *Edit history* from the editor's menu to see a song's saves grouped by day, each with the cover it had and the fields it changed. You can go back to the version before any of them.
- Restoring is also a save: Metadator backs the file up first and asks for write access, so a restore (or an Undo) can itself be undone. Settings uses the same wording.

## Improved
- **Better ranking of online results.** Titles, artists and albums are compared without the parts that only decorate them ("(Remastered)", "(Deluxe Edition)", "feat. …"), and word order no longer matters. Every credited artist counts, and a title written as "Artist - Title" or starting with its track number ("01. Halo") is understood.
- **The right version comes first.** Live, karaoke, remix and cover recordings no longer beat the original, and compilations lose to the original release unless you are looking for one. Duration still tells apart an album cut from a radio edit.
- **A match found by several sources ranks higher.** When two providers list the same recording, it is more likely to be the right one.
- **Deezer finds more.** It now tries several searches at once and falls back to the title alone when a strict search comes back empty (for example because of a "feat. …" it doesn't know).
- MusicBrainz results now carry the recording's version and disambiguation, which the ranking uses.

## Fixed
- **Crash in *Find metadata*.** The results could close the app with "Key … was already used" when MusicBrainz listed a release once per disc the recording is on (a song on both the Blu-ray and the DVD of an album, for example). Each release is now listed once, and the lookup lists each candidate once per provider.

Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/BobbyESP/Metadator/issues).

release.name: NetHack 3D 1.6.2
release.notes:
This update adds save backups, more display customization, rendering optimizations, and fixes for VR input, attack targeting, and saved run details.

### New features

- **Save import and export:** Back up manual saves and autosaves as `.nh3dsave` files, including character settings, and restore them to a compatible NetHack 3D installation. Supports all NetHack variants in the client: NetHack 3.6.7, NetHack 5, and Slash’EM. Open **Options → Saves** from the startup menu after saving and quitting.
- **Save import protection:** Imports check game-version and build compatibility, reject damaged backups, and prevent overwriting an existing save.
- **Tiled terrain in 3D ASCII mode:** Independently enable tiles for walls and ground surfaces while keeping characters, items, and other features in ASCII. Works in overhead and first-person views, including floors beneath characters and items.
- **Custom UI fonts:** Choose an installed font with a live interface preview. Browse installed fonts where supported, or enter a font family name manually. Confirm saves your choice; Cancel restores the previous font, and a reset button restores the default.
- Action-button labels automatically refit when the UI font changes.

### Performance improvements

- Spread terrain updates and graphics refreshes across frames to reduce large bursts of rendering work during movement, exploration, and tileset changes.
- Reduced repeated wall geometry and shading calculations, unnecessary first-person minimap redraws, and per-frame VR rendering overhead.
- Reduced repeated rebuilding of discovered dark-corridor walls in NetHack 3.6.7 and Slash’EM.
- Made loading older tilesets in NetHack 5 more responsive by processing their conversion in smaller chunks.
- Changed the default VR resolution from 150% to 130% to reduce rendering load. Existing saved resolution settings are preserved.

### VR keyboard and text entry fixes

- Fixed text prompts failing to activate the Quest keyboard

Create a backup list of your installed Android apps as HTML, CSV or Markdown. Works with Tasker and broadcast intents. No root needed.

release.name: v2.0.3
release.notes:
New
* Exclude specific apps from backups (Settings > Excluded apps).
* Choose which fields are exported (Settings > Exported fields). Leaving out app icons makes HTML backups much smaller.
* Optional "latest" backup file: a fixed file name that always holds the most recent backup, alongside the timestamped ones.
* Set a default sort field and order (Settings > Sort).
* Share a backup from the viewer, which now opens automatically after a backup completes.
* Separate toggles for user, system and disabled apps.
* Copy rows from the Markdown and CSV previews.
* Licence information and the app version code shown in Settings.


Improved
* Backups started from Tasker, Locale plugins or a broadcast intent now run reliably on Android 12 and later (they are scheduled through WorkManager instead of starting a service from the background).
* Redesigned Settings with better TalkBack support and fewer focus stops.
* Unified Markdown and CSV formatting; opening Markdown files no longer freezes the UI.
* Full folder path shown for Storage Access Framework (SAF) locations; cloud folders (e.g. Google Drive) show their real name.
* The file extension ("md", "csv", "html") is accepted as a format name in Tasker and broadcast actions.
* Note clarifying that HTML backups contain more detail than CSV or Markdown.


Fixed
* Backups started from Tasker, Locale or a broadcast silently did nothing on Android 12+.
* Disabled apps were reported as enabled (#70, #4).
* The backup folder setting was lost after a temporary storage error, which stopped all later backups.
* Crash when the backup folder permission had been revoked.
* Crash when no app was available to handle a tapped link (#75).
* The "Backup now" button in the viewer did not show progress while a backup was running.
* Latest-backup detection and installer names across Android versions.

release.name: ZenFile v3.5.6
release.notes:
<!-- ZenFile v3.5.6 更新日志（中英双语）。本注释在 GitHub 上自动隐藏。 -->

## ZenFile v3.5.6 (2026-10-13)

🐛 问题修复
· 修复分类页的「幽灵条目」：音频、下载、文档、压缩包、安装包里会列出 0 字节、或实际已经不存在的文件 —— 点「打开所在位置」跳过去却找不到该文件，在列表里删掉后一刷新它又回来了。根因是分类列表有 5 条数据入口绕过了「文件是否真实存在 / 是否为 0 字节」的校验（系统媒体索引读出了大小却没拿它过滤、磁盘缓存恢复完全信任旧路径、与旧列表合并时把空条目原样保留），现在统一在后台一次性核对并剔除，删掉的条目也不会再从缓存被带回来
· 修复分类卡片与快捷入口显示的数量多于列表实际条数（卡片上写着 12、点进去只有 8）的问题：数量的统计口径与列表统一为「过滤后的条数」
· 修复浏览页把 RMVB 显示成「未知格式」（同一个文件在分类页却能正常识别播放）：补齐浏览页的视频后缀（WMV / 3GP / M4V / RMVB / RM / ASF / F4V）、音频后缀（AMR / MID / MIDI）与图片后缀（ICO / RAW），与分类页对齐

🎨 界面与交互
· 设置—语言里的「自动（跟随系统）」改为跟随应用语言显示，此前在英文等界面下固定显示为中文
· 压缩 / 解压、复制 / 粘贴等进度弹窗的文案不再带黄色下划线（此前每行文字下方都有一条黄线）
· 进度弹窗的水平分隔线不再超出圆形进度环、也不再与进度环或「后台 / 取消」按钮重叠：分隔线宽度按圆环内缘重新对齐（圆周直径 300、内圈环内缘距圆边 17px，分隔线取 260px、两端各留 20px，贴住内缘但不压环）

---

## ZenFile v3.5.6 (2026-10-13)

🐛 Bug Fixes
· Fixed the "ghost entries" in the category pages: Audio, Downloads, Documents, Archives and Packages used to list files that are 0 bytes or no longer exist on disk - tapping "Open containing folder" jumped to a folder that does not contain the file, and deleting such an entry brought it right back after a refresh. The category lists had five data paths that bypassed the "does the file really exist / is it 0 bytes" check (the system media index read the size but never filtered by it, the on-disk cache restore trusted the old paths as-is, and merging with the previous list kept the empty entries unchanged); they are now all verified once in the background and dropped, and deleted entries are no longer restored from the cache
· Fixed category cards and shortcut tiles showing a higher count than the list actually contains (the card said 12 while only 8 were listed): the count now uses the same filtered result as the list
· Fixed the file browser showing RMVB as "Unknown format" while the same file was recognised and played fine from the category pages: the browser now knows the video extensions (WMV / 3GP / M4V / RMVB / RM / ASF / F4V), audio extensions (AMR / MID / MIDI) and image extensions

release.notes:
# Materializr 1.7.4

Materials and grids: give each body a real material with a mass and a finish, and pattern sketches into grids.

## Added

- **Materials.** Each body can carry a material, picked from the colour swatch in Items or the Properties panel. The list covers common 3D printing plastics (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, nylon and more), metals, wood and a few others. Plastics keep the body's colour; metals and wood repaint it. The material is saved with the project.
- **Volume and mass in Properties.** For printing plastics there is also an estimated printed mass from the infill percentage and wall count, counted the way a slicer does.
- **Material finishes in the viewport.** Metals reflect a photographed studio and wood shows a grain under a satin finish. Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Materials turns the studio reflections off.
- **Grid sketch patterns.** Linear Pattern can now copy left, right, up and/or down, each with its own count and spacing. Two or more directions make a grid, and all four centre it on the original. Directions follow the screen, whichever way the sketch faces.

## Changed

- The appearance editor opens in place of the Items list instead of a popup, so the viewport stays usable while it is open.

## Fixed

- **Tiled sketch patterns close into regions.** A copy whose corner lands on a neighbour's now shares that point, so every cell of a tiled pattern can be picked for Push/Pull or Extrude. Before, a tiled mesh formed no regions at all.

release.name: v1.2.1
release.notes:
### Release Notes

#### 核心更新：

1. Filament 版本升级：

   - 内置 Filament Java / Native 运行库由 `v1.67.1` 升级至 `v1.75.0`。
   - 同步更新 Android JNI、Java Binding 与内置材质资源。

2. 新增相机手势控制：

   - 新增 `CameraGestureController`。
   - 支持单指旋转相机、双指平移相机，以及双指缩放控制相机前后移动。
   - 支持配置旋转、平移、缩放灵敏度和相机俯仰角限制。
   - 相机手势不会消费触摸事件，可与 Node 点击和 `ViewRenderable` 控件交互共存。

3. 动画能力扩展：

   - 新增 `ARAnimationTranslation`，用于实现节点位移动画。
   - 新增 `ARAnimationPath`，用于实现 Bézier 曲线路径动画。
   - `ARAnimationModel` 新增 `getSourceDurationMillis()`，用于获取 GLTF 模型动画的原始时长。
   - 应用层可根据业务需要选择使用模型动画源时长或自定义播放周期。

4. 基本图元与几何接口扩展：

   - `GeometryUtils` 新增 Quad 创建接口 `makeQuad(...)`。
   - 新增以下基本图元创建接口：
     - `makePoints(...)`
     - `makeLines(...)`
     - `makeLineStrip(...)`
     - `makeTriangles(...)`
     - `makeTriangleStrip(...)`
   - 上述接口只需要提供顶点空间坐标和材质，可直接创建对应的 `ModelRenderable`。

5. 点图元与宽线材质：

   - `MaterialFactory` 新增 `makePointsWithColor(...)`，支持设置点图元的屏幕像素尺寸。
   - `MaterialFactory` 新增 `makeLinesWithColor(...)`，支持设置线图元的屏幕像素宽度。
   - 宽线通过三角形展开和 `CUSTOM0` 顶点属性在屏幕空间实现，不受 OpenGL 原生线光栅化宽度限制。
   - 动态 Renderable 新增可配置 Filament 图元拓扑和 `CUSTOM0` 顶点数据支持。

6. RenderableDefinition API 更新：

   - `RenderableDefinition.Submesh` 更新为语义更明确的 `RenderableDefinition.SubGeometry`。
   - 新增 `setSubGeometries(...)` 和 `getSubGeometries()`。
   - 原 `Submesh`、`setSubmeshes(...)` 和 `getSubmeshes()` 接口继续保留，并标记为过时。
   - 支持通过 `RenderableDefinition.setPrimitiveType(...)` 配置图元拓扑。
   - 支持通过 `RenderableInstance.changePrimitive(...)` 动态切换图元类型。

7. Line3D API 更新：

   - `Line3D` 新增 `dispose()`，用于主动释放其持有的 Renderable 和内部资源。
   - `setPipePointMode(...)` 的整型参数更新为类型安全的 `Line3DPipePointMode` 枚举。
   - 支持 `ORIGINAL` 和 `SIN_RESAMPLE` 两种管线端点处理方式。

#### 生命周期与稳定性：

1. GLTF 共享资源管理优化：

   - 调整 GLTF Asset、ResourceLoader、材质提供器、MaterialInstance 与 Renderable 的共享关系。
   - 优化 GLTF 资源加载、复用和回收顺序。
   - 避免 Fragment 或场景切换时提前销毁仍被其他 Renderable 使用的共享资源。

2. SceneLayout 生命周期完善：

   - `SceneLayout.destroy()` 会先递归释放当前场景持有的节点树，再销毁 `SceneView`。

it will **not** install like a normal app. It is for sideloading with
tools such as [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or TrollStore, which

release.notes:
## Nothing to redo

Deskhub 9.3.1 speaks the same authentication version as every 9.x release, so hosts and
clients on any 9.x release talk to each other and no device has to be let in again.
Coming from 8.x or older, read the
[9.0.1 notes](https://github.com/manhpham90vn/Deskhub/releases/tag/v9.0.1) first: every
device must be on Deskhub 9.

The fixes below are on the Mac you connect **to**; the viewer needs nothing new.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **A Mac can now be signed into from the login window.** With *Allow access before
  anyone signs in* on, 9.3.0 showed a viewer the login window but swallowed its mouse and
  keyboard, and the first click froze the picture until someone signed in at the Mac. The
  host before sign-in now posts input through IOKit, the route macOS keeps open at the
  login window, and never freezes.
- **A Mac set to start Deskhub at login and share on launch shares again without a
  click.** When the app had been living in the menu bar at the previous shutdown, macOS
  brought it back at login without a window, and the share that waited for that window
  never started: the Mac answered at the login window, then went quiet the moment someone
  signed in, until the window was opened by hand. The app now starts that share on its
  own and opens its window at launch, as the settings promise.
- **A Mac that is sharing stays reachable through Log Out.** The app used to quit the
  moment macOS began logging out, while a terminal with a running process or an unsaved
  document was still asking whether to quit, leaving the viewer unable to answer. The share
  now stays up until every other app has quit; if the log-out is cancelled on the Mac, the
  app keeps running.
- **Fewer round trips to the daemon.** While waiting for a display at login, the app sent
  its *access before sign-in* copies to the daemon on every half-second probe; it now
  sends them only when the settings or the allowed list change, when a share stops and
  once at launch.

## 📝 Documented

# Android Reverse — v20 Release Notes

This is the biggest update to Android Reverse yet. Version 20 turns the app from a pure analysis tool into a full round-trip editor: extract, inspect, **edit**, and **rebuild** an APK — all on-device.

---

## 🏗️ Round-Trip Editing & Rebuild

- **APK Rebuild** — repack an APK directly from the app after making changes.
- **Resource Editing** — edit app resources in place, not just view them.
- **AXML Editing** — edit binary Android XML (not just the resilient decoding from before).
- **Manifest Editing** — edit `AndroidManifest.xml` directly.
- **Signature Manager** — create, import, and export JKS keystores, and sign rebuilt APKs.

## 🧬 Smali Tooling

- **Smali LSP** — language server support for smarter navigation and editing.
- **Smali Editing** — edit Smali directly in the app.
- **Smali Formatter** — auto-format Smali code.
- **Smali Import / Delete** — import new Smali files or delete existing ones.
- **Smali Copy Path** — quickly copy a class/method's path for reference elsewhere.

## 📝 XML Tooling

- **XML LSP** — language server support for XML editing.
- **XML Formatter** — auto-format XML.
- **XML Search** — search within XML files.
- **XML Syntax Highlighter** — fixed highlighting bugs.
- **Data Converter for XML** — convert data directly within XML, plus general data converter improvements.

## 🎨 Resources & Media

- **Res Layout Preview** — preview Android layout resources visually.
- **Professional Image Editor** — full image editing built into the app.

## 📂 File Management

- **Remove Files** — delete files individually or in batch.
- **Extended File Properties** — view more detailed metadata per file.
- **Export / Replace Files** — export files out of an APK, or replace them in place.
- **Text Editor for Ordinary Files** — edit non-code/plain files without leaving the app.

## 🤖 MCP

- **MCP can now edit everything** in a project — compilation/rebuild remains a manua

release.name: Dungeon Master Tool v19.1.1 — Copies That Keep the Original (Beta)
release.notes:
**Release date:** October 2026
**Downloads & source:** [GitHub release](https://github.com/elymsyr/dungeon-master-tool/releases/tag/beta-v19.1.1) · [elymsyr.github.io](https://elymsyr.github.io/)

This is a bug-fix release. Copying a world no longer empties the original, and downloading the same world or package twice no longer empties the first download. Card edits made in quick succession are no longer lost. Your data is not changed, so this version installs over v19.1.0.

---

### Bug fixes

- **Copying a world** — copying a world moved its cards and sessions to the copy and left the original empty. This is fixed. The copy now also takes the world's images, PDFs, attachments and package links, and links inside text point to the copy's own cards.
- **Downloading a world twice** — downloading the same world from **Marketplace** or **Marketplace → Official** a second time emptied the first download. This is fixed: each download is its own world.
- **Downloading a package twice** — downloading the same package a second time renamed the first one and moved its cards to the new one. This is fixed. Installing an official package as a copy is covered too.
- **Lost card edits** — a second edit made right after the first (typing a name, then the description) could replace the first edit. This is fixed: both are kept.
- **Editing SRD and package cards** — the first edit of an SRD or package card makes your own Homebrew copy. An edit made at that moment could overwrite the copy's first edit and set its source back to the original. This is fixed.
- **Images in an imported world** — images inside text could break when a `.dmtz` world was imported on another device. This is fixed.

- **App version bump:** `19.1.0` → `19.1.1`.

| Feature | Description |
| ------- | ----------- |

| **Numeric Face Distance Limit** | Maximum authentication distance is now configurable as a continuous numeric value (up to 150 cm) instead of a fixed set of options |
| **Hardware JPEG Encoding for Cropped Faces** | Cropped face images are now encoded on the device's hardware JPEG encoder, reducing CPU load and USB bandwidth during authentication. See also: Performance. |

repo.description: Bypass Snapchat SSL pinning on Android devices

release.notes: Patched Snapchat v12.16.0.28 with SSL pinning bypassed.

Upgrade to KataGo 1.18.2
optimized versions of transformer networks 

Unfortunately transformer networks are much slower on smartphone NPUs than the convolution networks that KataGo used before. This is because smartphone NPUs are particularly optimized for convolutions since they are the backbone of image processing.
Moreover, the kata1-tf3-b11c768 network is probably just too heavy for a smartphone NPU. According to its size, it should be 2.2 times slower than the kata1-tf3-b10c512 network, but it's in fact 4 times slower, so it's probably hitting some hardware limits.

Nonetheless, the transformer networks are very strong, so that I still get an increase of playing strength over the 28b network at equal thinking time on my phone (but that may be different on other devices).

release.name: Jenny 1.0.0
release.notes:
The first stable release of Jenny. From here on, a change that breaks something you rely on gets a new major number.

## What's new

- **A new home** built around the conversation, with swipeable pages: Apps, Jenny, Notebooks and Settings. A Jenny App or a notebook can be pinned as a page of its own.
- **The workshop**: the previous interface, regrouped into four drawers (Console, Brain, Hands, Memory) behind Settings.
- **Jenny outside the app**: she floats above other apps and you can talk to her there, and you can reply to her from the notification shade.
- **Notebooks in the home**, each with its own chat, pages and map, plus editing and reporting from the reader.
- **Synthwave '84** is the new default theme, and the onboarding and splash screen wear it.
- Sturdier streaming from providers, tighter network and file guards, and every word in every theme readable at 4.5:1.

Over 800 changes since 0.11.0. The full list, including the changes you may notice, is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/flagdizero/jenny-android-ai-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Updating

Jenny 0.7.0 or newer offers this update on its own, and Android asks you to confirm the install. Older versions need the APK below installed by hand, once. The signing key is unchanged, so it installs over your current version and keeps your data.

## Verify what you downloaded

```
sha256  6fa89bb2e6e08b260b1cbbd98def48585a1a38feb164b096d2564126cdf6ba43
size    75244909 bytes (71.8 MB)
```

```bash
shasum -a 256 jenny-1.0.0.apk
```

The hash proves you got this file whole; the **signature** is what proves it came from
this project, and Android checks it for you on an in-place update. To check it yourself:

```bash
apksigner verify --print-certs jenny-1.0.0.apk
```

The certificate is the same one published with
[0.3.0](https://github.com/flagdizero/jenny-android-ai-agent/releases/tag/v0.3.0) — if it
ever differs, the build did not come from this project.

We are thrilled to announce the release of MobileInsight v6.0.0 beta for public test. Starting from this version, **MobileInsight will progressively support 5G NR**. We invite you to help us test this new feature and share your valuable feedback.

The main updates of MobileInsight v6.0.0 beta include

- **5G control-plane analytics:** MobileInsight v6.0.0 beta now supports the data collection of analytics of 5G radio resource control (RRC, defined in [3GPP TS38.331](https://portal.3gpp.org/desktopmodules/Specifications/SpecificationDetails.aspx?specificationId=3197)). It offers analyzers for the runtime 5G RRC state, PHY/link-layer configurations, handover parameters/measurements/decisions, and dual connectivity analysis. Please try these features by following our updated tutorials on [5G data collection and analytics](http://www.mobileinsight.net/tutorial-api.html).

- **Updated 4G LTE control-plane analytics for 5G:** For incremental deployment, most operational 5G networks so far adopt the non-standalone (NSA) and dual connectivity mode that use 4G LTE's core network and radio access as the "anchor''. To this end, MobileInsight v6.0.0 also updates its 4G LTE analyzers to tackle both modes. The latest LTE RRC analyzer now can analyze the 4G<->5G handovers and dual connectivity. 

- **New message support:** MobileInsight v6.0.0 beta adds support for these messages/versions


  - 5G NR RRC OTA messages: v8

  - LTE RRC OTA messages: v52, v49, v48, v46, v26

  - LTE RRC MIB Packet: v17

  - LTE RLC UL Config Log Packet: v69


We have tested these features on Xiaomi MI10 for 5G and various 4G LTE phones. **We would like to invite you to test these new features, and help us refine the 5G support by sharing your valuable feedback with us via** <support@mobileinsight.net>.

release.name: LineCode Pro v1.3.4
release.notes:
## LineCode Pro v1.3.4

### 版本信息
- 版本名称: v1.3.4
- 版本号: 38

## v1.3.4

### 工作区与文件

- **改动文件前先读取** - 内置文件工具新增读后写保护：覆盖或编辑一个已存在的文件之前
  必须先读取它。读取成功时记录本次返回内容的 SHA-256，写入或编辑前用**同一次读取拿到的
  内容**重新比对（不再另查一次磁盘，因此记录的一定是模型看到的那一版）：
  文件从未读取过就拒绝，并提示先用 `file_read` 读取后重试；读取之后文件又被外部改动
  （其他程序、其他 Agent 或用户）同样拒绝，并提示重新读取，不再覆盖 AI 从未看过的内容。
- **整体替换要求完整读过** - `file_write` 会用新内容整份替换目标，所以只在模型确实看完整份
  文件时才放行：窗口读取（`start_kb`/`end_kb`）或结果被截断的读取只记为「部分读取」，
  此时整体替换会被拒绝并提示改用 `file_edit`；`file_edit` 只替换匹配到的片段、其余字节
  原样保留，因此部分读取也允许编辑。目标不存在时按新建处理，无需先读；工具自身写入或
  编辑成功后刷新记录，连续修改不必反复重读。
- **同一文件不会被两个工具调用同时改** - 变更期间按路径持有内存占用标记：并行子 Agent 或
  同一轮里的并发调用正在改同一文件时，后来的变更直接拒绝并提示重试，不会出现两次变更
  都通过校验、后者覆盖前者却都报成功。进程之外的写入者无法被拦住（平台文件能力没有
  compare-and-swap），这段窗口仍以最终的写入调用为界。
- **读取失败的状态不再被当作新文件** - 写入前 `Stat` 失败且错误不是「不存在」（例如权限或
  I/O 错误）时现在直接失败，不再把已存在的文件当成新建文件而跳过读取保护。
- **记录只存在内存中** - 已读记录按绝对路径保存在进程内存里，不写入数据库或磁盘：
  应用重启后从零开始，这只会让规则更严格；记录条数设有上限，超出后整表作废，
  代价仅是重新读取一次。

### 发布

- **版本** - `versionCode` 38、`versionName` 1.3.4。
- **回归覆盖** - 原生测试新增 `file_observation_tests`（SHA-256 标准向量与分块一致性、
  内存观察表语义、容量上限与变更占用标记）和 `file_tool_tests` 的读后写用例（未读拒绝、
  外部改动拒绝、内容相同不算改动、部分读取只允许编辑、窗口覆盖整份文件才允许整体替换、
  截断读取记为部分、读取失败不授权、`Stat` 失败不当作新文件、并发变更被拒绝后释放、
  写入失败后可重试、文件被外部删除后可重建、中英文提示、共享记录注入）；
  `:app:assembleDebug` 通过，工具文案目录表由 `tools/gen_tool_text_catalog.py` 重新生成。


---

### 下载说明
- 下载 `LineCodePro-1.3.4.apk` 直接安装
- 校验文件: `LineCodePro-1.3.4.apk.sha256`

release.name: HeinPlay-1.4.0
release.notes:
## 更新内容
- **新增 Linux 电脑版（面向掌机）**：桌面端新增 Linux 版，产物为单文件 AppImage（`heinplay-1.4.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage`），免安装、双击即用，**重点服务 Steam Deck 等掌机 / 手持设备**，同时适用于普通桌面 Linux。配套一键安装脚本负责安装、升级与卸载；掌机场景下 SteamOS 游戏模式自动全屏铺满、播放页返回键可正常退出；应用文件名与安装路径全部使用英文，避免在用户目录生成中文路径。已在 ONEXPLAYER（Bazzite）掌机上完成实机验证。
- **新增游戏手柄操作支持**：Android TV、tvLegacy、Windows、Linux 全面支持游戏手柄 —— **A 键 = 确认、B 键 = 返回、十字键 = 方向键**，与遥控器 / 键盘 / 鼠标完全等效，所有界面（含弹窗、选集、换源）均可用手柄操作。
- **电脑版（Windows / Linux）统一交互**：Windows 与 Linux 统一为功能一致的「电脑版」，键鼠交互统一为 —— 鼠标悬停即高亮焦点、回车 = 左键 = 确认、ESC = 右键 = 返回，同一时刻只有一处焦点；顶部导航改为方向键逻辑移动（↓ 进入内容区、↑ 返回导航）；首页 / 分类页按 ESC 或右键弹出退出确认；设置中「Windows」分组更名为「电脑版」。
- **Windows 便携版存储与缓存重构**：偏好主表由约 7.5MB 降至约 39KB（大体积缓存值外置 + 写入去抖），启动维护降至十几毫秒，直播起播不再因重写偏好表卡顿；派生缓存迁至 `data/cache/` 并按「TTL + 7 天」滚动淘汰，海报缓存由 90 天调整为 7 天。同时修复便携版更新后需重新登录、历史日志丢失的问题。
- **点播源清晰度与排序优化**：源列表排序改为「可用性 > 清晰度 > 速度」，修正此前 360P 源因测速快而排在 1080P 之前的问题；去掉分辨率缓存兜底，避免解析失败时被旧缓存的低清晰度永久锁死。
- **直播体验优化**：直播不再套用点播缓冲档位（改用播放器低延迟默认值），起播与换台更快；频道列表与完整节目单打开时首帧即停在当前频道，不再有从顶部滚动跳转的动画；节目单找不到覆盖当前时间的节目时退化为「时间上最接近现在」的一条；EPG 缓存改为「仍覆盖当前时间」才复用，过期强制刷新。
- **tvLegacy 低版本安卓兼容性优化**：优化 tvLegacy 对低版本安卓设备（Android 5.0+）的兼容性，提升旧机型与旧安卓版本上的运行稳定性。
- **fvp 播放源兼容性提升**：修复部分播放源「能出画面但定格」（底层流参数探测窗口由 0.1 秒放宽至 0.5 秒）；关闭 fvp 低延迟模式 —— 其注入的 `fflags=+nobuffer` 会丢弃首个关键帧包，导致缓冲失效、进度条恒等于播放位置、拖动后不预取；底层播放器（libmdk / ffmpeg）日志已接入 App 日志（tag `MDK` / `FVP`），便于定位源兼容性问题。Windows / Linux / 鸿蒙 / tvLegacy 各 fvp 路径同步生效。
- **播放与交互修复**：修复电脑版关闭去广告后点播黑屏、Windows / Linux fvp「有声音无画面 / 卡死」、VLC 起播慢被误判为播放失败、开启去广告时切换播放器导致软件无响应、Windows 直播回放（catchup=append 类型源）无法回放、电脑版回车 / 小键盘回车无法确认、方向键焦点锁死与顶部导航 ↓ 进不了内容页等问题；修复 Android TV 与 tvLegacy 退出播放时闪退。
更新日志详见 CHANGELOG.md

## Added

- GitHub Actions release automation now rebuilds Android and Android TV APKs from the repository.

- The release workflow builds Android and TV in separate jobs before publishing the full asset set to the existing GitHub release.

- Android release APKs no longer force close during startup when release minification initializes background app services.
- Release publishing no longer stops at mobile-only artifacts when the current public release also expects TV downloads.
- Manual workflow runs can rebuild the current release from the checked-out repository instead of relying on local release assets.
- The release rebuild no longer risks timing out while producing both Android and TV assets.

## Recent work

- Rebuilt `v1.0.1` with signed Android and Android TV APKs produced by GitHub Actions.
- Organized the release into mobile and TV asset groups with matching ABI coverage.
- Updated repository and website release copy so download pages can point users at the current asset names.

release.name: DriftDroid v1.3.0
release.notes:
## Retro Rewind 6.13, a 30 FPS mode, and DriftDroid can update itself

### Retro Rewind 6.13

- **Works with Retro Rewind 6.13.0 and 6.13.1**, including Retro WFC online.
- **Already have Retro Rewind installed?** Tap Retro Rewind after updating DriftDroid. It notices the old version and updates itself (about 640 MB), then tap again to play.
- **Fresh install** downloads 6.13.0 and applies the 6.13.1 update on top, the same way the official installer does.
- **DriftDroid now follows Retro Rewind's release list** instead of knowing only one version. Updates that only change tracks or characters install without a new DriftDroid. Updates that change game code still need a new DriftDroid build.
- Large Retro Rewind updates download with a progress count and continue where they stopped if the connection drops.
- A failed install or update check no longer deletes a working Retro Rewind install.
- Fixed: picking an already-extracted Retro Rewind folder closed the app.
- The free-space check was asking for about 7 GB for a 4 GB job; it now asks for what it needs.

> [!WARNING]
> Mods that replace Retro Rewind's own menu files were made for 6.12.8 and can crash on 6.13 (for example when opening Retro WFC). Turn them off or get a version rebuilt for 6.13.

### 30 FPS races (new)

A new setting, **30 FPS races**, for phones that can't hold 60. The game runs at normal speed and draws half as many frames, using the game's own 30 FPS mode, so it stops feeling like slow motion. It works in the original game and in Retro Rewind, offline and online. Menus stay at 60. Retro Rewind time trials and ghost races stay at 60 because Retro Rewind requires it. Off by default; applies from the next race.

### DriftDroid updates itself (new, untested)

When a new version is out, an **Update available** button appears on the game chooser. Tap it, then **Update Now**: DriftDroid downloads the update, checks it, and Android asks you to confirm. The first time, Android asks you to allow DriftDroid

release.notes:
### 备注：
本次更新实际上实现了高通骁龙CPU的GPU（opencl）和NPU后端，但经过测试，opencl后端存在无限重复、高版本android设备上无法使用系统opencl库等问题，所以暂时禁用，目前CPU后端仍是llama.cpp最推荐使用的后端。
llama.cpp相关二进制文件已从git仓库移除，如需编译请使用release中的预编译包或自行编译。

### v1.2.2

新增
- llama.cpp 支持 Hexagon NPU（实验性），适用于骁龙 8 Gen 2 及以上。可在服务配置中选择该后端，并设置卸载层数（0–99）。
- 启动前会检测当前设备实际支持的 llama.cpp 后端。已保存的加速后端不可用时，自动改用 CPU。

优化
- llama.cpp 的默认生成线程数由 2 调整为 4。
- 内置 llama.cpp 运行时升级到 0.4.1。
- 模型库部分提示组件UI进行优化。

### Notes:
This update actually implements the GPU (OpenCL) and NPU backends for Qualcomm Snapdragon CPUs, but after testing, the OpenCL backend has issues such as infinite repetition and being unable to use the system OpenCL library on newer Android devices, so it is temporarily disabled. Currently, the CPU backend is still the most recommended backend for llama.cpp.
The llama.cpp-related binary files have been removed from the Git repository. If you need to compile, please use the precompiled packages in the release or compile them yourself.

New
- llama.cpp supports the Hexagon NPU (experimental) on Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and later. The backend can be selected in service settings, with an offloaded layer count from 0 to 99.
- ServLlama checks which llama.cpp backends the device actually supports before starting. If the saved accelerator is unavailable, it falls back to CPU.

Improvements
- The default llama.cpp generation thread count is now 4, up from 2.
- The bundled llama.cpp runtime is updated to 0.4.1.
- Optimize the UI of the prompt component in the model library section.

## What's Changed
* Feature/llama cpp snapdragon backends by @ArkaneFans in https://github.com/ArkaneFans/servllama/pull/44


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ArkaneFans/servllama/compare/1.2.1...1.2.2

release.name: v0.10.8 — D3D12 on older drivers, very wide windows
release.notes:
## Changes

- **D3D12 on older drivers (#177).** Some drivers, such as older NVIDIA ones, can't draw with the depth range flipped, which this game uses, and D3D12 stopped with an error on them. On those drivers the port now flips depth itself in a small extra shader step. Drivers that can flip the range are unchanged.
- **Very wide windows (#190).** In Auto aspect, the game used to stop widening at 4096 pixels of logical width (about 5.7:1) and add black bars beyond that. It now widens up to the render size limit of 8192 (about 11:1). Wider windows show more of the course and cost more GPU time. Windows wider than 11:1 still get black bars.

Everything else is the same as [v0.10.7](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/Free-Riders-Recompiled/releases/tag/v0.10.7).

## Validation

- **D3D12 depth fallback:** a whole Windows D3D12 race with the fallback forced on (`SFR_TEST_NO_INVERTED_DEPTH=1`): no errors, all pipelines prepared with the depth step, and the course and HUD drawn correctly. It was not tested on a driver that actually lacks the feature.
- **Wide window:** a 3840x360 window in Auto aspect gets a logical width of 7680 (was capped at 4096), with the course drawn across the whole width and the HUD at the edges.
- **Windows x64 package, Vulkan, with the validation layer:** a whole race, no validation errors, all 455 pipelines, no untranslatable code.
- **AYN Thor, this release's APK:** Dolphin Resort at full speed (0.999, 60 fps), all 455 pipelines prepared.
- **Unit tests:** 158 passed on Linux. GitHub Actions builds and tests passed on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android.

## Downloads

- **Windows x64:** download and extract the Windows ZIP; run `FreeRidersRecompiled.exe`.
- **Linux x64:** download and extract the Linux archive; run `FreeRidersRecompiled`.
- **Android 10 or later:** prefer `android10-arm64.apk`.
- **Android 9:** use `android-arm64.apk`.
- **Android version code:** 56. The companion licence archive applies to both APKs.

## RF Sentinel 2.27.0

**New: whitelist WiFi networks by name**
- Menu > Whitelist now has a **Network names** section: *Name starts with*, *Name contains* or *Exact name*. Handy for a router that is on every bus of a fleet, with a new address on each one.
- Networks whose name matches are treated like a whitelisted device: shown as trusted, never flagged, logged or alerted on. Other devices of the same make still alert as before.
- A WiFi device's **Whitelist** button also offers every network whose name starts like its own (you can shorten the start). Tap a rule to edit it; Remove has Undo.
- Hidden networks (no name) can't be matched by name.

- On a device's page, a map of every spot that device was heard, joined in time order for each encounter.

**Radio signals**
- On a radio signal's page, **Locate** opens the waterfall tuned to its frequency so you can follow the strongest signal, and **Watch this frequency** adds it to the frequencies to watch. (#6)

**Maps**
- The main screen's map and the full screen map share their view (place, zoom, heading, tilt, following you), the place card and routes.
- Cameras and CCTV load faster: what's on screen and around you downloads first, and cameras already shown stay on the map while a new download runs.
- CCTV shows again at once when you zoom back in.

**Fixes**
- The History map no longer crashes every time on some phones.

**Which file?**
- `RFSentinel-v2.27.0-release.apk`: the normal build (about 50 MB).
- `RFSentinel-v2.27.0-foss.apk`: free software only (about 28 MB).

release.name: Hermes Console v1.2.15
release.notes:
## Console 1.2.15

Console no longer needs the Mobile Bridge. It talks to Hermes' own Gateway and
Dashboard, and the new first run is: scan a code, confirm, you are on Home.

**What is new**

- A chat that shows Hermes' work in plain words, like Hermes Desktop, with an
  island at the top that speaks up only when something needs you.
- Voice conversations inside the chat; the on-device recogniser is ready when you
  tap.
- A Home board of sized widgets (Now, Chats, Bots, Rooms, Cron, Tasks) that
  never scrolls.
- A plain tap dock, one identity per profile, and a floating app pet.
- Models: edit the fallback chain and remove a provider completely.
- Calmer notifications and launcher widgets that stay current.
- A floating, translucent look in every theme, light and dark.

**Connecting**

Run one line on the computer where Hermes lives and scan the code it shows (see
the [README](https://github.com/xP3ta/hermes-console#connect)).
The current setup helper needs Console 1.2.15 or newer.

**Coming from a bridge-era install?** The app cleans up its side on the first
launch. When every phone is on 1.2.15, remove the bridge from the computer with
the helper's `--retire-bridge` line (Windows: `-RetireBridge`).

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/xP3ta/hermes-console/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1215-9540--2026-10-12).

**Installing:** Android 7.0 or newer. These APKs are the signed `full` release,
one per CPU architecture (most phones need `arm64-v8a`); verify the SHA-256 and
signing certificate before installing. Google Play and GitHub/Obtainium builds
are signed with different keys: stay on one channel.

# CoinTex 1.4.1

CoinTex is a top-down arcade game written entirely in Python with [Kivy](https://kivy.org). Move your character around each level to collect all the coins before the timer runs out, while dodging monsters and fire and shooting your way through. The same Python codebase runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone and iPad, and every screen and all of the graphics are drawn in code.

This patch release updates the Android packaging configuration for Google Play's Android 16 requirement, prepares the iPhone/iPad App Store release path, and includes a cross-platform usability and reliability pass.

## What's new in 1.4.1

- Android now targets Android 16 (API level 36) for Google Play update compliance.
- The Buildozer/python-for-android toolchain is pinned to API 36-capable releases with NDK r28c, and generated artifacts are checked for target SDK, ABIs, and 16 KB native-library alignment.
- Android now declares the game category, preserves Kivy's Back handling on API 36, and keeps progress out of Android cloud backups.
- The gameplay HUD has higher-contrast text panels, clearer Pause/Leave controls, safe margins for notches and gesture areas, and player spawns that stay clear of the lower controls.
- Desktop and Apple-silicon Mac users can move with WASD/arrow keys and fire with Space; Android Back and desktop Escape now navigate safely.
- Backgrounding pauses single-player without consuming the timer or health. Multiplayer closes cleanly rather than leaving a stalled peer connection.
- Save loading now recovers safely from truncated or malformed values, and peer messages/coordinates are bounded before reaching the game loop.
- Settings show an exact volume percentage and confirm when campaign progress has been reset.
- The Auto Player sends movement changes through Kivy's main thread, and transient visual effects are cleaned up between levels.
- An App Store-ready iPhone/iPad project path now includes current Xcode/iOS SDK checks, metadata, screen

release.name: Release v1.4.4
release.notes:
# 更新内容

## v1.4.4（2026-10-15）

**AI 生成链路的一次升级。⚠ 本版未做完整真机验证，风险已知并写在下面。**

- **Chat Completions 改走 SSE 流式**，并加上 Max Tokens 自适应：预算偏小自动抬到 16384、
  输出被截断（`finish_reason == "length"`）就翻倍重试一次、被服务端以 token 上限类错误拒绝
  则回退到 8192 并**按服务商记住上限**，下次不再撞同一堵墙。Responses / anthropic 端点
  **未接流式，行为不变**。
- **加强模式（双击快照按钮）现在能区分失败原因**：以前 AI 的选择器没命中时，回喂给模型的
  话永远是同一句「未匹配到任何节点」；现在会判断该选择器能否走快速匹配 —— 如果它首个属性
  没按规则写成 `[id=]` / `[vid=]` / `[text=]` 等号精确匹配，重试提示会直接指向写法问题。
  日志同时记录「可快速匹配 true/false」与选择器原文。
- **新增「设置 - 高级设置 - 外部调用」**：显示并一键复制带 token 的抓取快照命令。上一版给
  外部调用加了 token 鉴权，但没给普通用户任何拿到 token 的途径，等于把这条路关上了 —— 这版补回。
- 同步上游 gkd-selector 0.6.1 的 fast query 诊断 API（纯加法，不改匹配行为）。
- 单元测试 136 → 152（新增 SSE 解析与 token 预算两组纯函数测试，均不依赖网络）。

### 未验证项与影响范围

本版改动**全部集中在 AI 规则生成链路**，无障碍点广告的主流程一行未动。未做真机验证的具体项：

1. 流式请求在个别服务商上可能不被正确支持 —— 症状是 **AI 生成失败或结果缺尾**。已加的兜底是：
   响应不是 `text/event-stream` 时自动回落到原来的非流式解析；但服务商行为无法穷举。
2. 抬底到 16384 会让部分按 token 计费的服务商**单次消耗变高**（这是自适应的代价）。
3. 加强模式的重试提示改动，可能让某些模型的重试收敛变慢（不会更差于原来的笼统提示）。

### 出问题怎么办

- **反馈**：应用内「日志」页导出日志（设置 - 高级设置 - 导出日志），日志里已带
  `可快速匹配` / token 预算 / 流式分支的判断记录，直接发出来即可定位。
- **临时回退**：本版是独立提交链，出问题可整体回退到 v1.4.3（`93fc089`）——
  回退只需 revert 这 3 个功能提交，不涉及数据库迁移、不涉及配置格式变更，用户侧无感。

## v1.4.3（2026-10-15）

**AI 生成这条链一次过；顺带两个界面交互修好**

- **Chat Completions 改走 SSE 流式，并加上 Max Tokens 自适应**：预算偏小自动抬到 16384、
  输出被截断（`finish_reason == "length"`）就翻倍重试、被服务端拒绝则回退到 8192 并
  **按服务商记住上限**，下次不再撞同一堵墙。Responses / anthropic 端点未接流式，行为不变。
- **加强模式（双击快照按钮）现在能区分失败原因**：以前 AI 生成的选择器没命中时，回喂给
  模型的话永远是同一句「未匹配到任何节点」；现在会用选择器的快速匹配能力判断，如果它
  本身就无法快速匹配（首个属性没写成 `[id=]` / `[vid=]` / `[text=]` 等号精确匹配），
  重试提示会直接指向写法问题。日志同时记下「可快速匹配 true/false」和选择器原文。
- **触发记录支持按应用多选筛选**（只在"全部记录"视图出现，订阅维度和单应用入口行为不变）。
- **悬浮快照按钮改成单击展开菜单**（仅快照 / 加强模式 / 算了），去掉原来单击必须白等的
  400 毫秒双击判定。
- 同步上游 gkd-selector 0.6.1 的 fast query 诊断 API（纯加法，不改匹配行为）。
- 新增 SSE 解析与 token 预算的单元测试，单测数 136 → 152。

## v1.4.2（2026-10-14）

**更新通道修好了 —— 这一版必须手动装一次**

# PocketTracker 0.9.8

**Scales, nine new effect commands, a metronome, and a SoundFont that costs only
the sound you are playing.**

---

**Scales**

- **A SCALE screen** — sixteen scale slots and a project key. Step the name row through **38 built-in scales**, or switch notes on and off by hand and save your own preset. Every note is pulled onto the scale its track is in as it plays, so putting a scale on a phrase you wrote chromatically re-tunes it.

- **An instrument can opt out.** A new **TSP** cell on INSTRUMENT takes that instrument out of every note transposition — the scale, the chain TSP column and the project transpose.

**Nine new effect commands**

`SCA` and `SCG` are two of them. The other seven put things that could only be set on the INSTRUMENT screen into a phrase step or a table row, per note:

- **`LPF`, `HPF` and `BPF`** switch a low-, high- or band-pass filter **on** at the cutoff you name.
- **`DRV` and `CRU`** write the instrument's dirt per note — overdrive, and bit crush plus downsample together in one cell.
- **`FIN`** tunes a note by cents, a semitone either way, and re-tunes one that is already sounding, so a slide of it is a glide.
- **`TSX`** scales how far the chain and project transposes move a note: as usual, further, not at all, or the opposite way. *(GitHub Issue #30)*

- **The effect picker is grouped now.** Holding A on an FX type opens the commands in groups — **SEQUENCE**, **INSTRUMENT** and **GLOBAL** — instead of one long grid. One group is open at a time, and moving past its last row opens the next.

- **METRONOME is a new row on SETTINGS**, off by default. Turned on, it clicks on every beat while the song plays, and **VOL** beside it sets how loud. It is never part of the song — no mix, stem or resample carries it. *(GitHub Issue #35)*

## 3.2.0

**eOr 3.2 brings your old Android boxes along, puts your device status on the home screen, and gets even more out of an ES-DE library.**

Thank you to everyone who sent feedback after 3.1 — the 3DS and 3D box fixes below come straight from those reports 🙏

eOr now runs on **Android 6.0 and newer** (it used to need Android 8). Lots of older Android TV boxes are great for retro gaming, and they're welcome now.

- **3D box art support.** If your library was scraped with "3D box images", eOr now uses them whenever a game has no regular cover. Prefer them? Turn on **Prefer 3D boxes** in Settings › Media & Artwork. 3D boxes are shown whole, never cropped.

- **One press of A launches a game** from its page — it used to take two.

release.name: Linthra v0.2.9
release.notes:
# Linthra v0.2.9

Linthra 0.2.9 is a stability and reliability release focused on making everyday playback, downloads, syncing, local libraries, Android, and Linux more predictable under failures, races, account changes, and disappearing resources.

There is deliberately no headline feature in this release. The work since 0.2.8 concentrated on making existing features hold up when operations overlap or something goes wrong.

## Highlights

### Playback is harder to knock off course

Playback now handles a much wider set of awkward timing and failure cases without getting stuck, showing the wrong state, or letting an older track leak into the one you selected.

Among the fixes:

- Play after Stop reloads the current track instead of reviving an older source or hanging on Loading.
- Pause, seek, Next, queue changes, session restore, repeat-one, and audio-focus changes keep the latest listener action authoritative while a track is loading.
- A failed or stalled remote stream has bounded recovery instead of silently remaining in a playing/loading state forever.
- Missing local files are reported as local-file problems rather than network failures.
- A failed track cannot silently replace the title/state of the track that is actually playing.
- Finished queues, restored queues, repeat-one loops, and replaying a recently played song behave consistently.
- Automatic skipping remains bounded and visible rather than silently running through the queue.

### Downloads and smart pre-cache

Downloads and automatic caching now agree more reliably about ownership, cancellation, network policy, and account identity.

- Cancelling a download stays cancelled even when smart pre-cache overlaps it.
- A server error page cannot be saved as if it were an audio download.
- Downloads held for Wi-Fi start once the network policy allows them, including on Linux.
- A pre-cached copy promoted to a real download is not immediately treated as the oldest cache entry.

# Flutify 0.13

正式版，应用版本为 `0.0.13+13`。本版主要修复 macOS 窗口拖动问题。

## macOS 窗口拖动修复

- 修复搜索框上半部分会误触发窗口拖动的问题（[#18](https://github.com/is-hp-is-mad/Flutify/issues/18)，[#19](https://github.com/is-hp-is-mad/Flutify/pull/19)）：原生层关闭窗口的隐式拖动（`isMovable = false`），改由 Flutter 顶栏显式提供拖动区。搜索框内拖选、双击选词、清除按钮不再移动或最大化窗口。
- 宽窗口登录页补上专用拖动区，按钮避让交通灯，正文区域不会拖动窗口。
- 顶栏空白处拖动、双击最大化/还原保持正常。

## 下载

- Windows x64 / ARM64：安装版 `*-setup.exe` 与便携版 `.zip`。
- Android：arm64-v8a、armeabi-v7a、x86_64 和通用 APK，沿用此前的固定签名，可直接覆盖安装。
- macOS 12.0 及以上：`Flutify-v0.13-macos.zip`，解压后将 `Flutify.app` 放入应用程序目录。未做 Developer ID 签名和 Apple 公证，首次打开可能需要在系统设置的“隐私与安全性”中允许打开。
- 校验和见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

## 已知问题

- macOS 关闭隐式拖窗后，屏幕边缘分屏/平铺、多显示器拔插后的窗口恢复，以及所有页面与覆盖层顶部的拖动尚未完成实机验收，遇到拖不动的区域欢迎反馈。
- 从 v0.09 或更早版本升级时，旧版 Windows 更新器可能仍会失败；请手动运行新版安装包。
- Windows 原生 Widevine 许可证 HTTP 403 问题仍未解决；x64 保留实验性原生路径及加载失败回退，ARM64 继续使用 WebView2。


## What's Changed
* fix(macos): 禁用搜索框隐式拖窗并补齐登录页拖动 by @ClaudeByAnthropic in https://github.com/is-hp-is-mad/Flutify/pull/19

This release includes a patch.obb file containing the shared library required for virgl to work with GFOXSH's OpenGL patches applied. Furthermore there is also an updated APK included with a new "Apply Patch" button, a switch to enable virgl and a (hopefully working) fix for the INSTALL_FAILED_TEST_ONLY error when trying to install the APK.

If you have already installed the rootfs obb, you only need to download the patch.obb from this release, copy it to the same directory as the rootfs obb, install the new APK, open it and press the "APPLY PATCH" button to install the virgl patch.
Afterwards, you can enable the "use GPU" switch, start the VirGL Overlay app and the service and finally launch Wine. Note that you need to restart the virgl service when trying to run another program or trying to rerun the same program.
NB: in case virgl isn't working you might need to disable SELinux.

In case you don't have the rootfs cache installed, you need to follow the README.md instructions first and use the obb from the v1.0.3-alpha release. Afterwards you can follow the instructions given here.

release.name: Pyre 1.2.3 — reliability + quality
release.notes:
**The reliability + quality release.** 1.2.3 is a big one — it folds in everything since 1.2.1: a security + data-safety pass, a wave of roleplay-quality fixes, real new features you asked for, and a top-to-bottom hardening of multi-device sync. Driven directly by your reports and a full-app audit. Thank you 🔥

## Multi-device sync is now solid
The headline. A deep audit found ways your edits could silently fail to reach your other devices — and we closed all of them:
- An edit made just after your clock drifted (or an NTP correction) could be stamped "in the past" and become **invisible to your other devices forever**. Fixed with a monotonic revision clock end-to-end.
- A record could get stuck "always dirty," re-sending every tick but never converging.
- The sync hub now reports the **honest outcome of every pushed item**, so a record that didn't land is retried instead of being mistaken for "delivered."
- **Data now hits the disk before the sync cursor moves** on both sides — a crash mid-sync can no longer leave you with a moved cursor and lost data.
- **API-key sync is atomic**: a key is written to secure storage before it's adopted, so a storage hiccup can never leave you with a key that vanishes on restart.

Every one of these was reviewed line-by-line before shipping.

## Security & your data
- Your **API key is no longer sent to a provider's new host** after you change its URL — it's cleared at Test, Browse, and Save until you re-enter it.
- A **factory reset now warns** before any image that can't be backed up would be lost.
- **Backups are more complete**: in-progress character drafts and your BotBooru avatar's uncropped original are included, image types (MIME) survive a restore, and a corrupt attachment is caught instead of silently breaking. Backups now carry an integrity checksum.

## Roleplay quality

release.name: v0.5.3
release.notes:
## What's new in DreamPlayer 0.5.3


### Changed

- **Volume boost is now a gesture, not a slider.** Settings → Audio has a new
  **Volume boost** toggle (off by default). With it on, swiping up the right
  half of the player runs 0–200%: the first 100% is the system volume as usual,
  and past that the system volume stays at max while the extra travel becomes
  over-amplification up to 2×. Both old sliders — the player ⋮ sheet and
  Settings → Audio — have been removed, because a slider there could only set a
  value the gesture immediately overwrote.

  The boost **level** is session state and is never remembered: every video
  starts at 100% and you swipe past it deliberately, so a film never reopens at
  200% of its own accord. Only the toggle is saved. The system volume is put
  back where it was when the video closes, so boosting one film no longer
  leaves the phone louder everywhere — unless you changed the volume yourself
  while watching, which is left alone.

- **MPV respects volume boost again.** The MPV branch of the player returned
  before the audio settings were loaded, so "Play with MPV" started with the
  boost toggle read as off and night mode disabled, and the volume gesture was
  hard-clamped to 100%. The first two attempts to fix this chased the engine
  and the audio filter chain; the cause was one `return` in the wrong place.

  **On MPV the boost will still clip at high settings rather than limit.** mpv
  cannot be given filter options through `af` in this build — five forms were
  tried on device and every one was rejected, two of them silently — and the
  reference mpv player for Android (mpvEx, 2.7k stars) does the same thing:
  `volume-max` plus `volume`, with no limiter anywhere. Boost is smooth on the
  **native** engine, which is where boost is used by default.

- **Removed "Match MPV audio (FFmpeg)".** That switch was a diagnostic added
  while investigating the MPV volume gap, not a feature: it pushed the native
  engine onto libmpv

release.name: Swift Weather App 1.0.0
release.notes:
The first release of the cross-platform Swift weather application. One shared Swift core powers native UIs on Android, iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

### Highlights

- **Shared Swift Core** - All business logic, networking, data models, and persistence live in a single Swift Package (`WeatherCore`) compiled for every platform.
- **Android (Jetpack Compose)** - Full Material 3 UI with a city list, horizontal pager for swiping between cities, and autocomplete city search. Built using [Readdle's Swift Android Toolchain](https://github.com/readdle/swift-android-toolchain) to bridge Swift and Kotlin via JNI.
- **iOS / iPadOS / macOS (SwiftUI)** - A single SwiftUI codebase adapts to each form factor: `NavigationStack` with a pager on iPhone, `NavigationSplitView` master-detail on iPad and Mac.
- **OpenWeatherMap Integration** - Current conditions, hourly forecasts, and daily forecasts powered by the OpenWeatherMap API with in-memory caching (5-minute TTL).
- **Photon Geocoding** - City search with autocomplete via Komoot's Photon API, with 200ms debounce and parallel weather fetching for search results.
- **Persistent Storage** - Saved cities are persisted to a local JSON file with duplicate detection by coordinate proximity.

### Platforms

| Platform | UI Framework | Minimum Version |
|---|---|---|
| Android | Jetpack Compose + Material 3 | 10.0 |
| iOS / iPadOS | SwiftUI | 16.0 |
| macOS | SwiftUI | 13.0 |

### CI

Four GitHub Actions workflows validate every pull request:

- **MacCore** - Runs Swift core unit tests
- **AndroidApp** - Builds a signed release APK
- **iOSApp** - Builds the iOS app for Simulator
- **macOSApp** - Builds the macOS app

### Requirements

- Swift 6.2 toolchain
- Xcode 15+ (Apple platforms)
- [Readdle Swift Android Toolchain](https://github.com/readdle/swift-android-toolchain) (Android)
- An [OpenWeatherMap](https://openweathermap.org/api) API key
