release.name: Tatap v2.9.1 — Optimasi Ergonomi Gesture Kecerahan & Volume Pemutar Android
release.notes:
## Tatap v2.9.1

Pembaruan Tatap versi 2.9.1 memuat perbaikan ergonomi kontrol sentuh (*gesture controls*) pada pemutar video Android ([PlayerActivity.java](file:///home/b-ict/tatap/android/app/src/main/java/id/tatap/app/PlayerActivity.java)) untuk mengatasi masalah ketidaksengajaan terpicunya perubahan kecerahan atau volume saat pengguna mengusap layar untuk melihat bilah notifikasi atau jam.

### Perbaikan & Peningkatan

1. **Area Pengecualian Bilah Sistem (*Top & Bottom Exclusion Zones*)**
   • Menambahkan zona pengecualian di tepi atas ($\le \max(56\text{dp}, 16\% \text{ tinggi layar})$) sehingga usapan tarik ke bawah untuk membuka bilah notifikasi, memeriksa baterai, atau melihat jam tidak lagi memicu peredupan layar (*"tambah gelap"*) atau penurunan volume.

release.notes:
Three issues from the tracker in this one.

**Check in from the sharing notification (#35).** There is a new setting under Settings, Sharing, and it is off by default. With it on, the sharing notification has a Check in button next to Stop, so a check-in no longer needs the app open. A locked phone asks for the unlock first, the same rule Stop follows. The button cannot cancel an SOS: that stays in the app. The notification says "Checking in...", then that it worked, that it is queued, or that it failed, and the lock screen version shows none of that. This button has not run on a real phone yet, so please tell me how it behaves on yours.

**Your circle hears a plain check-in (#35).** A check-in used to raise nothing for the others unless it cleared an SOS. One you choose to make now shows "checked in" on your circle's phones once. A stale one never does, and older versions ignore it.

**Your pin no longer bounces between fixes (#34).** The app used to move your position to every fix as it arrived, so a vague network fix could knock the pin off a sharp GPS one. Now the sharper position holds. A vaguer fix that agrees with it only confirms it, and one that disagrees moves the pin only after the sharp source has been quiet for 20 seconds, never in still mode. The sharing report counts the fixes used, confirmed and set aside.

**Drag the circle panel from anywhere on it (#33).** A drag can start on any button and a plain tap still clicks. Half open, the list area moves the panel. Fully open, the list scrolls and a pull down from the top of the list collapses it. The SOS button never starts a drag, so holding it works as before.

repo.description: A library manager and installer for unofficial native game ports and recomps. Fully portable, with zero runtime dependencies, and compatible with Windows, Linux, and Android. Written in Rust. Requires a working OpenGL driver for the UI.

release.name: Ports Launcher
release.notes:
Library manager and installer for native PC ports and recomps of games, on Windows — a single native Rust binary + a bundled minimal 7-Zip (for extracting port releases), no setup wizard, nothing to install separately. Requires a working OpenGL driver for the UI. Full feature list and configuration in the [README](https://github.com/Nyaldee/Ports-Launcher).

This release is a **rolling "latest" build**: the asset below is replaced in place on every update instead of getting its own version tag. Always grab the newest `.zip` from this page.

## Install / Update

1. Download `Ports.Launcher.Windows.zip` (or `Ports.Launcher.Linux.tar.gz` on Linux) below.
2. Extract it — **if you're updating an existing install, extract into a separate folder first**, don't overwrite your current one blindly.
3. The zip ships with a default `ports.local.json` and `themes.json`. If you already have your own `ports.local.json` (your own local ports) or a customized `themes.json`, **back them up before overwriting** — extracting straight over an existing install will replace them with the defaults and you'll lose your entries/theme picks.
4. Once updated, copy your saved `ports.local.json`/`themes.json` back into the folder, then restart Ports Launcher to pick them up.
5. Run `ports_launcher.exe`.

`state.json` (installed ports, saved tokens, window state) is app-managed and safe to keep across updates the same way. `Library/` (your installed games) and `cache/` (cached box art) live alongside the executable and are never touched by the zip — leave them where they are when updating.

release.name: AimBuddy v0.3.0-beta.3
release.notes:
Release signing fix, correct in-app version reporting, and a 61% smaller APK.

### Fixed
- Installing a release APK failed with "App not installed as package conflicts with an existing package". The release build type was signed with `signingConfigs.debug`, whose keystore is per-machine and is regenerated from scratch on a clean CI runner, so every build carried a different signing certificate. Android keys an installed app on (`applicationId`, certificate), so no two AimBuddy APKs could be installed over one another. Release builds now use a dedicated, stable keystore supplied through `keystore.properties` or the `AIMBUDDY_KEYSTORE_*` environment variables.
- The ImGui window title and the Info tab reported `v0.0.0-dev` in every build. Gradle passed `AIMBUDDY_VERSION` to CMake as a cache variable, which the compiler never sees, and `CMakeLists.txt` never promoted it to a preprocessor define, so `utils/i18n.h` always fell through to its default. CMake now defines it for the compiler and warns if Gradle fails to supply it.

### Performance
- Release APK shrank from 32.59 MB to 12.66 MB. `proguard-rules.pro` carried a blanket `-keep class androidx.compose.** { *; }`, which disabled R8 shrinking across every Compose artifact and pinned the whole of `material-icons-extended` into the dex. The app references nine icons; dex dropped from 21.64 MB to 2.07 MB with all nine retained.
- Dropped v1 (JAR) signing. It is only consulted below API 24 and `minSdk` is 30, so its per-entry digests in `MANIFEST.MF` and `CERT.SF` were roughly 93 KB of dead weight. v2 and v3 remain enabled.

### Changed
- The release workflow now requires the signing secrets and fails instead of publishing an unsigned or debug-signed APK, verifies the APK signature after building, and prints the signer's SHA-256 fingerprint to the job summary so certificate drift is caught before release.
- Release assets are named `AimBuddy-v<version>.apk`; the misleading `-signed`/`-unsigned` suffix is gone.
- Local r

release.notes:
A new look across the whole app, a player that remembers where you were, and mrowser now tells you when an update is out.

## New look

**The address bar is a floating capsule.** Back, Reload and Home sit on the left, the address in the middle, and Favorite, the ad-block shield and History on the right. All of them use one set of line icons in place of the old system ones. The address shows the site name in white with the rest dimmed, and a lock on https pages. The blocked-ads count is a small badge on the shield.

**One focus style everywhere.** Buttons fill white when the remote is on them, list rows lighten with a soft outline, and favourite cards get a white ring. Red is kept for things that mean something: a setting that is on, a saved page, Delete and Exit.

**Dialogs, Home, Settings and History match.** Dialogs are rounded cards with pill buttons. Settings is grouped into Playback, Browsing and Favorites, with switches instead of red On/Off text. release.notes:
## ⚠️ Updating from v1.11 / v1.11.1

v1.11's signing key was lost, so v1.12 is signed with a **new, permanent key**. Android won't install it over v1.11.x. Do this **once**:

1. In v1.11.x, check that **≡ → Saves → Saves outside the app** is on. That is the `WindWakerHD Plus` folder at the top of your phone's storage. If it isn't on, use **Export saves** to a folder instead.
2. Uninstall v1.11.x and install v1.12.
3. Allow **Saves outside the app** when the app asks. Your save, save states and settings come back by themselves (or use **Saves → Import saves**).
4. Extract the game again (**Extract from your disc image or .wua…**). The game files are deleted with the old app. The game code is then prepared for your phone once more (5–15 min).

From v1.12 on, updates install directly over each other.

---

## What's new

### 🗺️ The item menu opens cleanly
With a widescreen picture, for about a second after opening the menu, a **black strip** showed at the left and the first page had a **left arrow** it shouldn't have. Both are gone from the first frame.

**Why it happened:** the menu is also drawn to the hidden GamePad picture until it has opened on the TV. A layout drawn to both screens was laid out for the GamePad's 16:9 screen, so its background didn't cover the wider picture.

### 🧭 Select opens the map
- A short press of the controller's **Select** opens the menu straight on the **MAP** tab.
- With the menu already open, it switches to the MAP tab.
- Holding Select (or Select + Start) still opens the app's settings.
- Turn it off in **Controls → Select opens the map**.

### 💾 Save states that don't get corrupted
- **Every part of the game's memory is saved.** Android moves memory the game hasn't touched for a while into compressed swap (zram). States only saved the parts still in RAM, so the swapped parts were missing and came back as zeros when loaded. That could break the game some time after a load. Saving is also faster (about 1 s), since the memory is scanned

release.name: Linked Camera v1.4
release.notes:
## What's new

### Now targets Android 16 (API 36)
Required by Google Play from 31 August 2026. `compileSdk` and `targetSdkVersion` are now 36, built with Android Gradle Plugin 8.10.1.

### Fixed: back button closed the app from settings
Targeting API 36 enables predictive back by default, which broke settings navigation: one press of back inside a settings sub-screen closed the whole app instead of going up one level, and `settingsClosing()` was skipped so the camera never resumed cleanly.

The preference fragments live on the *framework* FragmentManager back stack, which only `Activity.onBackPressed()` pops. With predictive back the system dispatches to the AndroidX `OnBackPressedDispatcher` instead, where none of the registered callbacks is enabled while settings are open. Fixed with the documented `android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="false"` opt-out. This is temporary; the structural fix is migrating the preference fragments to AndroidX.

### Fixed: preview settings not applied immediately (#9)
Display-only settings now call `DrawPreview.updateSettings()` directly.

## Tested
Verified on a Samsung SM-S908B running Android 16 (SDK 36) with the minified release build: back navigation at every level, photo capture, video recording, paused preview, edge-to-edge rendering, and a simulated 617dp large screen.

Not covered: the Bluetooth LE remote (needs the physical remote) and Nextcloud/WebDAV upload (needs a reachable share).

repo.description: Using OpenCv's Android Camera2(JavaCamera2View) with OpenCV 4.10.0-4.14.0

release.name: Release CvCameraMobile - OpenCV 4.14.0 - Version 2.0.0 - Git Hash 12e2f5d
release.notes:
Updates OpenCV to **4.14.0** and reworks the camera screen so every capability lives in its own pluggable file.

## New

- **Flash torch** with per-camera availability checks (#15). Torch needs `CONTROL_AE_MODE_ON`, since under OpenCV's default `CONTROL_AE_MODE_ON_AUTO_FLASH` auto-exposure owns the flash and `FLASH_MODE` is ignored.
- **EXIF orientation** written into saved photos, so landscape shots display correctly in galleries instead of appearing sideways.
- **Rotating control icons**. The bottom bar stays anchored to the physical bottom and only the icons turn with the device.
- **Effect picker** replacing tap-to-cycle: a single-choice dialog with "No Effect" first. Posterize and Vignette are now reachable; they were implemented but unreachable before.
- **Resolution picker** listing every supported size with aspect ratio and megapixels.
- **Canvas fill mode**. Switch between fit (letterboxed) and fill (centre-cropped) with no camera restart.
- **Shutter feedback**: screen flash plus the system shutter sound on capture.
- **FPS/resolution overlay** redesigned as a tinted chip, inset clear of the status bar and toggleable from the menu.

## Fixed

- **Selected camera resolution is now honoured.** `CameraBridgeViewBase` clamps the requested size to the preview surface, so any request larger than the view was silently discarded and only downscaling worked. The preview was stuck at 960x720 on a 1080x2340 screen despite the sensor offering 4080x3060.
- **Cartoon effect crash.** `bilateralFilter` accepts only `CV_8UC1` or `CV_8UC3`, while camera frames are `CV_8UC4`, so selecting the effect killed the camera thread.
- **Resolution list mismatch.** The picker enumerated `getOutputSizes(SurfaceTexture.class)` while OpenCV negotiates against `getOutputSizes(ImageReader.class)`; an offered size could be rejected.

# NexHub v3.2.0（正式版）

> 四合一媒体聚合客户端（动漫 / 漫画 / 小说 / 影视）—— 源即插件 · 共创社区。

---

## 🎉 正式版说明

NexHub **3.2.0 正式版**来了。这是鸿蒙（HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony）适配正式落地的一个版本：arm64 真机完整支持，与 Android 对齐源解析、播放、弹幕、画中画、朗读、投屏等核心链路；同时新增 iOS 未签名构建、内置免费翻译（Bing），并恢复投屏、莫奈壁纸取色、音量键翻页等能力。**基础功能完整、可安全升级。**

> - **这是什么版本**：3.2.0 正式版；Android / Windows / Linux / macOS / iOS / 鸿蒙六平台产物统一发布在同一个 Release。
> - **数据兼容性**：经代码核查，**无破坏性数据变更**——书架 / 收藏 / 进度 / 书签 / 历史 / 分组直接沿用；旧源 JSON 无需修改、无需重新导入；沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。历史记录与收藏、下载任务会在首次启动时自动迁移到独立文件存储，过程无感、旧数据保留兜底。
> - **鸿蒙安装方式**：HAP 统一不带签名，请用端侧签名工具自行签名后安装（或 DevEco Studio / hdc 侧载）。

> ⚠️ **本应用不内置任何内容源**，首次打开是空的，这是正常现象。请先导入至少一个源 JSON（应用内「源管理 / 导入源」）才能看到内容。源由社区共享维护，请自行评估其合规性与内容合法性。

---

## ✨ 本次更新内容

### 📱 鸿蒙（HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony）正式支持

- **四合一聚合与「源即插件」架构完整移植**：源导入与解析全链路可用，**内嵌 JavaScript 脚本源同样可跑**（自研 QuickJS 原生桥）；漫画 / 小说 / 影视阅读观看完整。
- **视频播放**：libmpv 内核（与 Android 同源），支持倍速 / 音轨 / 字幕 / 外挂字幕 / 防盗链头，弹幕同屏渲染；播放内核默认开启，亮度 / 音量手势控制升级到内置鸿蒙平台官方实现。
- **系统能力对齐**：画中画小窗（含控制面板）、系统通知（RSS 等）、**图片保存进系统相册**（系统确认框、免权限）、**剪贴板图片粘贴**（原生 pasteboard）、系统级「另存为」导出。
- **朗读**：系统 CoreSpeechKit 离线引擎（中文、语速、后台朗读、播放完成续读），也可配置自建在线 HTTP TTS。
- **阅读器音量键翻页**：原生按键通道，支持长按连续翻页。
- **投屏恢复**：设备发现改走原生 mDNS（`_googlecast._tcp`），播放器顶栏投屏入口恢复。
- **莫奈取色**：接入系统壁纸主色并**实时跟随**壁纸变化，页面切换与回前台不重复取色。
- **ECH 加速随 HAP 打包**：本地 ECH/DoH 代理引擎以 FFI 接入，应用级 / 源级 / Bangumi ECH 均可用。
- **数据持久化**：历史 / 收藏 / 下载任务改独立文件存储，应用强杀不丢。
- **平台差异（仍存在）**：本地文件夹导入改「导入文件」逐个选择；自定义下载 / 截图目录仅限应用私有目录与系统「下载」；插件与备份导出走系统分享；播客后台通知栏暂不可用；模拟器（x64）不支持视频播放与 ECH。

### 🍎 iOS 支持

- 新增 **未签名 IPA** 构建（与 Android / 鸿蒙共用包名），侧载后用 AltStore / Sideloadly 等工具自签安装。
- 全平台显示名统一为 **NexHub**。

### 🆓 内置免费翻译

- **无 AI 配置也能翻译**：详情页标题 / 标签 / 简介 / 评论、小说与字幕默认走内置免费翻译，失败或不可用时自动回退已配置的 AI。
- 连续失败自动熔断（静默 5 分钟）避免反复无效请求；术语表、非标准风格等高级需求命中时自动切 AI 优先。

# Hotspot Bypass VPN v6.0.0

First **stable** release since v5.0.0. Contains the fix for the long-standing multi-device
bug, plus console sharing and the refreshed client UI that were previously only available
in beta builds.

---

## 🐛 Fixed — second device had no internet (#13)

**Root cause:** the SOCKS5 proxy running on the host phone used a bounded work queue
(`LinkedBlockingQueue(10000)`) together with a fixed core pool size of 100.

Java's `ThreadPoolExecutor` only grows beyond `corePoolSize` **once the queue is full**.
With a 10,000-slot queue that effectively never happened, so the pool stayed pinned at
100 threads and the configured `maximumPoolSize` was dead weight.

The failure chain:

1. The first device opens dozens of long-lived connections (browsers and apps do this
   constantly), occupying all 100 worker threads.
2. The second device connects — TCP is accepted, so **the device reports "connected"**.
3. But its task is only enqueued. With no free thread, it never runs.
4. The SOCKS5 handshake never completes → **"connected, but no internet."**

This is why the symptom always hit the *second* device while the first worked fine.

**Fix:** replaced the queue with a hand-off queue (`SynchronousQueue`) and an abort
policy, so worker threads now scale on demand up to 256. Also added per-client
connection accounting (128 concurrent connections per device IP) and explicit rejection
metrics instead of silent queueing.

**Verification:** covered by the repository's integration test suite. The regression
test — `perClientAndGlobalLimitsPreserveCapacityAndReleaseItAfterDisconnect`, which
includes a `secondDevice` case — fails with a `SocketTimeoutException` during the SOCKS
negotiation when run against the old configuration, and passes against the new one.

# VanCamera v1.0.0 Release Notes

**Release Date:** January 29, 2026

## Overview

VanCamera transforms your Android phone into a high-quality, low-latency webcam for Windows. This is the first official release, featuring secure connections, automatic device discovery, and native integration with popular video conferencing apps.

## Features

### Cross-Platform Support
- **Windows Application** - Native Windows installer with all dependencies included
- **Android Application** - Supports Android 7.0+ (API 24)

### Connection Modes
- **USB Mode** - Lowest latency, most reliable connection via ADB port forwarding
- **WiFi Mode** - Wireless freedom with automatic mDNS device discovery

### Video Streaming
- **Hardware H.264 Encoding** - Efficient encoding using device hardware
- **Real-time Optimization** - Frame dropping and low-latency processing
- **Multiple Resolutions** - Support for various video presets
- **Front & Back Camera** - Switch between cameras with proper orientation handling

### Security
- **TLS 1.3 Encryption** - All video streams are encrypted end-to-end
- **Certificate-based Authentication** - Secure device pairing via QR code

### Native Integration
- Works with any DirectShow application:
  - Discord
  - Zoom
  - Microsoft Teams
  - Google Meet
  - OBS Studio
  - And more...

## System Requirements

### Windows
- Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
- OBS-VirtualCam driver (installed automatically)
- USB cable or WiFi network (for connection)

### Android
- Android 7.0 or later
- Camera permission
- USB debugging enabled (for USB mode)

## Installation

### Windows
1. Download `VanCamera-Setup-1.0.0.exe`

### Outgoing Caller ID (CLIR) Privacy
- **Outgoing Number Masking (CLIR)**: Added a master toggle to withhold Caller ID on outgoing calls so recipients see Private/Unknown number.
- **Carrier Standards & Custom Prefix**: Built-in support for global carrier prefixes including `#31#` (GSM standard), `*67` (US & Canada), `141` (UK), `1831` (Japan), and full custom prefix input.
- **Hardware SIM Settings Direct Shortcut**: Added a direct launcher button to open Android's native SIM Calling Accounts screen for hardware-level carrier caller ID configuration.

### Call Recording Engine Hardening
- **Idempotent Recording Lifecycle**: Implemented atomic state tracking (`AtomicBoolean`) preventing race condition crashes between UI disposal and telephony teardown.
- **Decoupled Database Persistence**: Decoupled Room database insertion from `InCallService` lifecycle, ensuring finished recordings are 100% saved even after rapid call teardown.
- **Safe Container Finalization**: Added graceful MediaRecorder buffer flushes before storage auto-deletion checks to prevent ghost or truncated recordings.
- **Self-Healing Storage Recovery**: Opening Call Recordings settings automatically discovers and indexes any orphaned `.m4a` files on disk with zero data loss.
- **Runtime Audio Permission Flow**: Explicit Android microphone permission orchestration with non-intrusive user prompts.

repo.description: Static recompilation of the Sega 32X game Knuckles' Chaotix into native C++ (Windows/Linux/macOS/Android), with true widescreen. Bring your own ROM; no game data included.

release.notes:
This release adds a widescreen HUD, a reachable Mods folder on Android, and a reorganised OPTIONS menu.

- **HUD at the screen edge ([Issue #28](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/ChaotixRecompiled/issues/28)):** in widescreen levels, SCORE, TIME and RINGS now sit at the left edge of the widened picture instead of the 4:3 area.
  - The positions are immediates in the SH-2's own HUD code, and only those are changed. Game state is identical (68K RAM compared over 3000 frames), and lockstep validation still passes.
  - **OPTIONS > VIDEO > WIDE HUD** turns this off. It is on by default.
- **Mods folder on Android ([Issue #29](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/ChaotixRecompiled/issues/29)):** on Android 11 and later, file managers cannot open `Android/data`, so mods there could only be added from a computer.
  - **OPTIONS > EXTRAS > MODS FOLDER** asks for Android's "All files access" (the storage permission before Android 11).
  - Once access is granted, the Mods folder is `ChaotixRecompiled/Mods` in the phone's storage. Mods are reloaded when you return to the app.
  - Until then, the old folder is still used.
- **OPTIONS in categories:** OPTIONS had grown to about twenty rows and ran off phone screens. It is now four short pages:
  - **VIDEO:** widescreen, wide lobby, wide HUD, aspect ratio, scaling, smoothing, screen, V-sync.
  - **SOUND:** sound, volume, music, effects.
  - **INPUT:** touch pad, 6-button pad.
  - **EXTRAS:** cheats, Mods folder, awards, reset awards.

  BACK and Escape return to the page above.
- **CHEATS page fixed:** since 0.4.0 the CHEATS page showed the awards page by mistake, so its switches could not be seen. It now shows its list.

Thanks to @lemanrush and @DoodleDiskette for the requests.

Validation:
- **Windows:** all 27 CTest cases pass, including a new lockstep run with the HUD at the edge and new menu tests that check every OPTIONS page fits and that the CHEATS page can be tapped.
- **Linux:** all 24 Linux CTest cases pass.

repo.description: A local music player that understands what your library sounds like: on-device neural shuffle and rediscovery for the music you already own. Android + iOS, Kotlin Multiplatform, Apache-2.0.

release.name: LatentJam 0.9.2
release.notes:
Make LatentJam look the way you like: your own accent colour, pure black, rounder or sharper shapes, five page-header styles and a left-handed layout. Statistics now show how you listen, not only how much, several playlists import at once, and seeks and skips no longer click. Still fully on-device: no account, no catalogue, no network. Nothing about your listening leaves the phone.

### New
- 🎨 **Appearance settings** ([#18](https://github.com/Nikita-sud/latentjam/issues/18)). Pick your own accent colour, or keep the colours from each song's cover. Choose pure black for OLED screens, rounder or sharper shapes, how strong the colour cloud behind the player is, the cover as the player's backdrop, the mini player's style, and five styles for the page header. A left-handed layout moves the alphabet rail and the shuffle button to the left. Every menu, sheet, dialog and control now shares one look. The look is part of your local backup.
- 📊 **Statistics that tell how you listen.** Besides how much: what is on repeat right now, favourites that are slipping away, what you played a year ago, songs you play in sequence, new versus familiar music, your sessions and the hours you listen. release.name: v0.1.1
release.notes:
# SearchLauncher 0.1.1 — smoother keyboard transitions and fewer tab reloads

## What changed

- **Less jumping when typing on websites.** The browser now resizes the page once when the keyboard opens or closes, and changes toolbar visibility at the same moment. This reduces repeated movement of bottom navigation bars and avoids resizing Gecko on every keyboard animation frame.
- **A clearer bottom bar.** A subtle 1px line separates browser controls from the page, using a light or dark tint that follows the bar's colors.
- **Tabs stay open through more settings changes.** Switching dark mode, language, font size or display settings no longer unnecessarily reloads normal browser tabs. Favorite sites and installed web apps are kept ahead of other tabs when deciding which pages to reclaim; Android can still stop them under memory pressure.
- **Browser startup reliability.** Fixed an optimized-build crash involving Gecko's debug configuration parser and disabled that debug-file feature in production.
- **More useful diagnostics.** Feedback reports include tab-reload reasons and the most recent available main-thread ANR stack to help diagnose remaining freezes and reloads.

## Updating

This is an update to the regular SearchLauncher app. No data reset is needed when updating from 0.1.0. If upgrading directly from a WebView-era release, launcher settings, favorites and bookmarks are preserved, but website cookies and site sessions do not migrate to Gecko.

The keyboard regression was reproduced on a plain fixed-footer page: three opening/closing cycles produced 31 viewport-height changes in 0.1.0 and six after the fix. These are emulator measurements, not a claim of verified Xiaomi frame rates.

Remote background Web Push and credential-provider passkey restrictions remain unchanged from 0.1.0.

release.name: Hikari AdBlock v1.2.3
release.notes:
**Hikari AdBlock** — free, open-source, no-root Android ad blocker.

## What's new in v1.2.3

### Shizuku mode now fails fast and tells you why

- **Added a clear error dialog for Shizuku mode.** If your ROM and kernel deny
  permission for `iptables`/`nftables`, Shizuku mode can't work on your device.
  Previously the app could sit on "Connecting..." and silently retry for a very
  long time before giving up with no real explanation. It now detects the block
  immediately and explains exactly what happened.
- **One-tap "Switch to Direct (VPN) mode".** The blocked dialog now has a button
  that switches you straight to Direct (VPN) mode and starts protection, so you
  still get ad blocking even when Shizuku is unavailable on your ROM.
- **Added a pre-flight probe.** When you select Shizuku mode, the app now runs a
  single cheap, read-only netfilter command first. If the ROM/kernel refuses it,
  you're told right away and the service is never started, so no filters are
  fetched and no retry loop runs.

### Under the hood

- The pre-flight probe is used from the Settings toggle, from the power-button
  toggle, and when a pending Shizuku start is retried after returning to the app.
  The service also runs the same probe as a safety net.
- Filters are loaded exactly once before the retry loop, so retries no longer
  re-fetch or re-seed the filter lists.
- Bumped the version to 1.2.3 (versionCode 7).

> If your ROM and kernel deny `iptables` permission, Shizuku mode cannot work on
> your device. Use **Direct (VPN) mode** (the dialog can switch you over with one
> tap) or the **root** backend instead.

## 📥 How to download
- **`app-universal-release.apk`** — works on every phone (pick this if you're not sure)
- **`app-arm64-v8a-release.apk`** — most modern phones (recommended, smaller download)
- `app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk`, `app-x86-release.apk`, `app-x86_64-release.apk` — other CPU types

repo.description: New Super Mario Bros. Wii running natively on Android and Windows: a static recompilation built on WiiCompiled. Bring your own game.

release.name: NSMBW 0.1.1: V-Sync, done right
release.notes:
**This'll be the last update for a while as I attempt to decompile the game starting today, unless someone reports an issue.**

**V-Sync is back, done right.**

- **V-Sync (Windows).** A new switch at the bottom of the Video tab, off by default. On, the picture never tears: each frame waits for the display, and the game's own clock follows the display's real refresh, one frame per refresh on a 60 Hz screen, one every third refresh at 180 Hz. Because the two clocks stay in step, frames never pile up waiting for the display, so it no longer slows the game down the way V-Sync in 0.0.10 did (a World 5 tower test that dropped 232 frames then drops none now). Displays whose refresh isn't a whole multiple of 60 (75 Hz, 144 Hz) still get tear-free frames, but keep the game's own 60 Hz clock.
- It can be switched on and off while playing.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own **New Super Mario Bros. Wii (USA, `SMNE01`, revision 1)**, extracted with Dolphin. See [Getting the game files](https://github.com/WitherBlitz/NSMB-Wii-Multiplayer-Recompilation#getting-the-game-files).

release.notes:
# Melodex v0.7.29 — macOS startup hotfix

This maintenance release fixes a macOS startup crash introduced in v0.7.28.

## Fixed

- Guard the early Qt `WindowStateChange` callback during window geometry restoration, before the playback feature is initialized. This prevents the `AttributeError: 'MainWindow' object has no attribute 'playback_feature'` crash on launch.
- Add a regression test for window-state events occurring during startup geometry restoration.

## Testing

- Mac owners: replace v0.7.28 with the v0.7.29 installer appropriate for Apple Silicon or Intel, open Melodex, and confirm it reaches the main window and can start playback.
- Automated tests and packaged startup checks must complete successfully before considering the release verified.

## Installation

Download the correct macOS `.dmg` asset from this release. If macOS blocks the unsigned application, use Finder's **Open** context action and follow the macOS security prompt. Only bypass the warning if you obtained the installer directly from this project's official GitHub release.

release.name: v0.3.2
release.notes:
The home screen can now be taken apart, and the light themes are pastel instead
of white. Both came out of [#1](https://github.com/metehankaygsz/dashline/issues/1)
— thanks to @GrayLanterns for the write-up.

## Turn sections off

- **The favourites row in the top bar is optional.** Customize → Favourites →
  Slots now starts with **Off**. With your apps already pinned to a card, the
  row was a second copy of them; without it the bar shrinks back to the home
  button and the Wi-Fi indicator.
- **Any section can be removed.** Both cards, the clock, the weather and the
  Android Auto / CarPlay tiles each gained a **Hidden** option.
- **What's left grows into the space.** One card takes the whole column when the
  other goes, a column with no cards collapses, and the clock panel disappears
  once nothing in it is showing — no gaps where a section used to be.
- Widgets on a hidden card are kept, not released, so turning the card back on
  brings them back.
- The Clock panel dialog now opens in landscape too. Hiding works either way up;
  only replacing the clock or weather with a widget is still portrait-only.

## Pastel light themes

- **The light gradients were near-white, and read as glare rather than colour.**
  Each one now carries the hue of its dark counterpart a few shades up, so
  switching modes changes a theme's brightness rather than its identity —
  Forest is a soft green instead of a hint of one.
- The gradient alone wasn't the problem: cards were near-opaque white and did
  most of the glaring, so surfaces let considerably more of the colour through.
  Text contrast was checked against the deeper backgrounds.
- The album-art tile was a fixed blue in light and a fixed navy in dark, which
  clashed with every theme that isn't blue. It takes the colour behind it now,
  in both modes.

## Install

```
adb install -r dashline-v0.3.2.apk
```

Or copy the APK to a USB stick and open it with the unit's file manager. From
v0.3.0 onward the launcher can offer this

release.name: TVAutoPlayer V1.5.0
release.notes:
# TVAutoPlayer V1.5.0

V1.5.0 增加多个每日时间段的独立图片/视频播放列表。规则支持跨午夜、总开关、单条停用、冲突拦截和约 30 秒边界检查；未覆盖时段继续使用原默认列表。

## 主要变化

- 新增电视遥控器可操作的时间段总览与编辑页。
- 每条规则可配置开始/结束时间、启用状态和独立混合媒体列表。
- 开始时间包含、结束时间不包含；结束早于开始表示跨午夜。
- 启用规则不能重叠，相邻时间段允许保存。
- 播放中只在有效规则来源变化时重建队列，普通检查不打断当前媒体。
- 仅有未来时间段且默认列表为空时，开机可进入等待状态并到点播放。
- V1.4.0 及更早配置直接兼容，升级后时间段功能默认关闭。
- Android 版本升级为 `versionCode=9`、`versionName=1.5.0`。

## 安装

下载 `TVAutoPlayer-v1.5.0-debug.apk` 后侧载，或执行：

```powershell
adb install -r .\TVAutoPlayer-v1.5.0-debug.apk
```

相同 Debug 签名可覆盖安装并保留设置。不同签名需要卸载旧版，会清除应用设置但不会删除媒体。

## 验证范围

- 中英文资源一致性与中文 UI 硬编码检查。
- 时间匹配、跨午夜、冲突检测、解析优先级、配置容错和旧配置兼容单元测试。
- Android Lint、Debug APK 构建、包清单、权限、ZIP 对齐、v1/v2 签名和 SHA-256。

真实电视上的 U 盘索引、遥控器焦点、边界时间精度、厂商开机限制和长时间循环仍需目标设备验收。

## 发布说明

当前 APK 使用 Android Debug 证书，适合侧载测试、展厅、门店和内网设备。正式批量部署请改用企业固定 Release 证书，并安全保管密钥。

### Improvements

#### Remote library updates survive network drops

When the connection to a remote (S3) library dropped during an update, for example a phone switching networks or Wi-Fi going to sleep, every song read at that moment failed, and a few seconds offline could mark hundreds of songs as unreadable. Now the update notices the outage, shows "Connection lost, waiting for it to come back…" and waits up to 5 minutes, then continues where it stopped. A remote library that cannot be listed is named in the update summary instead of being silently skipped.

If an update did not finish (the app was closed, or the connection stayed down), Settings, Music Library shows a warning, and a warning icon appears on the section header even while it is collapsed. Files that cannot be read at all (for example a damaged file) are now named in the update summary, up to three of them, so you can find and fix them. The result of the last update is now kept across restarts.

#### Android: library updates keep running in the background

With nothing playing, Android froze the app soon after it left the screen, so a large library update stopped half way and the rest of the songs stayed missing. Updates now keep running with the screen off or another app open, with a notification showing their progress; it disappears when the update is done.

Starting a radio station, podcast or remote song can take a few seconds while it connects. The play button now shows a spinner until the music starts, instead of looking like nothing happened. Clicking it stops the stream.

# Release Notes — Mai-An Lab v2.0.0

This release adds Deezer as a second source next to Qobuz, rebuilds auto-play as a resumable station with PAGA-style genre journeys, makes queue sync between Python and the Android player self-checking, keeps playback and long library jobs alive in the background, introduces an interactive split network canvas, adds infinite scroll, and replaces the metadata wizard with a multi-source workbench.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The bundled `flet_audio_service` extension moved to **v0.2.21**. Build with `fresh_build_android.sh` (or `.ps1`); an incremental build keeps the old Dart and Kotlin code.

## New Features & Key Highlights

### Deezer Support
* **Second Source**: Search, preview and download from Deezer alongside Qobuz. A Qobuz/Deezer switch sits above the search results, each source keeps its own results when you flip between them, and rows carry a source badge.
* **Sign-In**: Deezer uses the ARL cookie from a logged-in browser session (Settings → Account, or the set-up wizard). You only need credentials for one source; search opens on whichever is set up.
* **Plan-Aware Quality**: If your Deezer plan can't serve the quality you pick, the download drops to the best it can (FLAC → 320 kbps MP3 → 128 kbps MP3) and is saved with the right extension. Turn off `lower_quality_if_not_available` in the config to get an error instead.
* **Decryption While Downloading**: Deezer's encrypted CDN streams are Blowfish-decrypted as they arrive instead of being buffered whole, so a large FLAC can't run an Android phone out of memory.
* **Same Tags Either Way**: Deezer metadata is normalised to the same tag layout as Qobuz (album artist, disc numbers, cover art), so downloads from either source look the same in the library.
* **Optional Dependency**: `deezer-py` and `pycryptodomex` are imported defensively. A build without them still starts and still does Qobuz; Deezer reports what is missing.

### Search & Downloads
* **Download Dock**

release.name: AmneziaGuard 0.4.1 — a slow upload no longer freezes other apps
release.notes:
A robustness fix on top of 0.4.0 (which reached throughput parity with the
stock client). Same speeds, steadier under real mixed traffic.

**What changed**

The app's upload was forwarded to the tunnel with a blocking write on the
one thread that reads every app's packets. If the tunnel couldn't keep up,
that write stalled — and froze packet processing for *every* app at once
(a background upload could hang your browsing). Each connection now drains
its upload on its own thread, so a slow flow slows only itself.

A speedtest never showed this (it runs download then upload, never both);
it takes real mixed traffic — a background upload while you browse — to
notice, and that now stays responsive.

Throughput is unchanged from 0.4.0. Installs over it; app data is preserved.

release.notes:
# v0.2.1 — Game folder detection fix, Android crash reports

A small fix release on top of 0.2.0. Gameplay, settings, network code and co-op patches are unchanged.

## Fixes

- **Black screen when `gow2.exe` is opened directly.** Without `--game_data_root`, the game looks for the disc folder next to the exe and up to four folders above it. It used to take the first folder with a `default.xex` in it, even one with nothing else (a loose XEX, or another Xbox 360 game's dump), and then booted to a black screen with every game file missing. Now a folder counts only when it has both `default.xex` and `GearGame`; otherwise the search goes on, and if nothing is found the game asks for the folder once and remembers it in `gow2_game_path.txt`, as before.

## Diagnostics

- **Android crash reports** (SDK patch 0014). When the app closes on a memory fault, the log (`gow2_*.log`) now names the signal and its code (SIGSEGV or SIGBUS), the faulting address, where in the libraries it happened, and the state of the game's memory page. If the Android build crashes on your phone, attach that log to an issue: it should now be enough to find the cause. This follows [issue #1](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/issues/1).

## Verified on 2026-10-16

PC (Windows 11, RX 7800 XT): opening `gow2.exe` with no arguments next to a decoy folder that holds only a `default.xex` finds the real game folder and boots to the intro movies; the decoy is skipped.

## Known limits

Those of 0.2.0. Everyone in a session should run 0.2.1 (mixed versions not tried).

## Downloads

- `gow2-recomp-0.2.1-win64.zip` (Windows x64; no game files; no DLSS) with `gow2-recomp-0.2.1-win64.zip.sha256` (7939BC9D2071EF04CAEA767FD9FA8425B6700237F9DFA088B30A8DC43C4AAB2B).

repo.description: Installs and updates Android apps straight from their developers, and checks every file first. Phones, tablets and Android TV.

release.notes:
Most of this release is about picking the right file and saying less. A failure that keeps happening is said once, and on Android 12 and later nobody can start an install from a locked phone's notifications.

- F-Droid lists one build of a version for each processor. Tern took the arm64 one, so an armv7 television or an x86 tablet got an error row while its own build was listed right below. The build that fits the device now goes first.
- An app a few releases behind shows the notes of every release since the installed one, under "What's new since", newest first, ten at most.
- A publisher's checksum is found in more of the places publishers put it, such as `app.apk.sha256.txt` or `checksums_sha256.txt`. A bare sum counts only from a file made for that one download.
- Release notes keep what the developer wrote: `a < b and c > d` keeps its middle, `app_arm64_v8a.apk` keeps every `_`, and a link at the end of a sentence leaves out the full stop.
- A filter pattern that ran past its deadline is not started again while its earlier run still spins.
- Download progress redraws four times a second and its notification once a second.
- Downloads that nothing in the list will ask for again are cleared out at start and after a check of the whole list.
- A download waits up to a minute when the server asks it to.
- Settings says when Android last ran the background check, and what holds it back when something does.
- A retry after a failed background check waits for the same Wi-Fi and charger conditions as the check, and none is set while background checks are off.
- With Orbot off, or a proxy on this device not running, a background run stops once with one log line and one retry instead of failing every app. Nothing goes direct.
- A failure that repeats is logged and notified once. What Tern keeps to know that is a fingerprint of the app id and the reason, never a name.
- Installs waiting for the system's confirmation sit under one summary that makes one sound.

repo.description: Run 32-bit Android apps on 64-bit-only ARM phones: open-source ARM32 -> ARM64 native code translator and app launcher

release.name: ZettaBridge 0.1.0
release.notes:
Run 32-bit Android apps on phones that have no AArch32.

**What works.** Orange Roulette (2014, Haxe/OpenFL): menu and gameplay with sound. Flappy Bird (AndEngine): playable. APK import as a plugin, a home-screen shortcut, GLES 2.0 and 3.0, EGL, assets, input.

**What does not.** Games built on `NativeActivity` (Unity, pure NDK) do not start. Vulkan is not supported. Apps that need real installation are out of scope.

**How to use it.** Install the APK, import a game's APK in the launcher, launch it. If a game fails, long-press it, pick "Last run report", and attach the report to an issue.

**Tested on** a OnePlus 13 (Snapdragon 8 Elite), OxygenOS 16. No other device has been tested.

---

Запуск 32-битных приложений Android на телефонах без AArch32.

**Что работает:** Orange Roulette (2014, Haxe/OpenFL) — меню и игра со звуком; Flappy Bird (AndEngine) — играется. Импорт APK как плагина, ярлык на рабочем столе, GLES 2.0 и 3.0, EGL, ассеты, ввод.

**Что не работает:** игры на `NativeActivity` (Unity, чистый NDK) не запускаются; Vulkan не поддерживается; приложения, требующие настоящей установки, вне области проекта.

**Как пользоваться:** поставить APK, в лаунчере импортировать APK игры, запустить. Если игра не пошла — долгое нажатие, «Last run report», и пришлите отчёт в issues.

**Проверялось на:** OnePlus 13 (Snapdragon 8 Elite), OxygenOS 16. Другие устройства не проверялись.

release.name: Release 2.8.0
release.notes:
﻿# Release v2.8.0

本项目是一个基于 Android 的网易云音乐第三方播放器，支持搜索、播放、歌词显示以及特色的悬浮窗歌词功能。

## 🚀 版本更新说明

- 悬浮歌词窗口现在分别记忆横屏与竖屏各自的位置，旋转屏幕时直接恢复对应方向的记忆位置，不再基于另一方向的位置换算。
- 连续旋转两次（转回原方向）可精确回到旋转前的位置，修复此前位置逐次偏移（漂移）的问题。
- 拖动悬浮窗仅更新当前方向的位置记忆；隐藏后重新显示（如切回应用再切出）位置保持不变。
- 位置恢复增加屏幕尺寸校验，折叠屏、分屏等屏幕尺寸变化时回退到默认位置，避免错误恢复。
- 旋转完成后自动复核窗口位置，规避系统配置回调与实际屏幕旋转不同步导致的偶发偏移。
- 修复悬浮窗宽度同步变化时未刷新窗口布局的问题。

## ✨ 主要功能

### 🎵 网易云音乐集成

- **歌曲搜索**：支持搜索并播放网易云音乐曲库。支持通过名称搜索，或直接使用歌曲 ID 解析。
- **歌单与详情**：查看歌曲详情、专辑信息及播放列表，支持添加快捷方式、一键解析播放。
- **账号支持**：支持设置 `Music_U` Cookie 进行登录，解锁更高音质选项。

### 🎧 音乐播放器

- **完整控制**：支持播放、暂停、上一曲、下一曲。
- **播放模式**：支持列表循环、单曲循环、随机播放、顺序播放。
- **后台播放**：支持后台服务运行，切出应用仍可继续听歌。
- **批量下载**：支持自定义下载功能，可批量下载歌曲。
- **本地音频支持**：支持自动扫描本地音频文件、手动添加本地文件并直接播放。
- **歌曲收藏**：支持在应用内收藏歌曲，本地音频和网易云歌曲均可加入收藏。
- **听力保护**：提供智能听力保护，开启后连续听歌达到设定时长会自动暂停提醒休息。

### 🗂️ 数据与设置

- **数据导入导出**：支持将设置、主页快捷方式等使用数据加密导出与导入，便于备份和迁移。导出按钮位于设置界面右上角。
- **一键重置**：支持在设置中一键恢复全部默认设置，保留 `Music_U` 登录信息。
- **主题切换**：支持跟随系统、浅色、深色三种主题模式。

### 💬 歌词系统

- **同步歌词**：应用内主界面显示同步滚动歌词。
- **悬浮歌词 (Floating Lyrics)**：
  - 支持在其他应用上层显示歌词。
  - 可调节字体大小和颜色。
  - 提供迷你播放控制栏。
  - 支持锁定模式（防误触）和折叠/展开视图。

## 📱 系统要求

- **Android 版本**：`Android 12.0 / API Level 26.0` 及以上。
- **必要权限**：
  - 悬浮歌词需“显示在其他应用上层”权限。
  - 软件运行需“发送通知”、“读取设备音频”及“悬浮窗”权限。
- **网络连接**：解析网易云音乐需要网络连接。

## ⚠️ 免责声明

本工具仅供学习交流使用，非网易云音乐官方应用，请支持正版音乐。使用本工具时请遵守相关法律法规，尊重音乐人的劳动成果。

A release about playlists that leave the app, and words that take over the player.

nearly twice the size of the ones around it, the verse moves up under it as the song goes, and
tapping a line jumps there. A song with no words anywhere keeps its cover, so the setting can stay
on.

other player and every desktop program reads, naming files rather than database rows, so a rebuild of
Android's media database can no longer scramble them. Playlists you had are converted on the first
launch and the old file is kept. Any `.m3u` on the device can be imported, any playlist exported, and
**songs go in in bulk**: a whole album, artist or genre from its long-press menu, or any number of
songs from a searchable list on the playlist itself.

**Shuffle shuffles the queue.** It used to leave the queue in album order and jump around it, and
could stop the album halfway when its hidden order ran out. Now it rearranges the queue itself, so
what you see is what plays, and turning it off puts the original order back. **"Play next" puts it
next**, every time.

**Long tracks come back where you left them.** Settings → playback → resuming takes a length; a
track at least that long reopens at the exact moment the app was closed. Made for podcasts and
audiobooks; off by default.

release.name: GameCore 3.8.1 — Eight official plugins
release.notes:
## GameCore 3.8.1 — Eight official plugins

GameCore's plugin system now comes with a first set of **GameCore-made plugins**. Like every plugin, each one is **data only** — GameCore reads it and renders it; nothing in a plugin runs code on your device.

### The eight plugins
- **Nothing OS Gaming** — a Nothing-OS-style theme.
- **Anime Interface Pack** — an anime-inspired theme with reference screens.
- **Sensitivity Lab Pro** — a workspace for recording and comparing sensitivities.
- **Automation History** — a read-only view of the automations GameCore has already run for you.
- **GameCore Personal OS** — a personal dashboard.
- **Local Gaming Advisor** — on-device tips drawn from what GameCore already knows.
- **Benchmark Suite** — a benchmark readout.
- **Dashboard Composer** — compose your own dashboard from the widgets GameCore offers.

All eight are **bundled in the app** and also attached below as sideloadable `.gcplugin` files.

### New in the host
- **Plugin settings you can change.** A plugin can offer its own options — switches, choices and numbers — and GameCore stores and applies them. The controls live in GameCore; the plugin still runs nothing.
- **Automation history, shown by a plugin.** A plugin you allow can display the record of automations GameCore has run. It reads that history only to show it — it is handed none of your other data.
- **Live readouts on plugin screens.** Plugin screens and dashboard widgets can show figures GameCore already measures — frame rate, temperature and the like — each drawn by GameCore from data you have allowed.

### Install
Download **`GameCore.apk`** below. The eight plugins ship inside it; the attached `.gcplugin` files are there if you'd rather install one from a file (Settings → Access and tools → **Plugins**). Everything from earlier releases works unchanged.

## 2026-10-20 重新构建（OriginOS 修复）

- **OriginOS 6 锁屏 / 息屏断播修复**：设置页「允许后台运行」改为拉起系统电池优化豁免弹窗（REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS）；播放中 onPause 后调用 WebView.resumeTimers()，并保留 WakeLock + 媒体前台服务。
- 版本号仍为 **1.4.5**（versionCode 10405），资产同名替换；旧包请删除后重装或直接覆盖安装。

---

## v1.4.5 — 跟随系统 · 睡眠定时器 · 歌词逐曲偏移 · 锁屏持续播放 · 右划两次退出

### 新增
- **主题跟随系统**：外观三档「深色 / 浅色 / 跟随系统」；系统切换深浅色时界面、状态栏与导航栏实时跟随（无需重启），冷启动按系统外观解析。
- **睡眠定时器**：设置页可选 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 90 分钟或「播完当前曲停止」，实时显示剩余时间、可随时取消；到点先淡出再暂停（保留进度），锁屏/后台按绝对时间戳计时。
- **歌词逐曲偏移**：每首歌独立保存偏移（±0.1s / ±0.5s），全局值作为新歌默认；新增「对齐」一键校准、「归零」、随时导入本地 LRC；同名 `.lrc` 仍优先于在线歌词。
- **锁屏 / 熄屏持续播放**：原生 `PlaybackGuard` 插件在播放时持有 WakeLock，播放中不暂停 WebView；设置页新增「电池优化设置」入口（来电/其他应用/拔耳机由系统与 WebView 处理）。
- **右划两次退出**：首页第一次右滑提示「再滑一次退出」，2 秒内第二次退出；有页面历史时先返回。

### 修复
- **播放无声 / 无法播放**：不再重复申请音频焦点（WebView / Chromium 已持有焦点，重复申请会被判 LOSS 而暂停）。
- **息屏 / 切后台崩溃断播**：恢复 `super.onPause()`，不再触发 `SuperNotCalledException`（Capacitor `KeepRunning` 默认 true，WebView 不会被暂停）。
- **「跟随系统」不生效 / 提示不刷新**：改为原生推送 `uiMode` 并派发事件，JS 重新解析主题；设置页同步重渲染。

### 资产
- `EndfieldMusicTerminal-v1.4.5-release-lite.apk`（约 1.85 MB，不含预置歌曲）
- `EndfieldMusicTerminal-v1.4.5-release-full.apk`（约 97.6 MB，含 14 首预置曲目）

安装：`adb install -r <apk>`，或手机直接打开安装（同一签名可覆盖升级）。真机验证：锁屏/熄屏播放连续（媒体会话持续 `PLAYING`），跟随系统深浅色双向切换正常。

- The helper app, its accessibility service, and its notification reader are labeled **Android-Use** (they were "AU Bridge", "AU semantic Android control", and "AU notification reader"). - The install scripts install the newest release (they were fixed on 1.0.0) and support every platform below. `ANDROID_USE_VERSION` still pins a version.

- `au emulator install` runs Google's `sdkmanager` for the missing emulator package and system image, attached to your terminal so you read and accept the SDK license.
- `cargo xtask emulator-e2e`: create, start, set up, read and act, a refused second serve, restart with enrollment intact, snapshot save and restore, in one run.

release.notes:
## 1.1.3 — 2026-10

### Fixed

- **Legacy WebView rendering loop (Issue #2, completion).** Pages whose JavaScript can't be parsed by very old WebView engines (roughly Chrome ≤71, common on Android 7–8 with no WebView updates available) previously caused an endless cycle of white screens and reloads. After three consecutive failed renders, a circuit breaker now trips and parks the app on the loading page — permanently, until a single re-attempt after a 10-minute cooldown. The reload loop can no longer repeat endlessly.
- **Retry counter stalling.** The host-retry attempt counter now increments when a retry is scheduled rather than after its delay elapses. Rapid successive connection failures can no longer erase the counter's progress, so backoff advances correctly (5s doubling to a 5-minute cap) instead of restarting from the beginning on every failure.
- **Stacked fallback loops.** All render-failure witnesses (connection errors, empty-body detection, page watchdog) now record through a single code path, and waiting-page fallbacks are debounced to one per failure event. Duplicate recovery loops can no longer pile up during flapping connectivity.
- **Network watcher no longer reloads on stale data.** The network-recovery poller only reloads the URL after confirming connectivity at the end of the poll cycle, instead of blindly firing a doomed reload after the wait budget was exhausted.

### Changed

- **Page load watchdog is now observational.** A page that takes longer than 20 seconds no longer gets interrupted with a fallback — slow is not dead. Empty-content detection is the sole basis for intervention, and it now requires two probes 5 seconds apart, and accepts visual elements (canvas, SVG, images, video, iframes) as evidence of a live page in addition to text.
- **Auto-refresh suspends on persistent render failure.** While the render-failure count is elevated, the auto-refresh timer stands down rather than feeding the failure loop.

- **Infinite scrolling.** Swiping on from the last home page brings the first one back, and swiping back from the first page brings the last, following your finger, requested in #5. It is on by default; turn it off under Settings ▸ Home screen ▸ Infinite scrolling. Dragging icons and widgets is unchanged: a drag never wraps, and holding an icon at the right edge still opens a new empty page. If you have chosen a Left edge app, the swipe right on the first page keeps opening it, so the first page then wraps only forwards.

- **The ends of the pages.** With infinite scrolling off, or with a single page, a swipe past the last page no longer slides onto an empty page that then slides back (#7). Both ends now stop with Android's edge stretch and say "No more pages". The empty page past the last one is only for dropping icons.
- **Page dots on light wallpapers.** The dots and the home-page marker have a soft dark shadow, so they no longer vanish on a light wallpaper.
- **TalkBack and Switch Access.** Paging at either end does what a swipe does: it wraps when infinite scrolling is on, and otherwise stops and says "No more pages".

- **Better Chessnut play.** Improved discovery, remembered board selection, named connection messages and reconnect handling. release.name: Calibrate SoC 0.3.9-alpha — steps aside for ANY performance app, not just known ones
release.notes:
**AutoTDP now backs off for any app that's actually running your performance — even one it's never seen — while staying careful not to touch your tune for normal apps.**

### Backs off for any performance app, not just a known list
- **AutoTDP now stands down for any tuner or game runtime that's controlling performance**, even one it doesn't recognise by name. Before, it only backed off for a built-in list (your game runtime, Winlator, a couple of named tools); now it also spots an unfamiliar app *by behaviour* — one that holds the special system-tuning permission (`WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`) **and** is actually overriding your clocks. When that happens it reverts to stock and pauses, then resumes on its own once the app is gone. The screen shows "Suspended — another performance app appears to be in control."
- **Won't trip on normal apps.** It only treats an unknown app as "in control" when it *both* holds that tuning permission *and* is genuinely changing your clocks right then — plus it isn't a game, isn't one you've set up a profile for, and isn't Calibrate SoC itself. So an automation app like Tasker that you granted the permission to (for button-mapping) won't pause your tune just by being on screen. The known-app list still works too, as an instant shortcut.

### Same safety as always
- Purely additive. Temperature and battery cut-offs are unchanged; backing off only ever returns your device to stock clocks.

Adversarially reviewed · 2911 tests, 0 failures · debug-signed alpha.

release.name: RedTerm v2.2.0
release.notes:
### Highlights

- **A freshly installed distro now keeps the permissions the distribution chose.** Installing
  used to flatten every directory to `0755`, so `/tmp` stopped being world-writable with its
  sticky bit, `/root` was loosened, and every pacman transaction on Arch and ARMtix reported
  the difference:
  `warning: directory permissions differ on /tmp/ filesystem: 755 package: 1777`.
- **openSUSE is no longer reconfigured on every launch.** The repository aliases, the libzypp
  service and `RepoManager.db` are all left exactly as the image ships them, because they were
  never the fault.
- **Four distributions were silently running with none of the setup applied.** Oracle, Fedora,
  AlmaLinux and Rocky ship a `/root` this app could not write into, so the prompt and the whole
  first-time setup had never landed on them. See Fixed.
- **Twelve more distributions**, bringing the catalogue to twenty, all built from upstream by
  this project and checksum-verified before installation.
- **SFTP is documented as what it is** — a home-screen tool that browses a saved server
  without a distribution installed.

### Fixed

- **Installing a distro discarded the file modes in the image.** The install path `chmod`'d
  every directory to `0755` as it created it and reduced every file to "executable or not" —
  it read the mode out of the archive and then threw it away. Restore has always preserved
  modes correctly; install had its own extractor and it was the one that was wrong. The
  published images were correct throughout, so no change to how they are built could ever have
  fixed it.
- **A setgid directory lost its bit.** The mask now keeps setuid, setgid and sticky instead of
  discarding them, and directory modes are applied after their contents rather than on
  arrival — a directory the archive records as `0555` cannot have children created inside it
  if its mode is set first.
- **The post-install permission repair is gone.** It existed only to undo the bug abov

release.name: Dsh Box v1.0beta16 —— 顶栏按钮不再挡手，并修掉冷启动秒退
release.notes:
## Dsh Box v1.0beta16 —— 顶栏按钮不再挡手，并修掉冷启动秒退

一个把完整 Linux 沙箱和 AI 编程助手直接装进安卓手机的单文件 App：不用 root、不用电脑、不用先装 Termux，装完点开就能用，手机里的文件它还真能读写。

> **提示**：本版主要解决「右上角按钮挡住网页自己的 ✕ / 收起按钮，点不到」的问题，并修掉了一个从 v1.0beta15 起就存在的冷启动闪退。建议所有用户升级到本版。

### 一、本版修复

- **右上角的「设置 / ⋯」不再挡手**——上一版把按钮做成原生浮层后尺寸稳定了，但它常驻屏幕右上角，正好压住网页自己的控件（面板收起按钮、弹窗的 ✕），原生视图在上层，那一下点击网页收不到，表现就是「✕ 点不了」。本版做了三件事：
  - **常态只留一枚 40dp 的小把手（⋯）**，点它才展开「设置 / ⋯」，4 秒后自动收回——常态遮挡面积缩到最小；
  - **自动让位**：每秒检测一次把手底下是不是网页自己的可点控件（按钮 / 链接 / 输入框 / 小图标），是就自动往下挪一槽（共 4 个槽位），网页那边空出来它会自己回到顶部；
  - **长按把手 = 手动往下挪一槽**（此后不再自动让位），觉得碍事就长按把它挪开。
- **冷启动偶发闪退**（v1.0beta15 起存在）——应用被系统销毁重建的瞬间，第一个实例的界面回调会晚一步执行，撞上已经销毁的网页视图导致崩溃（表现为点开图标立刻回到桌面）。本版给所有涉及界面的回调加了统一兜底与空值判断，并留下诊断日志；实测反复冷启动不再闪退。

### 二、小贴士：浮层怎么用

- 平时右上角只有一个小小的 `⋯`；**点一下**展开「设置」和「⋯」两颗按钮，**长按**则把它往下挪一槽。
- 它自己会看情况挪开：如果网页右上角正好有按钮（比如面板的收起图标），把手会自动让到下面去。
- 想彻底收起来只用网页本身，展开后不理它，4 秒自动收回。

### 三、界面观感：从「网页映射」变成「像 App」

- **界面缩放（按电脑比例排版）**——竖屏按 760px、横屏按 1280px 的桌面视口渲染再整体缩放，字号栏宽都是电脑上的样子；设置里可单独开「文字放大」。
- **屏幕方向四档**——自动旋转 / 跟随系统 / 竖屏锁定 / 横屏锁定；横屏按电脑比例重新排版，不是把内容拉扁。
- **沉浸式全屏 + 手势条分开管**——「上抬界面」与「去掉小白条」两个独立开关，手势导航与三键导航都适用。
- **网页缩放模式开关**——关掉后手指拖动只滚动内容，不再被当成拖动网页/双指放大；默认关。
- **右侧滚动条整条删掉**——WebView 原生滚动条 + 网页 CSS 滚动条两处一起掐掉，连回弹光晕一起去掉，静止与滑动时都不再出现。

### 四、安装包加固

- **签名自校验（封条）**——每次启动校验自身签名证书指纹；被重打包、重签名、二次修改过的包启动时直接拒绝（提示「无法启动」后退出）。
- **自带脚本改为加密资源**——自有脚本在包内以密文存放，解密密钥由「包名 + 签名证书指纹」派生：换签名者即使拆包也解不开。
- **代码混淆**——功能实测无损，包体与上一版持平（约 176 MB），启动速度不受影响。

### 五、老功能不变

装完点开就用（首次启动离线）· 手机存储真通（`/mnt/sdcard`，`DCIM`/`Pictures`/`Movies`/`Android` 默认只读）· 五档权限（自动/无障碍/Root/Shizuku/基础）· 同一 Wi-Fi 下用电脑浏览器操作 · 会话与凭据导入导出 · 常驻通知保活 · 进入设置页不再导致沙箱无限重启 · 清除数据后不再网页全白 · WebView 崩溃自动重建、沙箱掉线自动拉起。

### 六、安装与限制

- 从旧版**覆盖安装即可，数据保留**（包名未变，`versionCode 1000015`）。
- 仅支持 **arm64、Android 8.0+**。
- 首次启动解压约 1~2 分钟，建议预留 2 GB 以上空间。
- MIUI / HyperOS 建议手动授予自启动权限。
- 沙箱内 `apk add` / npm 安装的内容位于应用私有目录，卸载 App 会一并删除。

### 七、校验

```
sha256  1EA7FA22EB8A391BFAA29FE266CC9B0A8197C3C8EFBD5219B658D1DA6C800E48
md5     692B84F0137A8A7E8198F5AE99035FC7
```

release.notes:
## 多機錄影 v0.6.1

這一版處理 v0.6.0 發佈後的回饋：開始錄影前就知道每台會錄多大、刪掉的影片都放得回去，也多了示範用的模式。

### 開始錄影前就知道每台會錄多大

- 手機錄不到選的解析度時，會改用它能錄、又不超過所選的最高解析度。以前要等錄完，看影片清單上的大小才知道；現在**開始錄影前**，那台的卡片上和「錄影規格」選單裡就會寫出來，例如「這支手機錄不到 4K，改用 1080p 錄」。手機的 App 要更新到 v0.6.1 才看得到這個提醒。

### 刪掉的影片都放得回去

- 在 macOS 上一次刪掉同一段好幾台的影片時，只有第一支能在垃圾桶裡「放回原處」；現在每一支都可以。
- 刪完的提示上多了「打開垃圾桶」（Windows 是資源回收筒）。刪錯了就點進去，對影片按右鍵選「放回原處」（Windows 是「還原」），影片會回到專案資料夾。

### 錄影資料夾

- 在「設定」選了或貼上別的資料夾，**還沒按儲存**就會寫出那裡剩多少空間、硬碟格式和能不能用。以前要按了儲存才會更新。
- 把欄位清空再按儲存會被擋下來。以前錄影資料夾會變成程式所在的資料夾。

### 示範第一次怎麼設定：`npm run demo`

想向別人示範怎麼設定時，先在開著的終端機按 `Ctrl`＋`C` 關掉多機錄影，再執行 `npm run demo`。控制台會從剛安裝好的樣子開始，沒有手機、也沒有專案；示範時的配對和設定只是暫時的，原本的都不會動到。示範完按 `Ctrl`＋`C`、再執行 `npm start`，每支手機重新掃一次 QR Code，名稱和影片清單都還在。

### 介面

- 「開始使用」畫面在寬螢幕放在中間；視窗窄的時候，按鈕移到說明下面，說明不會被擠成一行幾個字。

### 更新方式

- **電腦**：在 `multicam-recorder` 資料夾執行下面三行，配對、專案和設定都會保留。

  ```sh
  git pull
  npm install
  npm start
  ```
- **手機**：下載 `MultiCamRecorder.apk` 直接安裝，會覆蓋舊版，配對和設定都會保留。電腦端更新後，還在用舊版 App 的手機連上時，控制台會提醒並顯示下載的 QR Code。舊版 App 照樣能用，只是看不到上面的解析度提醒。

> 自己用原始碼編譯、裝過 debug 版的話，簽章不同，不能直接覆蓋：請繼續用 `npm run android:build` 和 `npm run android:install` 更新，或先解除安裝再裝這一版。解除安裝會刪掉 App 裡的影片，請先確認都已經傳到電腦。


release.notes:
## What's New in Version 2.3 — Convergence & SML Audio Intelligence Release

Welcome to **Void Player 2.3**! This release marks the convergence of the mobile and desktop platforms, featuring an on-device Small Machine Learning (SML) audio intelligence engine, upgraded Android 16 support, LRCLIB synchronized lyrics auto-fetching, hardware DSP audio controls, and the brand-new native Windows 11 WinUI 3 desktop client.

---

### Highlights & New Features

#### 1. Embedded Small Machine Learning (SML) Vector Engine
* **Multi-Feature Vector Space Modeling**: Categorizes local tracks across 12+ genre semantic centroids, acoustic energy vectors, tagged tempo (BPM) closeness, and lexical title/album token matching.
* **Continuous Acoustic Energy Extraction**: Computes normalized intensity scores ($0.08 \dots 0.98$) combining genre baselines, embedded ID3/FLAC tempo (BPM), and track duration dynamics.
* **Temperature-Scaled Softmax Calibration**: Normalizes feature distance scores through temperature-scaled softmax ($T=12.0$), yielding calibrated confidence ratings ($45\% \dots 99\%$) and eliminating unclassified fallback buckets.
* **100% On-Device & Private**: Runs entirely in local background coroutines. Zero cloud inference, zero network dependencies, and zero telemetry.

#### 2. Harmonic DJ Smart Flow Progression
* **Acoustic Transition Scoring**: Intelligently sequences continuous playback by evaluating mood continuity, acoustic energy delta, and tempo variance:
  $$\text{FlowScore}(A, B) = \text{MoodContinuity}(A, B) \times 0.45 + (1 - \Delta\text{Energy} \times 1.5) \times 0.35 + \left(1 - \frac{\Delta\text{BPM}}{60}\right) \times 0.20$$
* Prevents abrupt energy jolts or tempo collisions during continuous playback sessions.

#### 3. Void AI Insights ("My Vibe Wrapped")
* Computes your library's musical persona (*The Midnight Wanderer*, *The High-Drive Dynamo*, *The Deep Focus Architect*, *The Neon Cruiser*, *The Acoustic Vagabond*, *The Heavy Soni

release.notes:
# OmniTune 1.6 Release — Official iOS Launch & Multiplatform Debut

We are thrilled to announce **OmniTune 1.6**, marking the official debut of OmniTune on Apple iOS! 

Powered by **Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)** and **Compose Multiplatform**, OmniTune brings its modern music player experience, rich YouTube Music streaming engine, and synchronized lyrics to iPhone and iPad devices—while preserving independent release cycles and uninterrupted stability for our Android community.

---

## 🚀 What's New in 1.6

### 📱 Official iOS Debut (`iosApp`)
- **Native iOS Target**: Complete, standalone native Xcode application target (`iosApp`) leveraging SwiftUI and Compose Multiplatform.
- **Apple AVFoundation Audio Engine**: Native background audio playback powered by Apple's `AVPlayer` and `AVAudioSessionCategoryPlayback`.
- **System Media Integration**: Full Control Center, Lock Screen, and Dynamic Island controls via `MPRemoteCommandCenter` and `MPNowPlayingInfoCenter` with live artwork, elapsed time, and scrubber seeking.
- **Background Playback**: Seamless background streaming with automatic route-change handling (auto-pauses when headphones disconnect).

### 🎨 Signature SuvMusic Experience on iOS
- **SuvMusicTheme & Palettes**: 5 expressive color schemes (Default/Purple, Ocean, Sunset, Nature, Love) with dynamic accent adaptation.
- **Outfit Variable Typography**: Clean, expressive Material 3 typography scaled specifically for mobile displays.
- **Continuous-Curvature Squircles**: Smooth iOS-style rounded geometry (`SquircleShape`) applied across cards, search bars, and action chips.
- **Pure Black AMOLED Mode**: Deep contrast optimized for OLED displays with WCAG AA compliance.
- **Signature Player Suite**:
  - MiniPlayer with smooth rotating vinyl album art animation and marquee text.
  - Full-screen Expandable Player Sheet with album hero backdrops.
  - 9 visualizer waveform seeker styles with live playback progress.
  - Modern Reorderable Queue with equalizer animations

release.notes:
## First Release of 8-Puzzle

**8-Puzzle** is a **sliding puzzle game** that features a walkthrough of the optimal solution and allows users to customize the tiles using photos selected from their Gallery. In finding the optimal path from the current puzzle state to the goal state, the system employs the informed search algorithm A* and uses Manhattan distance as an admissible and consistent heuristic to estimate the cost. 

Inspired by an exercise in our Mobile Development class, I started creating this app during our university break, after finishing my second year of undergraduate studies. As one of my first personal projects, working on this was an opportunity to synthesize concepts and practices that I learned from our sophomore courses, such as:
- Exploration of language features (Advanced Programming and Theory of Programming Languages)
- Program optimization (Algorithms and Complexity)
- Artificial intelligence and search algorithms (Introduction to Intelligent Systems)
- Quality assurance and unit testing (Introduction to Software Engineering)

This project also utilizes a continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline — which is the focus of our third-year class Advanced Software Engineering.

The API documentation can be viewed at [https://memgonzales.github.io/sliding-puzzle/](https://memgonzales.github.io/sliding-puzzle/)

release.name: EmuTran v0.3.4
release.notes:
## v0.3.4

### Added
- **BIOS Helper.** A new guided screen (from the Dashboard) that shows, per system, exactly which BIOS files you still need, the folder to drop them in, and whether the files you've placed are verified-good against known reference hashes — so you can tell a good dump from a bad one at a glance. EmuTran never provides BIOS files; this only inspects your own.
- **ROM sorter.** A new tool that scans your device for game files you've already copied over (Downloads, SD card, anywhere) and offers to move them into the correct `Emulation/roms/<system>/` folders by type — with a "needs your choice" bucket for ambiguous formats. Every move is explicit and confirmed; files are never deleted unless the move fully succeeds, and nothing is ever downloaded.
- **Resilient downloads.** When an emulator's latest release is unavailable (a dead or moved source), EmuTran now automatically falls back to an older release from the same trusted source before giving up, and tells you when it did — so a rotted source no longer dead-ends a setup. Integrity verification still applies on every fallback.

### Fixed
- **Security:** the Dashboard "Install" button now verifies downloaded APKs against their SHA-256 checksum, matching the setup and update paths (it previously installed unverified).
- Shizuku installs of large/verbose APKs could deadlock on "Installing…" — fixed the output-draining order so they no longer hang.
- GPU driver downloads are now written atomically (no more corrupt half-written driver zips on a disk-full or network drop), with a retry on transient failures, and the driver-discovery call is now cached so repeated setups don't burn the GitHub rate limit.
- The emulator catalog cache and manifest are now written atomically, so a process kill mid-write can't permanently corrupt them.

release.name: Ravenpass 0.3.0 Beta
release.notes:
This update adds a trash, a password generator, breach checks, password merging and card autofill in Chrome.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Update Ravenpass on every device that opens your vault. Once an item is in the trash, or you change how long the trash keeps items, Ravenpass 0.2.0 and earlier can't open the vault.

## What's new

- **Trash.** Deleting an item moves it to the trash, and the notice offers Undo. Restore items, delete them for good or empty the trash in **Vault settings → Trash**. The trash keeps an item for 30 days; choose 7, 90 or 365 days there instead.
- **Password generator.** Open the generator from the rail, or from the toolbar on a phone, or generate a password while you edit one. By default it makes five capitalized words with a digit. Choose 3 to 10 words instead, or 8 to 64 characters with the digits and symbols you set, and leave out look-alike characters such as `I`, `l` and `1`.
- **Generator history.** The passwords you copy or use from the generator stay in a history on this device for 30 days. Change the period or turn the history off in **Settings → Privacy**.
- **Breach checks.** Turn on **Check for breached passwords** in **Settings → Privacy** and Ravenpass marks the passwords found in known breaches, lists them first and warns you on the item and in the editor. It sends Have I Been Pwned the first 5 characters of each password's SHA-1 hash, never the password. Breach checks are off until you turn them on.
- **Merge passwords.** **Merge with another password** in a password's header combines two passwords into one. You choose what to keep where they differ, passkeys move over, and the other password goes to the trash.
- **Card autofill in Chrome.** Card number, holder, expiry and security code fields open a menu of your cards. One choice fills the whole checkout, billing address included, and never the card's PIN. Every card fill asks for Touch ID or your PIN first, whether or not fill confirmation is on. Cards fill on `https` pages only.

# PassPony (Android) 2.0.0

2.0 adds passkeys, SSH remotes and key backups, and lets several phones share one passage store without copying a secret key between them.

- **Passkeys** (#4): save a passkey for a site in your browser and sign in with it. It is stored as a `passkey:` line in that site's entry, encrypted with your keys, so it syncs and backs up like the rest of the store and works in PassPony on iPhone too. Android 14 and later, in browsers on Google's privileged browser list; a request from another app is turned down with an explanation, because confirming an app's claim to a site would mean contacting that site.
- **SSH remotes**: sync over SSH with an Ed25519 key made in the app or an imported key. Hosts are trusted on first use and a changed host key is refused.
- **Key backups**: save every key on the phone (age identities, imported OpenPGP keys, the SSH key) to one `.passpony` file locked with a recovery code, and restore it on a new phone. Passphrase-protected age identities files can be imported (#10, #11), and importing now adds identities instead of replacing them.
- **Phones sharing a store**: after a sync, clone or publish, each phone adds its own public key to the store's root `.age-recipients`. When another phone's key shows up, PassPony shows it and asks before re-encrypting your entries for it (Re-encrypt, Remove key, or Later). Entries a phone can't read are left for the phone that wrote them.
- **One-time codes**: HOTP counters (`pass otp` compatible), and import from a Google Authenticator export QR code, with a confirmation for each scanned code of a multi-code export.
- The unlock grace window now counts its five minutes from when you leave the app.
- The backup recovery code has a copy button.

release.notes:
# NetValve v1.0.0 — Release Notes

**Release date:** July 24, 2026
**Tag:** `v1.0.0`
**APK size:** ~60 MB (loopback) / ~67 MB (netstack)

---

## 🎉 NetValve v1.0.0 — First Public Release

NetValve is a **root-free, local-VPN per-app traffic controller for Android**. This is the first public release — a complete, working application with all core features functional.

---

## ✨ Features

### Traffic Shaping
- ✅ **Per-app bandwidth limits** — set download/upload caps per app (KB/s, MB/s, kbps, Mbps)
- ✅ **Token-bucket pacing** — smooth, accurate rate limiting with burst tolerance
- ✅ **Suspend-to-pace, not drop** — TCP backpressure + bounded UDP queue; protects VoIP, gaming, streaming
- ✅ **DNS exemption** — name resolution never throttled (latency protection)
- ✅ **Live, no-busy-wait** — efficient coroutine-based design

### App Control
- ✅ **App blocking** — cut all network access per app
- ✅ **Time-based schedules** — e.g., block after midnight
- ✅ **Day-of-week schedules** — different rules for weekdays vs weekends
- ✅ **Foreground/Background rules** — different caps based on app state
- ✅ **Condition-based policies** — Wi-Fi/mobile/roaming/charging/battery/screen/foreground

### Monitoring
- ✅ **Live throughput** — current, average, peak (per app)
- ✅ **Connection counts** — active, throttled, blocked
- ✅ **DNS stats** — query counts and cache state
- ✅ **Connect latency** — measured per protected socket
- ✅ **Per-app totals** — persistent across restarts
- ✅ **Leveled logging** — DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR with filtering and export

### Platform
- ✅ **Root-free** — works on stock Android, no Magisk/KernelSU
- ✅ **Local-only** — no remote server, no telemetry, no trackers
- ✅ **Material 3 UI** — Jetpack Compose, dark/light themes
- ✅ **Battery-aware** — Doze exemption guidance, OEM-specific deep links
- ✅ **Boot persistence** — re-arm tunnel after reboot (opt-in)
- ✅ **VPN coexistence** — graceful `onRevoke` handling

# New TSuki Update — What’s New

### Playback that doesn’t stop

* The screen no longer turns off while you’re watching videos.
* If a song fails, the app automatically retries it, so you no longer have to leave and come back.
* Songs continue playing with the screen off, with no pauses between tracks.
* Your headphone and smartwatch buttons can now skip to the next track.

### Your music, your way

* When you open the app for the first time, you can choose between **Videos + Music** or **Music Only**, and change it anytime in Settings.
* In **Music Only** mode, videos and subscriptions are hidden. Everything opens in Music and plays in audio-only mode.
* The initial questionnaire can now be skipped and has been given a cleaner look.

### Queue and Radio

* Reordering songs in the queue is now properly respected during playback.
* Skipping ahead no longer gets stuck or accidentally jumps to the next song.
* Starting a radio no longer restarts the song that was already playing.

### Karaoke Lyrics

* No more strange `v1:` prefixes, stuck-together words, or unwanted characters.
* Word-by-word highlighting now follows the vocals continuously.

### Subscriptions

* The **Videos** and **Shorts** filters now display the correct content.
* **Not interested** instantly hides a channel, with the option to undo it.

### Videos

* Dragging to enter fullscreen now works in both portrait and landscape, with a normal progress bar.
* Thumbnails no longer appear at the sides when using original-size mode.
* You can now disable Shorts recommendations in Settings.

### For your car and with friends

* **Android Auto:** anything you start playing from the car is now added to your phone’s queue.
* **Listen Together over Wi-Fi** now reconnects properly.

release.name: BayesianBahn 0.4.0
release.notes:
### Added
- **A forecast for trains whose run number is too new to have one.** IRIS gives
  every run its own number and renumbers at each timetable change, so a train
  that has run for years can arrive with almost nothing behind it: over eleven
  collected days a quarter of arrivals fell through to a class-wide prior that
  knows neither the station nor the hour. Those trains still have a line, and
  the line has run all along. `pipeline/build_shards.py` now publishes a second
  set of shards keyed by line and station, and the app reads one when — and only
  when — the train's own history comes up short. Walk-forward over 781,000
  archive events at 62 stations, on exactly the events the prior answers today,
  the line scores 0.43 min of CRPS better (95% 0.40..0.46, resampling whole
  trains) with a shard available for 88% of them; across the December 2025
  timetable change, where the population doubles to 11% of events, the same
  0.41. Regional and S-Bahn both gain; long distance almost never carries a
  line number, so there is nothing to say about it either way. The screens say
  which line the numbers came from rather than claiming they are this train's.

### Changed
- **A reported delay is now an anchor with an admitted error, not a promise.**
  0.3.0 took DB's live delay and adjusted it by what the train's own past runs
  did; where DB reported nothing it used history alone. The adjustment was the
  weaker half. A report is now the centre of its own distribution, widened by
  the error such reports are measured to carry at that much notice — fitted on
  82,482 arrivals, and asymmetric, because a train that has lost time rarely
  makes it back. The connecting train's departure report is treated the same
  way, so a change is the difference of two admitted errors rather than one
  distribution against one promise. Scored against DB over the same thirteen

release.name: AzureQL v2.3.5
release.notes:
# AzureQL v2.3.5 — What’s Changed / 更新内容

## 中文

客户端版本：**AzureQL 2.3.5**

服务端兼容目标：**青龙 2.22**

### 功能：支持青龙服务端版本 2.22

- 配置文件详情接口迁移到 v2.22.0 的 `/api/configs/detail?path=...`，避免继续调用已经废弃的旧路径。
- 认证请求收到 HTTP 401 时只清除失效 Token，继续保留用户授权保存的密码、Client Secret 与 mTLS 证书材料，便于重新认证。
- 修改密码或 2FA 状态成功后主动使旧会话失效，避免继续使用服务端已经撤销的 Token。
- 备份恢复健康检查现在可识别 HTTP 503，并显示调度服务暂不可用的明确提示。

### 日志可靠性

- 通用日志读取适配 v2.22.0 的有界 `offset`、`limit` 与 `tail` 响应。
- 任务从运行态进入终态后，会继续按游标排空全部剩余日志分页，避免遗漏最后几页或重复追加完成信息。
- 长系统日志滚动和正文顶部下拉刷新已在 Android 16 真机上通过验证，刷新期间不会误唤起输入法。

### 首页与通知渠道

- 首页“今日成功”和“今日失败”现可查看对应任务、命令、执行次数及已删除状态。
- 通知设置加入青龙 v2.22.0 的 WPUSH 渠道字段，支持 API Key、Channel 与 Topic 广播编码；敏感字段继续默认遮罩且不落盘。

### 验证与兼容性

- 全项目 53 个测试套件、300 项单元测试全部通过，Android Lint 与 Debug APK 构建成功。
- 已在 Motorola XT2551-3（Android 16 / API 36）连接青龙 v2.22.0 完成覆盖安装、会话保留、首页明细、已完成任务日志和系统日志冒烟；未发现新增崩溃或 ANR。
- WPUSH 真实发送、会改变认证状态的 401/密码/2FA 场景，以及恢复期间 HTTP 503 仍需在具备专用凭据或测试实例时验证。
- 支持 Android 12（API 31）及以上；本版本重点适配青龙 v2.22.0，并继续保留既有兼容路径。

## English

Client version: **AzureQL 2.3.5**

Server compatibility target: **QingLong 2.22**

### Feature: QingLong server 2.22 support

- Migrated config-file detail requests to the v2.22.0 `/api/configs/detail?path=...` endpoint instead of the retired legacy path.
- An HTTP 401 on an authenticated request now clears only the expired token while retaining user-authorized saved passwords, client secrets, and mTLS certificate material for re-authentication.
- Successful password or 2FA changes explicitly invalidate the previous session so a server-revoked token is never reused.
- Backup-restore health checks now recognize HTTP 503 and present an actionable scheduler-unavailable message.

### Reliable logs

- General log reads now support the bounded v2.22.0 `offset`, `limit`, and `tail` response contract.
- When a task reaches a terminal state, AzureQL continues draining every remaining cursor page, preventing truncated tails and duplicated completion output.
- Long system-log scrolling and pull-to-refresh were valid

Muse on Android hardware, with a native control dashboard and programmable device capabilities.

adb install -r muse-gadget-0.3.0-universal-debug.apk

This hotfix and stability update introduces Spotify-grade playlist management, intelligent network auto-resumption, and a massive overhaul to how local storage is handled.

* **Intelligent Track Deduplication:** Overhauled the playlist update logic. The app now extracts core titles and YouTube video IDs to perfectly fingerprint tracks, preventing duplicate downloads when syncing playlists.
* **Instant Re-Linking (No-Data Sync):** When updating a playlist with missing tracks, the app checks if the physical file is still in your Library. If found, it instantly snaps it back into the playlist without wasting internet bandwidth. It only downloads genuinely new songs.
* **New UI Dialogs:** Added full support for `"Update Playlist?"` and `"Already in Library"` dialogs in the Library screen, allowing users to safely merge missing tracks without creating duplicate playlist containers.

* **Safe Playlist Removal:** Removing a song from a specific playlist safely unlinks it without deleting the master file from your Library.
