release.name: Beta v4.8.2
release.notes:
# 🚀 Rustify 4.8.2

Fixes a release-only bug introduced in 4.7.0 that broke Gemini Nano, lyrics translation and
language detection. Install it over any previous version; everything you have is kept.

> App `4.8.1b → 4.8.2b` · Rust core `4.8.1 → 4.8.2` · 310 tests in the core, 110 in the app.

**Which APK:**
- `arm64-v8a`: almost every phone.
- `armeabi-v7a`: older 32-bit phones.
- `x86_64`: emulators and Chromebooks.

The `baselineProfiles` zip is optional: it makes the first start faster when you install with
`adb install-multiple`, as the README explains.

---

## 🐛 Fix: on-device AI worked in debug but not in release builds

R8 (the release optimizer) removed constructors that ML Kit loads by reflection, so every ML Kit
feature — Gemini Nano for the DJ and the chat, lyrics translation and language detection — failed
silently in the release build. The app reported "this phone has no on-device AI (AICore)" on a phone
that has it, and translation icons stayed grey. Debug builds were not affected because they skip R8.

**What was wrong:** `ComponentRegistrar` classes (the entry points ML Kit discovers from the
manifest) had their no-argument constructors stripped. ML Kit's `ComponentDiscovery` instantiates
them by reflection; with no constructor, it threw and every downstream feature read as unavailable.

**The fix:**
- A ProGuard rule keeps every `ComponentRegistrar` constructor: `-keep class * implements
  com.google.firebase.components.ComponentRegistrar { public <init>(); }`.
- The AICore status check now logs its failure instead of swallowing it as "unsupported", which is
  what hid the problem in 4.8.1.
- Synchronized version bump: app `4.8.2b` and Rust core `4.8.2`.

**Affected versions:** every release build from 4.7.0 (when ML Kit was first added) through 4.8.1.
Debug builds were never affected.

repo.description: A journal that can prove itself. Encrypted, hash-chained incident log with self-verifying exports.

release.notes:
Big journals make it out of the app, and verify.py is harder to fool.

Sealed backups have a new format. A backup made with 0.6.0 needs 0.6.0 or newer to restore, so please update Magpie on any device you would restore to before you count on a new backup. Backups from 0.4.0 to 0.5.1 still restore here.

- Backups are written and read in sealed 512 KB pieces, one attachment at a time. A backup used to be one long piece of text, and three videos near the 50 MB cap crashed the page in Chromium.
- On Android, exporting a journal with one big video ran the app out of memory. No file landed and no error showed, but the timeline said "Exported today". Exports go to Android in slices of under 1 MB now and only count once Android says the file landed.
- If Android kills the page's renderer, Magpie comes back on the lock screen instead of closing.
- verify.py reads UTF-8, so a genuine export with one accented letter stops failing on Windows. Exports from 0.5.1 and earlier still carry the old script; run those as `py -X utf8 verify.py`.
- `python3 verify.py --anchor <hash>` checks an export against a head hash shared earlier.
- verify.py names a file dropped into files/ after the export, fails a renamed attachment, and prints a FAIL line instead of a stack trace for a missing or broken file.
- Auto-lock waits the minute it shows instead of locking the moment the app is hidden.
- A second tab on the setup screen can't create a journal over an existing one.
- A file over the 50 MB cap is refused by name before anything reads it.
- Shared files keep the name the other app gave them.
- Timeline dates follow the language picked in Settings, and the last "file(s)" style messages use proper plurals.

The longer version is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/munzzyy/magpie/blob/v0.6.0/CHANGELOG.md).

release.name: v1.1.10
release.notes:
### ✨ New Features

- **File Upload & Save Support**: `onShowFileChooser` override + pending callback state + `ACTION_GET_CONTENT`/`ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT` handlers. Situs converter (PNG→PDF, file merger, uploader) sekarang bisa pilih file dari penyimpanan dan situs yang butuh akses penyimpanan (File System Access API) bisa menyimpan file. Support multi-file upload.

- **Geolocation Fix**: `setGeolocationEnabled(true)` — gatekeeper WebView sebelumnya `false` membuat `navigator.geolocation` di JavaScript selalu error walau user sudah kasih izin. BMKG, Maps, dan situs berbasis lokasi sekarang bisa mengambil lokasi.

- **Inactive Tab List (21 Hari)**: Banner tab tidak aktif yang sebelumnya `clickable { }` kosong sekarang expand/collapse menampilkan LazyGrid 2 kolom. Dilengkapi button "Tutup tab tidak aktif" untuk close semua sekaligus, action row dengan count info, animasi `animateContentSize` dan `AnimatedVisibility` yang smooth, icon `Archive`, divider header-content, dan spacing konsisten dengan search bar.

- **Popup Domain Auto-Track**: Semua domain popup yang terdeteksi di `onCreateWindow` otomatis dimasukkan ke `skippedRedirectUrls` supaya `goBack()` langsung skip tanpa perlu heuristic lagi.

- **URL Website Update**: About → website URL diganti dari `https://yue.abiyyu.xyz` ke `https://fazza-abiyyu.github.io/Yue-Browser/`.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Blank Page Permanen Setelah Error**: Reset state error (`isShowingErrorPage`, `hasReceivedErrorForCurrentLoad`, `lastAutoRetryUrl`, `lastHttpErrorUrl`) sekarang dilakukan di `onPageStarted` — bukan cuma `onPageFinished`. Sebelumnya auto-retry/gagal reload berikutnya kena guard `isShowingErrorPage=true` → `onReceivedError` return diam → WebView blank permanen tanpa error page.

- **Blank Page Saat Reload Error**: Hapus `Cache-Control: max-age=0` dan `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` dari header reload. Server balas `304 Not Modified` → WebView pakai konten error yang ke-cache → reload bikin blank lagi. Sekaran

release.name: Vocab v3.2.0
release.notes:
## Vocab 3.2.0

- 資料夾可單獨或跨課程多選分享 JSON，與網頁／iOS PWA 互通；筆記預設不分享，精熟度及個人學習狀態不會沿用。
- 資料夾「＋」可匯入分享檔，預覽內容、指定課程、選擇略過重複字；同名另建、不覆蓋，可撤回本次匯入。
- 相片支援多選、預覽、移除及排序；逐張 AI 辨識，保留成功結果，只重試未完成圖片。
- 掃描新增主單字／標題、全部明列詞條、自訂範圍指令，禁止隨機從例句挑字。
- 辨識結果可勾選與編輯，匯入失敗不離開預覽；原資料不會被重複單字覆蓋。
- AI 文章分章涵蓋所選資料夾全部單字，檢查實際使用情形、標示缺字並可繼續補齊；完整單字與合理詞形才計入。
- 修正單字編輯頁的鍵盤與底部導覽列安全區，保留未完成的新字卡草稿。
- AI 請求可取消，加入整體時間上限，避免連線逾時後自動重送；Gemini Key 改放標頭。

不需解除安裝；使用原正式簽章覆蓋安裝以保留既有資料。AI 速度、辨識正確率與模型可用性仍取決於使用者設定的服務；文章尚有缺字時會明確標示未完成。

## Vocab 3.1.3

- 將約 76 萬筆 ECDICT 中文釋義轉為台灣繁體，搜尋結果與從搜尋新增的單字不再使用原始簡體釋義。
- 預先轉換的離線詞庫，不需要額外翻譯 API；英文、音標與缺少例句的處理保持不變。
- 保留 ECDICT MIT 與 OpenCC Apache-2.0 授權及修改聲明。

不清除或改寫已儲存的單字與學習資料。請直接覆蓋安裝，不要先解除安裝。

## Vocab 3.1.2

- 新增約 76 萬筆 ECDICT 英漢詞條，Android 可離線搜尋，不需要外部翻譯 API。
- 自動模式優先查詢 ECDICT，查無結果才使用線上字典；也可在「設定 → 單字查詢」指定來源。
- 保留原始中文釋義（部分為簡體），不會偽造例句；搜尋結果附有 ECDICT 原始專案與 MIT 授權連結。
- 更新來源正式改為 VocabGroup/Vocab-for-Android；舊版仍能透過 GitHub 轉址找到新版。

此更新不清除既有單字、資料夾與學習紀錄。請直接覆蓋安裝，不要先解除安裝。

## Vocab 3.1.1

- 修正文章庫初次開啟不顯示舊文章：歷史文章不再依賴目前選取的 AI 聊天室，並可直接開啟不同對話的文章。
- AI 聊天室可在確認後新增文法到指定的既有文法庫，保留句型、例句與練習題；同名文法不會被默默覆蓋。
- AI 聊天室新增明確修改單字欄位的操作，可依指令改寫已有內容，確認前顯示差異，並支援復原；仍遵守使用者選取的資料夾編輯範圍。
- 手動單字編輯的單張及一鍵 AI 補齊會傳入原有欄位。只缺中文例句翻譯時，翻譯原有英文例句；不會把另一句例句的翻譯套用到原句。

此更新不變更資料庫版本，不清除既有資料。覆蓋安裝仍須使用相同正式簽章。

## Vocab 3.1.0

這次把現代化設計落實到實際畫面與操作視窗，而不只是更換主題顏色。

- 單字與文法主頁重新排版：今日進度、主要操作、最近內容與學習工具。
- 資料夾／文法庫、學習及測驗清單改用一致的精簡收藏列，保留拖曳排序；編輯、刪除與切換操作集中在更多選單。
- 單字管理重新整理文字層級與操作，單字編輯改為完整寬度的定義、例句及中文翻譯欄位。
- 編輯、匯入、搜尋、AI、設定與作文共用中性色輸入框、扁平內容區塊與統一圓角。
- 文法匯入改為清楚的教材來源清單；單字掃描來源收成圖示工具列，留下更多辨識結果空間。
- 文法與單字選擇題採用單行選項區塊，保留選取、正確與錯誤提示。
- 文章閱讀把文章／逐句翻譯／測驗放在內容上方；文章與作文紀錄改為精簡清單。
- 作文編輯加入頁面上的標題與課程欄位，保留完整批改與弱點練習流程。
- 資料夾選擇、AI 套用確認、新增及刪除確認統一為新樣式視窗，支援長清單及鍵盤安全區。
- 外觀只保留亮色、暗色與跟隨系統，移除資料夾自訂配色介面。
- 保留首頁頂端單字／文法膠囊切換、透明毛玻璃懸浮工作列及可移動的黑白朗讀浮窗。
- 翻卡學習保持點擊翻面、左滑不熟、右滑記住，不顯示底部評分按鈕。

可覆蓋安裝，既有課程、單字、文法、文章、作文和學習紀錄會保留。

release.name: v0.1.0-alpha — first public preview
release.notes:
> ⚠️ **Alpha — under heavy construction.** Many features work, several are fragile, a few are scaffolded only. See the [README status matrix](../../#status).

## Highlights

- 🎮 **107 systems / 200+ libretro cores** discoverable in-app, downloadable from the official buildbot
- 🎯 **Atari ST emulation validated end-to-end** (Hatari + TOS)
- 🌍 **8 languages** (FR/EN/ES/DE/IT/PT/JA/ZH)
- 🥽 **Niveau 1 MR** — declared passthrough-aware, Quest renders the panel over your real space
- 🧪 **Niveau 2 MR** — native OpenXR + FB_passthrough integrated (immersive quad layer); fragile depending on launch context
- 🕹️ **Per-controller remap UI** + hot-swap detection
- 💾 **Save states with thumbnails** + 60-snap rewind buffer
- 📺 **Aspect ratio** Fit / Fill / Stretch / 1× / 2× / 4:3 CRT (per-game)
- 🎨 **Post-FX**: Off / Scanlines / Phosphor / Heavy CRT / Soft glow
- 🖼️ **Bezels**: None / CRT / Arcade cabinet / Handheld
- 📸 Screenshots gallery + share + delete
- 🛌 Auto-resume on next launch
- 🤖 Pixel-art mascot in the corner
- 📊 Battery + Wi-Fi widgets

## Install

```bash
adb install -r RetroXR-0.1.0-alpha.apk
```

Then **Library → Unknown Sources → RetroXR**.

Targets: Quest 3 / Quest 3s / Quest Pro / Quest 2 (panel app), Android phones / tablets, Android TV. Min SDK 29.

## Known issues
- Niveau 2 MR may pause when launched from a 2D context (Quest's compositor doesn't always transition to immersive)
- HW context cores (Beetle PSX HW, Mupen64, PPSSPP) are coded but not yet validated in-headset
- No tests, no R8 minification, no signing yet — debug APK only

## What's next
Connect HW core path, real GLSL shaders (HQ4x, xBR), cloud save sync, RetroAchievements integration, netplay LAN p2p.

🎮 Built end-to-end as a multi-day live engineering session, mostly driven from the headset.

release.name: XScript v0.3.0
release.notes:
### 桌面端（`desktop/`，仍是开发阶段，未发布安装包）

- **工程页**：浏览设备上的工程和文件，新建工程 / 文件，重命名、删除文件（入口 `__init__.py` 受保护），保存并运行（F6）、停止（Shift+F6），实时跟随运行日志。
- **Monaco 编辑器**：随应用本地打包（不走 CDN），Python 高亮与补全，补全数据来自 `ide/python-stubs`（`xscript.*` 与 `ascript.*`，含签名与文档）。
- **本地文件夹同步**：与 VS Code 插件同一套规则（`.vscode/.syncignore`、按大小 + 内容哈希的增量上传），支持全量上传和拉取到本地；可用系统对话框选择文件夹。
- **屏幕**：连续截图投屏（1–10 fps，不占设备 2 路投屏流的名额），在画面上点按、长按、拖动即可操控设备，另有返回 / 主页 / 最近任务和文字输入。
- **中 / 英界面切换**（侧栏底部，记住选择）。
- **断点调试**：点编辑器行号左侧或按 F9 设断点；F5 调试/继续，F10、F11、Shift+F11 单步；查看调用栈和变量，在暂停处求值；停止时先正常分离调试器，再停脚本。
- **屏幕墙**：每台设备上一张截图返回后才请求下一张（2 秒后；失败 5 秒后重试），慢设备不再积压请求；窗口隐藏时暂停。
- **修复**：窗口很窄（约 400px）时，局域网连接一行（地址、连接、扫描 /24 网段）自动换行，不再出现横向滚动条。
- **流程编辑器**（新页面）：xflow 文本和 React Flow 画布是同一张图，改一边另一边跟着变。
  - 节点库按类别分组，支持搜索和键盘导航；检查器按「常规 / 输入 / 输出 / 代码」分组，数字等字段当场校验；窄窗口下节点库和检查器可以收起。
  - 撤销 / 重做、复制粘贴、注释框、折叠节点、折叠为代码、提升为文件。
  - 可以在电脑上试跑（断点、单步、变量、运行历史存进 `desktop.db`），也可以把设备片段发到当前设备执行，或一键在当前设备上运行。设备报错会通过 source map 反查并定位到节点。
  - 在屏幕页的控件树里选中控件，可以直接拖到画布，生成「查找 + 点击」节点。
- **设备**：全局「当前设备」、断线自动重连和 USB 热插拔、更紧凑的设备卡片、局域网扫描进度。
- **投屏**：画面适配窗口大小，操控方式增加。
- **体验**：统一的错误提示和操作反馈；切换页面或关闭窗口时不再丢失未保存的修改，并改用应用内的确认框；全应用共用一套控件（Tailwind + ui 组件），样式表按 CSS 级联层组织。

### 管理后台与网页控制台

- **修复**：登录失败计数表满 1 万条时会被整表清空，可借大量随意用户名的失败登录解除对真实账号的锁定；现在只清过期项，必要时优先淘汰未锁定的条目。
- **修复**：设备、卡密、操作日志和运行日志的搜索按字面匹配，`%`、`_` 不再当通配符；搜索词以 `\` 结尾时运行日志搜索不再报 500。
- **修复**：设备 HTTP 转发遇到无效的 `body_b64`、发送途中设备断开或设备回复格式错误时，返回 400 / 502，不再是 500；定时下发小程序的 `script_id` 不是数字时返回 400。
- **修复**：实时日志、运行日志跟随和打包日志在请求比轮询间隔慢时会重复追加同样的行，现在上一次请求没回来就跳过这一轮。
- **修复**：退出登录或会话失效后清空页面缓存，同一标签页里换账号登录不会短暂看到上一个账号的数据；下载时会话失效会回到登录页。
- **无障碍 / 体验**：右上角账号菜单可用键盘打开并有焦点框；两步验证码输错后自动清空重输，校验中不会重复提交；窄屏下搜索框不再撑出页面。
- **安全**：设备密钥不再出现在访问日志里。uvicorn 日志会把 `token=` / `access_token=` 的值显示为 `***`；App 改用 `Authorization: Bearer` 请求头连接，`?token=` 作为旧方式继续可用。
- **安全**：已登录账号修改密码、开启或关闭两步验证时也限制错误次数（同一账号失败 5 次锁定 5 分钟，所有会话共用），只有输错才计数。
- **安全**：公共接口限流在并发请求下准确生效；`/license/verify`、`/license/use` 遇到签名伪造的令牌会按 IP 锁定一段时间，合法令牌不计数。
- **性能**：设备状态帧和 `cloud.send()` 数据改为每 15 秒合并写一次库，控制台看到的状态和数据仍然实

MyPlayer v4.4 introduces our groundbreaking **128-Dimension On-Device Neural Hash & Contextual Bandit Reinforcement Learning Engine** for 100% personalized music recommendations without sending a single byte of telemetry to external cloud servers. * **0% Hardcoded Rules:** Zero hardcoded genres, languages, countries, or artists. The engine learns exclusively from your real listening patterns, favorites, downloads, and playback duration.

  - ❤️ **Favorite & Download Super-Boost (`+1.80`):** Adding a track to favorites or downloading it creates an immediate taste anchor.
* **Ultra-Lightweight & Zero Lag:**
  - **RAM Footprint:** ~2.5 KB (5 vectors × 128 floats).
  - **Storage Footprint:** Strictly capped at 80 pattern entries (< 15 KB on disk forever). Runs with zero lag even on entry-level 3 G

# 🔐 Abdal LockBox v1.65 — Self-Destruct Protection

We are pleased to announce the release of **Abdal LockBox v1.65**, introducing a critical security feature designed for high-risk situations: **Self-Destruct Protection**.

## 🎯 Use Case Scenario

Self-Destruct is designed for situations where the user is under pressure, theft, coercion, or physical threat and is forced to unlock the vault. In this scenario, the user can enter the predefined Self-Destruct Password instead of the Master Password. The app continues the unlock flow silently, but immediately wipes all sensitive local vault data from the device.

When the Self-Destruct Password is entered during the normal unlock process, Abdal LockBox proceeds without displaying any warning, error, or suspicious message. At the same time, it immediately and permanently wipes all sensitive local vault data from the device.

## ✨ What's New

- Added a new **Self-Destruct** card in the Settings section
- Added a dedicated switch to enable or disable Self-Destruct Protection
- Added a secure Modal Dialog for setting or changing the Self-Destruct Password
- The Self-Destruct Password is fully separate from the Master Password
- The Self-Destruct Password cannot be the same as the Master Password
- Disabling the Self-Destruct feature automatically removes the stored Self-Destruct Password
- Re-enabling the feature requires the user to set a new Self-Destruct Password
- When triggered, the app permanently wipes:
  - Vault data
  - Encryption keys
  - Cache
  - Temporary files
  - Local metadata

Self-Destruct Protection is designed to work silently and naturally. If the user enters the predefined Self-Destruct Password, the app does not reveal that the protection mechanism has been activated. This helps protect the user in situations where visible warnings or error messages could create additional risk.

release.name: v0.3 — the rest of the parameter set
release.notes:
Adds every voice and text-parser parameter the engine exposes, and stops it
padding each utterance with half a second of silence.

**New settings** (gear beside BestSpeech in Text-to-speech output):

- **Inflection**, **head size**, **excitation** and **unvoiced volume** — the
  Keynote GOLD voice-quality parameters, each with a "voice default".
- **Phrase prediction** — the parser's punctuation look-ahead, which is what
  shapes an utterance's intonation.
- **Text processing** — expand abbreviations, times of day, read numbers in
  full, digits one at a time, capital groups as words, spell every letter,
  speak punctuation, speak spaces and line breaks.
- **Pauses** — the engine adds 477 ms of silence after every utterance, now
  trimmed by default. The shorter settings also cap its 420 ms sentence pause;
  "Authentic" trims nothing.

**Voices sound slightly different from 0.2.** The `~f` code silently discards a
`~h` set before it, and every voice table descended from `bst.h` lists `~h`
first — so no voice's own pitch range has ever actually reached the engine, here
or in the Windows tools. Fixed, which makes Sara, Wendy, Kit, Granny, Martha and
the rest a little more expressive or flatter as their definitions intended.
Setting **Inflection** to 0 reproduces the old output exactly.

Curly quotes, en/em dashes and ellipses are now mapped to ASCII rather than
blanked, so a curly apostrophe no longer makes "don't" read as two words.

Still missing from #1: the user pronunciation dictionary.

Universal APK — arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86. `B32_TTS.DLL` is not
included; import your own copy from the settings screen.

wrong answers.

# Driver Driver v0.8.0

You can now keep track of the drivers you've tried and look up community reports by game. This update also includes the new DD logo.

## What's new

- **My drivers:** save a driver for later, add game and emulator notes, and mark your own results as known good or having issues. Search your library by game, file or notes.

# AICEcho 3.0.3

本次更新改善 Shizuku 方式的刷卡稳定性，不需要重新添加卡片或重新配置已正常使用的卡片。

## 更新内容

- **减少识别成其他卡片的情况**：改善刚开始模拟或刷卡成功后仍贴着读卡器时，偶发识别成小米互联等卡片、无法继续刷卡的问题。
- **模拟期间保持刷卡监听**：Android 15 及以上的 Shizuku 模拟页优先使用当前卡片的 NFC-F 监听；退出模拟页后恢复默认监听。不支持此接口的设备和 Root 模块方式保留原流程。
- **准备提示更清楚**：开始模拟时提示先移开读卡器，等页面确认已启用后再贴近刷卡。

## 下载与更新

下载下方的 **`AICEcho-3.0.3-release.apk`**，可直接覆盖同签名的 AICEcho 3.0.2 或本次监听修复测试包，保留已有卡片资料。更新前建议导出一份本地备份。

使用 Shizuku 不需要安装 `aicecho-pmm-ksu-v3.zip`；已有 Root 的用户按原设置使用即可，本次更新没有改变 Root 模拟流程。

首次使用和手机条件见 [使用说明](https://github.com/UmiSlat/AICEcho#第一次使用)。

Security hardening and v2 vault format finalization release.

### Changed
- Finalized the shared v2 encrypted vault/export envelope.
- Standardized current vault/export writes around `Lockroot_VAULT` / `Lockroot_EXPORT`, Argon2id, and AES-256-GCM.
- Clarified legacy migration behavior across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.

### Security
- Hardened vault unlock, save, and migration paths.
- Added compatible legacy migration behavior where the platform can decrypt the old vault format.
- Improved desktop vault/export handling around the newer shared envelope shape.
- Clarified that wrong passwords, tampered ciphertext, and tampered envelope metadata fail authentication.

### Testing
- Updated Android vault codec and repository tests.
- Added desktop smoke coverage for v2 vault/export behavior.
- Verified Android release unit tests, Windows release build, Linux release build, and desktop smoke tests.

release.notes:
Saves, solved levels and settings of 0.7.3 are kept. Endless grids under way are kept too; the ones
dug from now on are measured and shaped anew.

### Added

- **Hints** that teach the reasoning. A **Hint** plank under the grid gives the plainest deduction
  your marks allow, a word at a time: where to look, then why, then which cells, outlined in gold. It
  stays until those cells are marked. When no rule gives a cell, it names the one to try and says
  which rule the try breaks. With a wrong mark on the grid it says so, and shows it if asked. An
  option turns the plank off.
- The tutorial is a table of **lessons**: the basics, then treasure rooms, dead ends, narrow
  hallways, the dungeon in one piece and trying a cell out. Each is a small dungeon solved one
  deduction at a time, then one to solve on your own with the Hint plank at hand. A lesson bears a
  seal once that second grid is solved.
- **Daily**: one dungeon a day, dug from the date, so the same for every player on this version.
  The last two weeks stay open and nothing is lost for a day missed.
- **Share** on a solved grid sends what it was, how many hints it took and the grid itself, never
  its solution. **Enter a code**, in Endless, digs the dungeon a friend sent: the whole message can
  be pasted. A grid is taken only if reasoning alone solves it.
- A **gallery**, in Endless, keeps the dungeons solved in Endless, in Daily and from a friend.
- The campaign is told in **chapters** of ten levels, five to a difficulty, each with its name, its
  count and a seal once mapped. The levels and their order are the same.
- On grids with small cells, **two fingers spread the grid** and move it; the counts stay along the
  edges, each in front of its row or its column.
- The cells laid since the latest checkpoint bear a **parchment corner**: a try is told apart from
  what is sure.
- A tap on a count switches between plain and calligraphic digits.

- Two of the most complex patches (`map_screen.dart`, `maplibre_map_screen.dart`) were rebuilt from pristine plus only their genuine Voyager-specific changes, clearing out drift that had built up across earlier rebases.

release.name: Xpense Tracker v1.0.5 — Glass that bends light
release.notes:
## Xpense Tracker v1.0.5

> ### ✅ Installs straight over v1.0.4
> No uninstall, nothing to back up first. (Coming from **v1.0.2 or earlier**? That one still needs
> the uninstall-and-restore dance — see the v1.0.3 notes.)

A visual release. The glass chrome introduced in v1.0.4 was doing half its job, and a few screens
had their content sitting in the wrong place under the app bar.

### 🔮 Glass that actually bends light

Bars and sheets already blurred what was behind them. Now they **refract** it: content passing the
edge of a bar bends the way it would through a real pane of glass, rather than just going soft.
Watch a list scroll under the floating nav bar — the rows compress slightly as they cross the rim.

The middle of a surface stays undistorted on purpose, so anything scrolling under the centre of a
bar is still perfectly readable. Warping the whole surface is the look Apple reserves for photo and
video backgrounds; over a screen full of numbers it fights the text.

### 💡 Glass is on, and stays on

The **Reduce transparency** switch is gone. In practice its main effect was leaving the glass turned
off by accident and making the app look flat.

Bars and sheets still go solid **automatically** if you've asked Android for **high contrast** or an
**accessible navigation** mode — that's a real accessibility need and it's still honoured, it just
isn't a toggle buried in Settings any more.

### 🔦 Light mode looks like glass now

In light mode the tint over the blur was thick enough that barely any of what sat behind a bar came
through, so bars read as plain white. They're properly translucent now. Dark mode is unchanged.

### 📐 Content no longer hides under the app bar

- **Records** — the income/expense/net board was tucked underneath the app bar
- **Settings** — the first row was clipped by it
- **Projects** — the opposite problem, a band of empty space above the summary

All three now sit just below the bar at rest, and still scroll underneath it as you go.

# PopugVPocket 0.5.1

PopugVPocket 0.5.1 is a stabilization and distribution-infrastructure release following Reborn.

## Highlights

- VGirl now uses independent left direction, center display, and right action zones across common landscape sizes.
- XYAB touch rectangles no longer overlap and switch between compact and diamond layouts responsively.
- Store downloads expose progress, cancellation, bounded redirects and size, `.part` staging, SHA-256 verification, and atomic completion.
- Store UI supports update, reinstall, repair, verify, and uninstall while preserving achievements and permanent rewards.
- Android workflows can build compact APK, AAB, checksums, and either debug-prerelease or production-signed artifacts.
- Cartridge templates generate release assets and a moderated catalog entry draft.

## Android

- Package: `org.popugonet.popugvpocket`
- versionName: `0.5.1`
- versionCode: `7`
- Minimum SDK: 29
- VBoy portrait and VGirl landscape profiles

The public 0.5.1 release is a debug prerelease intended for testing. Tagged releases currently publish a debug-signed APK and checksum without an AAB. Production mode remains available manually, requires repository signing secrets, and includes no production keystore in the repository.

## Security

External cartridges remain unsandboxed Godot code. HTTPS and SHA-256 validate expected bytes but not publisher identity. Install only cartridges whose source and publisher you trust.

## Known limitations

- The public catalog has no approved external GitHub Release assets yet; production remote installation is not claimed as verified.
- No Android device was available during the initial 0.5.1 preparation pass.
- Updating a mounted PCK may require restarting PopugVPocket.

Checksums are generated as `SHA256SUMS.txt` beside release artifacts.

release.notes:
# wolphun 0.3.0-beta — the Symbian port

The headline of this release is a **third platform**: wolphun now runs **natively on the phones these games were actually sold for**. Desktop and Android also get screenshots, a texture filter, and a long list of smaller fixes.

---

Which file do I want?

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
|  **Windows** | `wolphun-emulator-0.3.0-beta.zip` | Portable. Unzip and run `wolphun emulator.exe` — **no Java needed**, the runtime is inside. |
|  **Linux** | `wolphun-emulator_0.3.0~beta-1_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./wolphun-emulator_0.3.0~beta-1_all.deb`, then run `wolphun`. Needs a system Java (`default-jre`). |
|  **Symbian 9.2+** | `wolphun_S60.zip` → `wolphun_fp1.sisx` | E51, **E63**, E66, **E71**, E90, N81, N82, **N95**, and the 9.3 / 9.4 models (E52, E72, E75, N85, N96, 5800, N97). |
|  **Symbian 9.1** | `wolphun_S60.zip` → `wolphun_3rd.sisx` | E50, E60, **E61**, E61i, E62, E70, **N73**, N75, N80, N91, N92, N93. |
|  **Android** | build from source | Open `android/` in Android Studio and press Run (`minSdk 24`, Android 7.0+). |

> You provide your own game files — **no game ROMs are included.**

---

##  New: Symbian S60 3rd Edition

This is **not** the Java core running on a JVM. It is a **from-scratch C++98 port** of the PIP2 virtual machine and the entire SDK layer — no STL and no libc in the emulation core — wrapped in a native **Avkon** interface that uses the phone's own theme, menus, list dialogs and file browser.

### Why two packages

The Avkon DLL ordinals changed between Symbian 9.1 and 9.2, so a single binary cannot serve both: a 9.2 build simply will not load on a 9.1 phone. Pick the one for your model from the table above — the source is identical, only the SDK it links against differs.

Both are **self-signed**, so no developer certificate is needed. The phone may ask you to allow software from untrusted sources: *Tools → App. manager → Options → Settings → Software installati

The info refresh used to run on the UI thread, freezing the app every couple of seconds. On an onn Full HD Google TV stick (4× Cortex-A35):

| Per update        | v1.0    | v1.1    |
|-------------------|---------|---------|
| UI thread blocked | ~100 ms | ~7.5 ms |
| Frame time        | 105 ms  | ~17 ms  |

- **Manifest:** `pvr.app.type=vr`, how PICO OS recognises a VR app, and PICO/ByteDance devices now enter VR mode.

**This has never run on PICO hardware.** It is written from the OpenXR specification and PICO's documented requirements. One thing cannot be settled without a device: whether the PICO runtime implements `XR_KHR_android_surface_swapchain`, which the whole display path depends on. If it does not, the app will say "VR mode unavailable" on a PICO and the approach needs rethinking for that platform.

Reports from PICO owners are very welcome. The first run answers it: `adb logcat -s ARMSX2-XR` shows either the session starting and which controller profiles were accepted, or the missing extension by name.

## Install

`adb install -r ARMSX2-3D-0.3-beta.apk`, or install over Beta 0.1/0.2 — same signing key, settings kept.

**Signed with the Android debug key**, as this is a personal beta.

  ```
  /data/data/com.google.android.as/databases/history_db

  ```
  /Android/data/com.d4vram.nowplayingexporterpy/files/Music/NPEpy_download_songs/
  ```

  Formato típico: `.webm` (sin post-procesado FFmpeg). Para escucharlas en tu reproductor, **mueve/copialas** a `/sdcard/Music/`.

## 🚀🔍 Cómo funciona (resumen técnico)

# Tessera 0.1.37

The same signed packages are now published to two repositories, and the application can follow either.

## Update source

- **Windows:** Settings → Application updates has an **Update source** choice. The default is the main repository, `Aevorine/Tessera`; the alternative is the mirror, `Aevorine/Tessera-releases`. Check again after switching.
- **Android:** the update card has a switch for the same mirror.
- The choice is limited to these two built-in repositories and does not affect trust: Windows installs only packages signed with the pinned key, and Android accepts only packages carrying the installed signing key.
- Installations of 0.1.33 and earlier, which only know the mirror, can update again.

## Included from 0.1.36

- Updates follow the Windows system proxy, with one tunnel per range connection and a direct fallback.
- The backend yields CPU a few seconds after you switch to another program and returns to normal priority when you come back.
- Panels open without a loading step and fade in; the sidebar keeps the cleanup suite highlighted on all of its tabs.
- Dependency, CodeQL and search-path security fixes; the code-scanning, Dependabot and secret-scanning lists are empty at publication time.

## Downloads

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `Tessera.Setup.exe` | Windows 10/11 x64 installer |
| `Tessera.exe` | Windows 10/11 x64 portable |
| `Tessera-CrossDevice-0.1.37.apk` | Android companion (Android 8.0+) |
| `Tessera-Rendezvous-0.1.37-<platform>` | Optional self-hosted rendezvous server |

The Windows signing certificate is self-signed and its public key is pinned by the updater; Windows may display a SmartScreen warning on first use.

release.notes:
**This is a PRE-RELEASE (alpha).**

Built end to end by GitHub Actions from source: the Rust engine, the Slint UI, the
UniFFI bindings and both APKs. No binary in this repository was trusted to produce
them.

Gates that had to pass first — every one of these is a step in this workflow, and
every one of them can fail the build:

*Engine*
- the Rust corpus must BE the shipped asset (checked before the tests, so a passing
  round-trip cannot be a round-trip over the wrong bytes)
- engine unit tests (`cargo test --lib --features mirror,pure_rust,netstack` -- the SHIP recipe)
- the suite must not silently shrink (a test-count floor, so deleting tests fails)
- `rustfmt` must stay clean
- zero warnings on all four shipped Android ABIs (`RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings cargo check --target ...`)
- `clippy` must stay at zero on the shipped ABIs

*Bindings and the .so*
- UniFFI bindings match the current Rust surface (no stale generated Kotlin)
- the built `.so` actually carries the pillar symbols (`mirror_status`,
  `centauri_serve_hits`, `resolver_doh_sinkhole_on`)
- the A14 uniffi-record guard (wired into Gradle, and it throws if its script is missing)

*Android*
- JVM unit tests for the flavour
- four self-check corpora for the deprecation tooling: the suppression stripper, the
  gated/ungated classifier, the parser, and a backlog ceiling that fails if the number
  of ungated deprecated usages grows

NOT a gate, said plainly because an earlier version of this text claimed it was: the
Slint goldens. This workflow RENDERS them on Linux and uploads them as an artifact,
and the step is labelled "never authoritative" for a reason -- three `Text` elements
carry no pinned font-family, so they rasterise with the host's default font and a
Linux render cannot be compared against a device golden. `torta_ui` is BUILT here but
its tests are not run; the only `cargo test` in this workflow is `torta_core`'s.

See README.md for what is proven and — deliberately — what is not yet.

What's New

This release includes a broad set of improvements focused on audio, customization, widgets, stability, and performance.

Audio feedback has been reworked for more consistent volume across interface effects, keyboard sounds, and reminder alerts. MyNotes now follows Android’s Notification volume, while reminder playback has improved behavior with Bluetooth devices and stronger alert output when needed.

Widgets can display multiple images from the same note, use improved collages, show more text when resized, preserve image proportions, and provide better link-preview thumbnails. Attachments and previews also use rounded corners for a cleaner appearance.

Widget behavior was also made more reliable with improved favorite and pin actions, synchronized palette resources, responsive layouts, and cleaner thumbnail handling. Several duplicated helpers, unused resources, obsolete queries, and redundant settings logic were removed.

The Settings screen also received visual cleanup, including a uniform top header that no longer changes to a darker tone while scrolling.

Overall, these changes make MyNotes feel cleaner, faster, more consistent, and more responsive, while reducing obsolete code and improving maintainability for future releases.

release.name: SNAG 1.5 - tray app, browser extension, security fix
release.notes:
**A system tray app on Windows, a browser extension, and a security fix that applies to everyone.**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| `SNAG-1.5-arm64-v8a.apk` | Android 7.0 or later, arm64-v8a only |
| `SNAG-1.5-windows-x64.exe` | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit |
| `SNAG-extension-1.1.zip` | Chrome or Edge, optional, first release |

## Please update

1.4 and earlier accepted requests from any website. A page you visited could quietly tell SNAG to download something to your disk; it could not read the result, but the file still landed. 1.5 rejects anything that does not come from SNAG itself or the extension. If you run the Windows build, update.

## Windows: it lives in the tray now

No console window any more. SNAG sits next to the clock while it runs. Right-click the icon to reopen it, open or change the download folder, or quit. Your folder choice is remembered.

The quit prompt also tells you the truth now: stopping mid-download leaves partly downloaded files behind that cannot be played, and you will want to delete them.

## The browser extension

Optional, and SNAG works fine without it. It adds a SNAG button to YouTube, TikTok, X, Instagram, Vimeo, Twitch, SoundCloud and Reddit so you can start a download without copying the link, and a right-click menu entry for any video link.

Unzip `SNAG-extension-1.1.zip` somewhere permanent, open `chrome://extensions` or `edge://extensions`, turn on Developer mode, click **Load unpacked** and pick the folder. It only talks to SNAG on your own machine, and only on those sites. It is not on the Chrome Web Store, for the same reason SNAG is not on Google Play.

## Android

No functional changes. Rebuilt at 1.5 so both downloads carry the same version, and signed with the same key as every release so far, so it installs over your current copy.

release.name: Svitok 0.2.0 - Autofill
release.notes:
Autofill, on both platforms, plus a security pass over the whole app.

Passwords are still derived, not stored - autofill asks the app to compute one for the site you're on, and the key and phrase never leave the app.

## Autofill

- **Android** - a system autofill service. Set Svitok as your autofill provider, focus a login field, confirm with a fingerprint and your phrase, and it fills. Works in apps and, with one Chrome setting, in the browser.
- **Desktop** - a browser extension talks to the running app through a thin native-messaging host that holds no secrets. If the app is locked when you pick a suggestion, it comes to the front, asks for your phrase, and then fills - no second click.

Matching is by registrable domain (the Public Suffix List), so a saved `github.com` also fills `gist.github.com`, while `github.com.evil.com` does not. Setup is in [docs/AUTOFILL.md](https://github.com/KOR1K1/svitok/blob/main/docs/AUTOFILL.md).

## Security hardening

- Android seed unlock is biometric-only now (device PIN/pattern is no longer accepted for the seed).
- Screen capture is forced on the seed and password screens even if you turned protection off.
- Copied passwords are kept out of Windows clipboard history and the cloud clipboard.
- Key material is locked into RAM (`mlock`/`VirtualLock`) so it can't be swapped to disk.
- Importing a backup can no longer swap KDF parameters and lock you out of your own vault; QR sync shows a diff and asks before overwriting existing entries.
- Decrypted vault entries and derived passwords are wiped after use.

No format or algorithm change - the golden vectors still pass, so paper written with 0.1.0 keeps working. Existing installs upgrade in place (same signing key).

## Install

- **Android** - `Svitok-0.2.0-android.apk` (signed, sideload)
- **Windows** - `Svitok-0.2.0-windows-setup.exe` (NSIS installer, unsigned - SmartScreen may warn)
- **Linux / macOS** - build from source

SHA-256 checksums in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

release.notes:
## What's new in v1.2.1

A focused bugfix release — every issue below was reported, fixed, and verified on-device.

### Fixed

- **Autosave now actually works.** Copies made on modern Android (10+) were being silently rejected by the system because the app wasn't in focus — every background read was denied, so items never landed unless you pressed the save button. ClipVault now saves your clipboard the moment you open or return to the app, with no button press needed. Background polling also adapts: it backs off automatically (up to once a minute) when the platform keeps refusing, instead of hammering every 5 seconds and draining battery.
- **Biometric lock/unlock for notes is fully reliable.** A subtle condition bug in the prompt configuration was throwing an `IllegalArgumentException` the moment you tried to lock or unlock a note — the old code only worked by accident on some devices. Now it picks the right authenticator combination for your hardware, the prompt actually appears, and fingerprint + PIN both work.
- **Home screen no longer falsely shows "Nothing copied yet" on cold start.** A race between Paging's first load and the autosave insert could briefly flip the list to empty — fixed by waiting until the data refresh genuinely finishes before deciding what to show.
- **Search no longer hijacks your keyboard.** Tapping the search tab used to immediately pop up the keyboard with autofocus. Now the bar opens cleanly; tap to search when you're ready.
- **Floating bubble icon replaced.** The old icon was a broken clipboard glyph; it's now a proper chat-bubble that matches the brand.
- **Settings panel no longer feels laggy.** A double-toggle bug was causing every switch to flicker; the internal state pipeline also moved off a fragile `Array<Any?>` to a typed combine. Switching settings is instant now.
- **No more crashes from URL previews.** A nasty NPE that fired whenever a URL title fetch returned null was fixed with a guarded cache and defensive error handlin

- Encrypted upstream DNS (DoH) — Cloudflare, Quad9, AdGuard, Mullvad, NextDNS, custom

hardcoded DoH can bypass any DNS filter, though the DoH-endpoint blocking
option pushes most of them back onto system DNS.

No analytics, no crash reporting, no accounts. The query log is a capped 4 MB
ring buffer in app-private storage that never leaves the device. Every
outbound connection

release.name: v1.1.0 — Huge-file conversions + real progress
release.notes:
## ⚠ Upgrading from v1.0.0

The original v1.0.0 signing key is no longer available. Android refuses to install a different-key build on top of an existing app, so users on v1.0.0 **must uninstall before installing v1.1.0**. Your data (queue, history, settings) will be wiped — `prod.keys` will need to be re-selected once.

This is a one-time event. All future releases will keep the same signing key as this one.

## What's new

### Fixed: huge-file conversions (>10 GB) no longer hang
v1.0.0 copied the source NSZ to `/data/data/.../cache` and let Python write the NSP output there too. For a 15 GB NSZ → 23 GB NSP this required ~37 GB of temp space on the internal partition, which silently filled up midway through and hung the conversion at 25% with no error report.

v1.1.0 changes:
- **Skip the input copy entirely** when the SAF picker returns a file accessible at a real path (most cases: Downloads, internal storage, SD card). For Yakuza Kiwami that saves 15 GB of cache and ~5 minutes of copy time.
- **Atomic zero-copy finalization** via `renameTo()` when source and destination live on the same filesystem — the final 23 GB NSP doesn't get copied twice.
- **Real progress bar** with MB/s and ETA. A coroutine polls the growing NSP every 2 seconds and reports actual progress instead of getting stuck at 25%.
- **Working directory moved to `externalCacheDir`** (FUSE storage, typically 80+ GB) instead of `/data` internal (~30 GB) for the fallback path.
- **Realistic space check**: now counts input copy (if any) + estimated output + 256 MB margin, verified at the actual write target. Fails fast with `need=XXmb available=YYmb at=/path` instead of silently hanging mid-conversion.
- **`android:largeHeap="true"`** for safety with multi-GB workloads.

### Verified end-to-end
Yakuza Kiwami (15 GB NSZ → 23 GB NSP) on a Retroid Pocket 6, writing straight to SD card, in **31 minutes** start to finish.

## Requirements

- Android **8.0 (API 26)** or higher
- ABIs: arm64-v8a, x86_64
- You

# KeenWG 2.2.8

Версия 2.2.8 исправляет добавление пользовательских VPN-подписок и упрощает экран VPN-серверов.

## Что изменилось

- После добавления подписки KeenWG сразу загружает список серверов; отдельное скрытое обновление больше не требуется.
- Название подписки, использованный трафик, лимит и срок действия считываются из совместимых с HAPP `profile-title` и `subscription-userinfo`, если провайдер их передаёт.
- Новые метаданные выдаются только запросившему их клиенту: приложения предыдущих версий продолжают получать прежнюю схему каталога.
- Личная ссылка подписки больше не используется как видимое название. Если провайдер не передал имя, показывается только безопасное имя или домен без секретной части ссылки.
- Источники подписок собраны в один компактный список без больших карточек и лишнего начального скролла.
- Для неудачно загруженной подписки доступны явная повторная попытка и удаление с подтверждением.

release.name: Lockstep 1.0
release.notes:
Lockstep 1.0 — the first release.

Two-factor codes generated entirely on your device. No account, no cloud, and
no internet permission.

**What it does**
- Add accounts by scanning a QR code or entering a setup key
- Scanned codes are shown for confirmation before anything is saved
- TOTP and HOTP, with SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
- Group and search your accounts, drag to reorder
- Tap a code to copy; the clipboard clears itself
- Encrypted backup and restore, protected by a password you choose
- Auto-lock on a timer you set, and the moment you leave the app
- Light and dark, following your system theme

**Security**
- Secrets encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key held in the Android Keystore,
  hardware-backed where the device supports it, and released only after you
  authenticate
- Codes kept out of screenshots and the app switcher
- Backups protected by an Argon2id-derived key
- Excluded from Android's automatic cloud backup
- The app requests one permission: camera, and only for scanning

**Requirements**
Android 11 (API 30) or newer, with a screen lock set and a fingerprint enrolled.

release.name: Tablet Input v3.0.0
release.notes:
# Tablet Input v3.0.0

將 Android 平板變成 Windows 的觸控與筆輸入裝置，透過 USB ADB 直接取得底層輸入資料。

## 本版重點

- **一般／繪圖模式**：日常辦公使用滑動、輕點與長按拖曳；繪圖模式接觸即按下，適合繪圖與 osu! 等音樂遊戲。
- **觸控筆與手指輸入**：掃描並選擇 ADB 輸入裝置，保存設定，也可自動尋找裝置。
- **Windows Ink 筆壓**：支援懸浮、側鍵右鍵與壓力，能依手感調整可用壓力上限。
- **雙端映射**：調整平板觸控區域；電腦端以可拖曳的半透明視窗編輯映射，支援跨螢幕與不同縮放配置。
- **連線與介面改善**：Client 自動重連、連線狀態顯示、編輯時暫停輸入，以及 Server 設定變更提示。
- **Windows 應用包**：無主控台視窗，內附執行環境與 ADB，解壓即可使用。

## 下載與使用

- **Windows x64**：下載 `TabletInputServer-v3.zip`，完整解壓後執行 `TabletInputServer.exe`。
- **Android**：下載並安裝 `TabletInputClient-v3.apk`。

以 USB 接上平板，開啟 USB 偵錯並允許授權；推薦同時開啟 USB 網路共用。先開 Server，再從 Client 搜尋連線。選擇輸入裝置與模式後按「套用設定」。

應用包不需另裝 Godot 或 .NET SDK；GitHub 自動附加的 **Source code** 是開發原始碼，不是應用程式。

[操作指南](https://github.com/Billc123z/TabletInput/blob/v3.0.0/docs/usage.md) · [更新率實測](https://github.com/Billc123z/TabletInput/blob/v3.0.0/docs/measurements/2026-09-13-input-rate.md) · [延遲實測](https://github.com/Billc123z/TabletInput/blob/v3.0.0/docs/measurements/2026-09-14-input-latency.md)

release.notes:
# 鲜花消消乐 v1.3.0 🌸✨（15 关 + 3D 风格棋盘）

> 本期主题：**棋盘站起来了**。新增 5 个 3D 风格关卡，棋盘会带着透视旋转归位；再配两段全新 AI 生成背景视频。

## 🧊 3D 风格棋盘（L11 起）

| 效果 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **入场旋转** | 进关瞬间棋盘呈强透视斜视角，约 1.5 秒内**旋转归位**（三次缓动，带小幅回弹感） |
| **常态浮动** | 归位后仍有极轻微的双轴浮动（±3.7°/±1.6°，7.5 秒周期），棋盘"悬浮"着不僵硬 |
| **透视与厚度** | 单应矩阵投影（焦距 1.45，透视明显）+ 倾斜时轻微暗化 + 棋盘下方一层柔和投影，悬浮感十足 |
| **手感零妥协** | 触摸位置按**同一矩阵反算**回棋盘坐标——形变后点哪颗花就消哪颗花（真机手感与平面关完全一致） |

技术路线：棋盘渲染进 SubViewport → 全屏 TextureRect + 自写 `board_warp.gdshader`（单应矩阵形变）→ 输入代理按逆矩阵映射。**不引入 3D 渲染管线**，架构风险最小、性能开销可控。

## 🗺️ 新增 5 个关卡（共 15 关）

| # | 关卡 | 形状 | 特色 | 目标/步数 | 3★实测 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | 浮空花岛 | 🏝 岛屿 | 3D 首秀 | 2250 / 28 | 40% |
| 12 | 旋转花环 | ◎ 回环 | 中空 + 3D | 1450 / 30 | 50% |
| 13 | 月牙秘境 | 🌙 月牙 | 窄月牙 + 3D | 1450 / 30 | 60% |
| 14 | 花瓣绽放 | 🌸 花瓣 | 环形花瓣 + 3D | 1200 / 32 | ~40% |
| 15 | 终极花园 | ✚ 十字 | 3D 终极挑战 | 2650 / 34 | ~45% |

新增 3 种棋盘形状：**岛屿 / 月牙 / 花瓣**（形状系统累计 10 种）。

## 🎬 两段新背景视频（MiniMax H3）

- **云端仙境**：浮空岛 + 云海 + 瀑布花田（桃紫渐变天色）
- **月夜花园**：月辉 + 柳枝剪影 + 萤火虫（深青夜幕）

背景主题累计 **6 段**，按关卡自动切换（无缝回文循环）。

## ✅ 逐关闭环测试（每一关都测）

| 测试 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `smoke_all_levels`：15 关 × 3 项（形状校验 / 重力完整性+可行步 / 真实交换结算） | **45 项断言全过** |
| **新增 `smoke_view3d`：3D 视图专项** ① 装配检查（SubViewport + 形变层 + 输入接管）② 投影/反投影往返精度 ③ **端到端：模拟触摸一次交换 → 消除成功 +30 分** | **4 项断言全过** |
| 单应矩阵单元测试：三种姿态往返一致 / 正对时恒等 / 旋转中心不动 / 触摸映射回同一格 | 全过 |
| 难度采样（10 局/关，智能 AI） | 3★ 40%~60%、失败率 0%，全程零违例 |
| **视觉闭环**：虚拟显示（Xvfb）驱动引擎逐关渲染截图 + 抓取 3D 入场旋转的 6 帧过程 | 目检通过 |
| 全量回归 | 单元测试 + **10 套**冒烟（105 断言）+ 三场景零错误，全绿 |

## 📦 安装

- 下载 `flowermatch3-1.3.0.apk`（Android 8.0+，arm64）
- **从任意旧版直接覆盖安装**（同一发布签名，存档 / 星级 / 静音设置全部保留）

release.name: 2.1.1 - MP3 Output and Metadata Compatibility Update -
release.notes:
## DSRE-Mobile Release Notes

This release focuses on MP3 output support, native library packaging, cover-art handling, and metadata compatibility.

### Added

- Added MP3 output support using `libmp3lame`.
- Added `libmp3lame.so` packaging for supported Android ABIs.
- Added cover-art related FFmpeg codec support for Android builds.
- Added documentation for third-party native libraries and license notices.

### Changed

- Updated MP3 metadata handling to prefer ID3v2.3.
- Disabled ID3v1 writing for MP3 output when possible, to reduce metadata compatibility issues with non-ASCII tags.
- Updated the FFmpeg Android build scripts to avoid GPL/nonfree configure options for the public release build.
- Updated README and third-party notices for the current native library configuration.

### Fixed

- Fixed MP3 conversion failure caused by missing `libmp3lame.so` in the APK.
- Fixed cover image loss caused by incomplete MJPEG-related FFmpeg options on some ABI builds.
- Improved native dependency packaging for `arm64-v8a` and `armeabi-v7a`.

### Known Notes

- MP3 tag compatibility depends on the source file.
- If the input metadata is already garbled when checked with `ffprobe`, DSRE-Mobile cannot reliably restore the original text.
- In that case, please fix the source file tags with a tag editor before processing.
- Cover art preservation is best-effort and depends on the input image format and enabled FFmpeg codecs.

### License Notes

The DSRE-Mobile source code is licensed under the MIT License unless otherwise noted.

The Android APK may include third-party native libraries such as FFmpeg and LAME/libmp3lame. These components remain under their respective licenses. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for details.

repo.description: AI 私人新闻主播 — 多源新闻聚合 + LLM 智能文稿生成 + TTS 语音播报，每天早上自动为你生成音频新闻简报

release.name: v1.0.0
release.notes:
# 晨间新闻播报 - v1.0.0

**你的 AI 私人新闻主播 —— 每天早上自动为你生成音频新闻简报。**

---

## 这是什么？

一个 Android 开源应用，自动从多源新闻聚合，用大语言模型生成播报文稿，再用 TTS 合成语音。每天早上醒来，就能听到一份专属的音频新闻简报。

![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-1.9.22-blue)
![Jetpack%20Compose](https://img.shields.io/badge/Jetpack_Compose-Material_3-green)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-orange)

---

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合
- **RSS 源**：IT之家、36氪、少数派、BBC中文、纽约时报中文等主流媒体
- **World News API**：覆盖 200+ 国家/地区，按语言、国家、话题筛选
- **RSS2JSON**：绕过 CORS 限制，稳定抓取国内 RSS 源
- 8 个预配置新闻源，自动分类为国内、国际、科技、AI、城市等类别
- **来源审计**：新闻列表按来源标签筛选，查看每个源的出稿数量
- **下拉刷新**：一键重新抓取所有源
- 新闻条目带缩略图，按类别分色分区展示

### AI 文稿生成
- **多厂商 LLM 支持**：DeepSeek、阶跃星辰 Step Plan、OpenAI、通义千问等任何 OpenAI 兼容协议的模型
- **深度推理模式**：DeepSeek 自动启用 thinking 模式，阶跃星辰自动启用 reasoning_effort，生成更专业的播报文稿
- 多源新闻自动去重、按重要性排序、生成连贯播报稿
- 支持自定义 Base URL、API Key、模型名（Cherry Studio 风格配置）

### 语音合成 (TTS)
- 支持小米 MiMo TTS 及任何 OpenAI chat-completions 兼容的 TTS 服务
- 5 种语音可选：冰糖、茉莉、苏打、白桦、默认
- 长文本自动分段合成（1024 字符/段），合并为完整音频
- 支持自定义播报风格
- 合成失败时显示明确错误信息 + 文件日志，方便排查

### 播放器
- ExoPlayer 驱动，支持播放、暂停、倍速播放（1x / 1.25x / 1.5x / 2x）、快进快退（10 秒）
- 播放时显示动态波形可视化
- 播放时同步查看播报文稿
- 支持分享文稿文本
- 无音频播报也能查看文稿内容（文稿-only 模式）

### 播报管理
- 卡片式列表展示所有历史播报，含日期、新闻条数、字数、生成耗时
- 点击卡片进入播放器，左上角返回
- 删除播报（含确认对话框），自动清理关联音频文件

### 定时生成
- WorkManager 后台定时任务，每天自动抓取新闻 → 生成文稿 → 合成语音
- 可自定义生成时间（默认早上 7:00）
- 生成完成后推送通知提醒

### 设置
- **新闻偏好**：开关国内/国际新闻
- **关注城市**：选择关注的城市的新闻（深圳、济南等），支持自定义添加
- **AI 文稿生成**：配置 LLM Base URL、API Key、模型名、思考模式开关
- **语音合成**：配置 TTS Base URL、API Key、模型名、语音选择
- **定时任务**：开启/关闭自动生成，设置时间

### 使用流程
1. 打开 App → 「新闻源」下拉刷新抓取新闻
2. 「设置」页配置 LLM / TTS 的 API Key
3. 「今日播报」点击「生成今日播报」
4. 生成完成后点击卡片播放

> **VPN 提示**：抓取境外新闻源（如 BBC）需要 VPN，但 MiMo TTS 在 VPN 环境下可能不稳定。建议先开 VPN 抓新闻，再关 VPN 生成播报。App 会自动复用 30 分钟内已抓取的新闻，不会重复抓取。

---

## 技术栈

| 层面 | 技术 |
|------|------|
| 语言 | Kotlin |
| UI | Jetpack Compose (Material 3)，动态配色 |
| 架构 | Clean Architecture (Domain / Data / UI) |
| 依赖注入 | Hilt (Dagger) |
|

repo.description: Bit-perfect music, audiobooks, podcasts and internet radio in one client — Android and desktop, one shared core, talking only to samo-server. Began as a Feishin fork and went somewhere else entirely.

release.name: samo v1.4.0
release.notes:
samo is a self-hosted listening client for music, audiobooks, podcasts and radio, talking to [samo-server](https://github.com/bouliehaan/samo-server).

Coming from 1.3.0: samo runs on Android TV, a TV signs in without a keyboard, every Android menu can play something next, and the download notification finally goes away. Pairing and sign-out need **samo-server 1.3.0**.

## Android TV

The same APK now runs on Android TV. It picks a separate remote-driven interface when Android says the device is a television, not from the screen width, and runs landscape there and portrait on phones. Home, browse, collections, detail, the player, radio and setup are all built for a D-pad, with focus you can see and keys that do what a remote expects. There is a TV launcher banner, and neither Leanback nor a touchscreen is required, so it installs on any Android TV box.

## Sign in on a TV with your phone

Typing a password with a remote is miserable, so a TV shows a QR code instead. Scan it, approve the device on the server's `/pair` page, and the TV is signed in. Signing out now revokes that device's own token on the server rather than only forgetting it on the device, so a lost or sold device stops working the moment you sign it out.

## Play Next, everywhere on Android

With 90 things queued there was no way to hear one of them next; every menu only appended. Every Android context menu now has **Play Next**, and Add to Queue is renamed **Play Last**. Getting inserts right meant fixing what sat underneath them:

- A queue holding a book or a station could drift out of line with the player after an insert, so the app named one track while another played.
- Queuing an audiobook queued one copy of the whole book per chapter, each from the start. A book now queues once, from where you left off; a chapter queues the book from that chapter.
- Play Next during a multi-file book lands after the book, never between its chapters, and scrubbing inside a book no longer jumps into the song aft

﻿First public release of VaultSnap -- a local-only password manager for Android. No cloud. No accounts. No telemetry.

## Install

Download `VaultSnap-v1.0.0.apk` below. Sideload on Android 8.0+ (API 26+).

**SHA-256**

```
3c11e698f6ef1564fbf5efa9545ec23727d2bfdb41092ee3a0e129d3bdf28112
```

Verify after download:

```
sha256sum VaultSnap-v1.0.0.apk
```

## Highlights

- AES-GCM-256 encryption under a single Vault Master Key derived via Argon2id
- Android Autofill with biometric unlock and per-entry website / app linking

- Encrypted attachments with on-device image viewer
- Encrypted backups with a dry-run verify wizard
- Recovery question path if the master password is forgotten
- Wall-clock auto-lock that wipes the master key from RAM
- Sensitive clipboard masking on Android 13+
- **Zero `INTERNET` permission in the release build**

## Verify the no-network guarantee

```
git clone https://github.com/cedsceds-12/vaultsnap.git
cd vaultsnap
pwsh ./scripts/verify_release_manifest.ps1
```

The script builds a release APK and asserts the merged `AndroidManifest.xml` contains only `USE_BIOMETRIC` (plus benign auto-added entries from `local_auth` and AndroidX). Any other permission fails the script.

Quick check on the published APK:

```
aapt dump permissions VaultSnap-v1.0.0.apk
```

`android.permission.INTERNET` will not appear. By design.

## Tests

120 unit and widget tests:

```
flutter test
```

## ✨ 新功能：内置 2FA 生成器

现在你可以在 NebulaLock 中直接管理双因素验证（2FA）令牌，无需额外安装应用。

- 支持手动输入 Base32 密钥，或通过扫描二维码快速添加账户。
- 实时生成动态验证码，每 30 秒自动刷新，点击即可复制到剪贴板。
- 所有密钥通过 Android Keystore 加密存储，与密码本享有同等级别的保护。

---

## 🔒 元数据加密：隐藏文件名与数量

此前 `images` 和 `files` 列表在 JSON 文件中明文存储，可能暴露文件数量、名称等敏感信息。  
**v1.2 开始，所有图片和文件的元数据（文件名、大小、MIME 类型）均会被加密存储**，只有成功解密后方可查看。

- 旧版本文件在首次打开时会自动迁移，兼容无痛升级。
- 元数据加密进一步提升了隐私保护，即使文件被窃取，攻击者也无法得知你存了哪些文件。

---

## 🔁 重置主密钥优化：不再清空数据

之前勾选“重置一级密钥”会直接清空保险箱内容，现在改为**保留所有数据**。重置过程中：

- 系统会使用旧密钥解密所有内容，再用新密钥重新加密图片、文件及元数据。
- 耗时操作会显示实时进度（如“正在重新加密文件…”），避免界面假死。
- 既更换了主密钥，又保证了数据完整不丢失。

---

## 🕵️ 隐私清理：移除 NFC 传输日志

- 彻底注释了 `NfcTransferActivity` 和 `NfcTransferService` 中的所有日志输出，确保 NFC 传输过程真正无痕，不留任何系统日志。

---

## 📱 其他改进

- 修复了若干场景下的应用崩溃问题。
- 优化了部分界面的显示细节和操作稳定性。

---

欢迎下载体验，如有问题或建议请在 GitHub Issues 中反馈。感谢大家的支持！

repo.description: A decentralized, off-grid messaging concept using Bluetooth LE advertising to broadcast messages without pairing or internet.

release.name: v1.0.0 - EchoSphere
release.notes:
Project Overview

EchoSphere is a decentralized, off-grid communication tool for Android. This application allows users to broadcast short text messages to nearby devices without requiring an internet connection, cellular data, or the traditional Bluetooth pairing process.

How it Works: Range and Technology
The application utilizes Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Advertising. Instead of connecting to a specific device, the app "shouts" small packets of data into the surrounding environment.

Transmission Range: The effective distance for receiving messages typically spans between 10 and 30 meters (30 to 100 feet).

Variable Factors: This range depends strictly on the hardware of the smartphones involved and physical obstacles. In open spaces without interference, the signal can reach its maximum distance, while walls or electronic interference may reduce the radius.

Proximity Protocol: Because it uses BLE Advertising, the "Echo" is received by any device running the app within the broadcast sphere, making it ideal for hyper-local communication.

---------------------------------

**Installation Instructions**

Download the EchoSphere_v1.0.apk file.

During installation, Android may prompt a security warning (Play Protect) because the app is self-signed. Select "Install Anyway".

Grant the necessary Bluetooth and Location permissions (required by Android for BLE scanning).

release.name: Safi — GitHub build #12.1
release.notes:
## صافي — بناء من المصدر داخل GitHub Actions

نزّل ملف `Safi-*-github.apk` من Assets وثبّته على أندرويد 8 أو أحدث.
الملف موقّع بنفس شهادة النسخة الأصلية؛ الروت غير مطلوب ولا يطلب التطبيق صلاحياته.

هذه نسخة تجريبية. نجح البناء والاختبارات الآلية في GitHub، ونجح أيضًا فحص المحاكي عبر UID منفصل (8 اختبارات: حجب UDP/TCP، والنطاقات المسموحة، ومُحلِّل النظام). نجاح البناء والفحص لا يعني أنها اختُبرت على كل هاتف.
يحجب التطبيق مصادر الإعلانات عبر DNS، ولا يضمن إزالة إعلانات يوتيوب أو إعلانات نفس نطاق المحتوى.
لا يعمل مع VPN آخر، ولا تفعّل معه «حظر الاتصالات بدون VPN».

يوجد اختيار لمزوّد DNS المشفّر (Cloudflare افتراضيًا، وأيضًا AdGuard DNS وGoogle)، وقائمة إضافية اختيارية من رابط https،
وزر في الاختصارات السريعة، ودعم «VPN دائم التشغيل» مع تحذير صريح من خيار حظر الاتصالات بدون VPN.
لا توجد نتيجة مؤكدة بأن إعلان Passion Drama Lite اختفى.
يمكن تشغيل فحص DNS بموافقة منفصلة لمدة دقيقتين: حتى 128 سجلًا في ذاكرة الجهاز، وقد يشمل أي تطبيق مفتوح، ولا يُرفع التقرير تلقائيًا.
حجب شبكة الإعلان قد يمنع أيضًا فتح حلقة تشترط مشاهدة إعلان، ولا يفتحها بداله.

المستودع عام، فالتنزيل لا يحتاج تسجيل دخول.
الكود المقابل متاح في ملفات Source code لهذا الوسم، تحت GPL-3.0، بلا ضمان.
بصمات APK ومعلومات المصدر والتوقيع مرفقة مع الإصدار.

[سجل البناء والاختبارات](https://github.com/Pomtoto/safi-adblock/actions/runs/38230127634)

[نطاق التحقق في هذا الإصدار](https://github.com/Pomtoto/safi-adblock/blob/8509e11ebc68f67853eaaf236beebd9b1d59998f/tests/UPDATE-1.2.md)

repo.description: YouTube with the ads stripped out of YouTube's own data, before the player learns they exist. Sideloadable for Fire TV and for Android phones, from one shared payload. Android sibling of YouTOBA.

release.name: YourTOBA 0.1.0
release.notes:
First release. Two builds from one codebase, sharing the same ad stripping.

| File | Install on | Interface |
|---|---|---|
| `YourTOBA-tv-0.1.0.apk` | Fire TV, Android TV | Leanback (`youtube.com/tv`), remote control |
| `YourTOBA-Mobile-0.1.0.apk` | Android phones | The ordinary mobile site (`m.youtube.com`), touch |

Different package names, so both can be installed side by side.

**Requires Fire OS, not Vega OS.** The Fire TV Stick 4K Select (Oct 2025) and
Fire TV Stick HD (2026) run Vega and cannot sideload at all. `minSdk` is 21, so
Fire OS 5 through 8 all install.

### What it does

Ads are removed from YouTube's own innertube JSON before the player ever learns
they exist, so there is no ad to skip. Network-level blocking of ad and tracker
hosts sits behind that as a supporting layer.

### If the picture is black but audio plays

That is the WebView decoding video into a layer the compositor never shows.
Press **Menu**, then **Up/Down** to change layer type, and **Select** to run a
bundled video self-test that tells you whether frames are decoding at all.

### Signing

These are signed with a personal sideload key that is not in the repository.
Building from source generates your own, so an APK you build cannot be installed

release.name: v0.8 — translated dialogs, rating prompt, source link
release.notes:
Data Saver — Usage & Blocker, version 0.8 (versionCode 8).

Same build as the Google Play release of this version.

## What changed since 0.7

- **The bulk-restrict and monthly-bundle dialogs are translated.** Their titles, bodies and
  buttons were English string literals in code, so on an Arabic, Urdu or Hindi phone the
  dialog that asks you to approve restricting five apps at once appeared in English. Three
  more buttons used the framework's `cancel`, which resolves from the *system* locale rather
  than the app's chosen one.
- **"Restrict 5 apps?" counts correctly** in languages with more than two plural forms.
- **A Source code row in Settings**, opening this repository.
- **A rating prompt**, once, after a week of blocking actually running. Decline and it waits
  a month. It is the app's own dialog; no Play library is linked.
- **One build, no flavours.** The Play in-app review library was removed, so the only
  dependency is `androidx.core:core-ktx` and the dex contains no `com/google/android/play`.

## Permissions

Six, and no `INTERNET`. Check it yourself:

```
aapt dump permissions DataSaver-v0.8.apk
```

| Permission | Why |
|---|---|
| `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` | tell mobile data from Wi-Fi |
| `FOREGROUND_SERVICE` + `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE` | keep the blocking engine alive |
| `PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS` | read per-app data figures (you grant this by hand) |
| `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` | the engine's own status notification |
| `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED` | restore blocking after a reboot |

Blocking uses `VpnService` in package-list mode — no packet forwarding, no tunnel, nothing
leaves the device. No analytics, no crash reporter, no account.

## Verifying this APK

```
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```

Signed by `CN=Anubis Productions, OU=DataGate, O=Anubis Productions, C=EG`, SHA-256
fingerprint:

# Photos Backup 0.5.0

- Import selected iPhone/camera originals on Mac and connected Android/iPhone media on Windows.
- Select Android device folders and mirror their names as Google Photos albums.
- Fix Android backup-button layout, large text, long filenames and dialog sizing.
- Fix Windows inaccessible folders, repeated device entries and long upload paths.

**Validation:** Disposable Mac/Windows imports matched Google originals byte for byte. Android folder backup and album creation passed the owner’s device check; 20 instrumentation tests and scrcpy layout inspection passed. See `live-validation.md` and CI for package checks.

**Known limit:** iCloud reclaim is experimental. Automated tests pass, but live deletion/recovery is not yet validated ([follow-up #34](https://github.com/ayush5harma/google-photos-backup/issues/34)). Connected-iPhone deletion/recovery is also unvalidated ([follow-up #23](https://github.com/ayush5harma/google-photos-backup/issues/23)); no source deletion was performed in the import tests. iCloud reclaim is off by default, requires explicit confirmation, does not permanently purge media and cannot promise immediate reclaimed space. The currently working unlimited original-quality mode uses an unofficial client; Google may change storage accounting at any time.

Five packages: macOS ARM64/Intel DMGs, Windows ARM64/x64 installers, and a signed Android APK for ARM64/x86_64. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Mac packages are ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned.

## Highlights

- **Negotiated USB link:** the Windows client reports whether the connected
  phone is actually using Low, Full, High, SuperSpeed or SuperSpeedPlus.
- **USB 2 fallback warning:** VeXArk highlights when a USB 3-capable phone has
  negotiated only the 480 Mbit/s High-Speed mode.
- **Real throughput:** a 256 MiB generated stream measures ADB and Fast Wi-Fi
  without opening photos, videos or other personal files.
- **Integrity checked:** every probe is validated with SHA-256.
- **Clear recommendation:** the client recommends ADB or Fast Wi-Fi and
  estimates transfer time for 10, 50 and 100 GiB.
- **No test artifacts:** the benchmark does not create a temporary media file
  on the phone or computer.

The release build was validated on a Xiaomi 15 with a custom ROM. With a USB
2.0 cable, Windows correctly reported High-Speed and VeXArk measured about
39.4 MiB/s through ADB. Encrypted Fast Wi-Fi measured approximately
50–58 MiB/s under the tested network conditions and was recommended
automatically.

Throughput depends on the cable, USB controller, phone, access point and
computer. A cable's charging wattage does not indicate its data speed.

release.notes:
# Droid Vault 2.0.0

The stable release. Debloat and Restore now work as a pair, and a backup can no
longer cancel itself.

## What's fixed

- **Restore can finally see what you removed.** The Restore tab read its list from
  a place that the debloat itself had just emptied, so it showed nothing. It now
  reads from your backup folder.

- **Restore no longer claims success it can't prove.** Android's unarchive
  command prints "Success" and exits 0 whether or not anything was installed.
  Restore now confirms the app is really installed and enabled before it says so.

- **"Keep Data" is on by default.** Turning it off now asks you to confirm first,
  because that one deletes the app's data for good.

- **System apps are no longer silently skipped.** They could be ticked and drawn
  with a checkmark, then left out of the backup anyway.

- **A finished backup no longer cancels the next one.** You could get "Import
  cancelled" after every single byte had copied successfully.

- **Import updates the list immediately**, instead of waiting for you to leave the
  screen and come back.

- **Partition backup and flashing wait their turn** instead of running alongside a
  backup and getting killed partway through by it.

- **A slow engine check no longer reads as "engine out of date".** It says "could
  not be checked" instead.

- **Unknown Wi-Fi security is skipped, not downgraded.** Networks that couldn't be
  identified were previously restored as open networks.

- **Automation's Add-rule sheet explains itself** when you have no labels yet,
  instead of showing an empty field and a dead button.

## Upgrading

Your backup folder is untouched. Install the APK over your existing copy — your
settings and scheduled jobs are kept.

A página do filme passa a ler antes também o início (`MovieDetailsViewModel.readAheadOpening`). Mesmas regras de rede da leitura antecipada (`readAheadAllowed`) e nada com outro vídeo tocando.

Buffer de assistir mantido 10 min depois de o app ficar parado, fechado ou morto (`WatchBufferLifetime`, marca em `watch_buffer`/`idle_since`); depois `WatchBufferCleanupWorker` (WorkManager, único, atraso de 10 min) o esvazia. Voltar à tela ou tocar em segundo plano cancela; na abertura só esvazia se a marca passou de 10 min. Antes esvaziava a cada abertura.

Dados móveis com a qualidade em Média ou Baixa: 30 s/60 s de buffer à frente em vez de 50 s/180 s (`ContentAwareLoadControl.limitAhead`, ligado pelo `PlayerViewModel` com a rede).

Memória: 20 s para trás em vez de 60 com o buffer de assistir ativo (`vodBackBufferMs`, 60 s abaixo de 640 MB livres); teto do buffer em 40% do heap, de 32 a 160 MB (`playerBufferTargetBytes`), respeitado antes dos mínimos de tempo.

**Validação:** `:app:assembleDebug`, `:app:compileReleaseKotlin`, `:app:ktlintCheck`, `:app:verifyRoborazziDebug` e `:app:lintDebug`; testes de unidade (incluindo `BufferPolicyTest`) e capturas sem falha.

**Limitações:** o teste de fumaça no emulador não roda nesta máquina; sem instalação no Galaxy S23 nesta versão, então a leitura do ponto do Continuar, a limpeza após 10 min e o buffer nos dados móveis não foram vistos no aparelho.

repo.description: Android 原生分区工具：Root 分区表、手动备份、警告确认后的直接 dd 写入；无自动备份或写入风险检查。Kotlin / Compose / Material 3，GPL-3.0-only。

release.name: YU-Flash-Tool 1.0.1 · 正式签名构建 14.1
release.notes:
# 1.0.1

> **本次恢复强制自动完整备份与写后读回校验，活动写入仍采用固定 Toybox `dd`。** 用户确认后必须先完整备份目标并通过 `verifyBackup`；写入和同步后，精确字节范围的长度/SHA-256 必须与写前源一致，并再次复核源文件，才能成功。备份或校验不可跳过。**这不是镜像兼容性、设备安全、可启动性、可恢复性或掉电持久性认证。** 本文是发布输入；实际 CI、签名与产物证据由工作流追加在后面，GitHub 发布状态以发行页面为准；文档本身不预先宣称完成。

## 本次变化

### 1. 确认后必须先备份完整分区

- 保留单个危险确认框，展示目标名、路径、源文件实际字节数、警告与免责声明；不要求准确输入目标名。
- 不再是确认后立即 `dd`。每次写入任务自动读取**整个目标分区**，不是只备份将写入的前缀；已有手动备份不能替代本次自动备份。
- 复用现有 `SafetyPolicy.backup` 和备份实现，不新建绕过读取限制的通道。DATA、挂载中/挂载状态未知、映射/映射状态未知、无效或未知容量/身份等不能通过；`Risk.UNKNOWN`/`Risk.CRITICAL` 分类本身不一定拒绝读取。
- 使用设置中明确选择的 **`/sdcard/download` 或 `/sdcard/Download`**；目录不存在或不可写时失败，绝不静默切换大小写或回退另一位置。
- 空间至少为完整分区容量加 **64 MiB**；短镜像也不减少备份需求。空间检查不是容量预留，其他进程仍可耗尽空间。
- 每次建立唯一任务目录，先写 `.img.partial`，同步、检查完整长度与 SHA-256，复核目标身份和文件摘要后提交镜像及元数据。不覆盖已有任务备份；孤立镜像或 `.partial` 不是完整备份成功。
- 写入协调器必须再执行 **`verifyBackup`**，核对文件长度、摘要及提交元数据。策略、身份、读取路径互锁、目录、空间、备份或复核任一失败都不得启动本次 `dd`。

**影响：不满足现有备份政策的目标不能写。** 本版不是“所有分区/整盘均可无条件直接写入”，也没有“跳过备份继续”选项。

### 2. 源摘要与写后精确范围校验

- 文件仍从 `content://` 流复制到私有普通文件，不修改原文档，不按镜像格式解析、解压、展开或转换。
- 自动备份及复核后，重新测量私有源的**实际长度和 SHA-256**，作为写前基准，不只依赖提供器长度或导入时统计；与已确认的导入字节数不符或摘要无效时不启动 `dd`，但不要求源与分区等长。
- 仍使用固定 `/system/bin/toybox dd`，保留基本路径限制与 Shell 引用，不提供任意 Shell。仅 `dd` 返回 0 后独立调用 `/system/bin/toybox sync`。
- 写后由**只读助手**通过已安装 APK 的 `CLASSPATH` 和 `app_process` 流式读回目标 `[0, 写前源长度)`，核对实际长度和 SHA-256。读取不足、I/O 异常、助手失败或结果不符均不能成功。
- 不生成另一份大型临时读回镜像，不依赖 `dd | sha256sum` 等可能掩盖上游读取错误的 Shell 管道。
- 最后再次测量源文件长度/SHA-256，检测相对写前基准的变化；读回比较使用的是**写前源**，不能用已改变的源重定义成功基准。这不是从导入起锁定内容，也不能排除检查之间修改后又恢复的竞态。
- 自动备份、`verifyBackup`、写前源摘要、`dd`、`sync`、精确范围读回与源复核全部成功后，才记录 `SUCCESS`。只有 `dd`/`sync` 返回 0 已不再足够。

```text
明确确认
  → 现有策略准入 → 完整自动备份 → verifyBackup
  → 写前源实际长度 + SHA-256
  → 固定 dd → 独立 sync
  → 只读助手精确范围读回长度/SHA-256，与写前源比较
  → 源长度/SHA-256 再复核 → SUCCESS
```

固定写入与同步命令（两次独立调用）：

```text
/system/bin/toybox dd if=<引用后的私有文件路径> of=<引用后的已发现 /dev/block 路径> bs=1048576
/system/bin/toybox sync
```

### 3. 保留的界面、发现与任务边界

- 修复主页重复“点击获取分区表”提示：只保留一个 **“一键获取分区表”** 按钮，初始诊断为空；读取时仅显示一次 **“正在读取分区表”**，隐藏旧诊断。详细诊断也不会重

Запас и сроки

• «Держать дома минимум». В карточке продукта задаётся, сколько должно быть дома. Когда остаётся меньше, продукт сам попадает в список покупок — откуда бы его ни списали: из карточки, со списка или из уведомления.
• «Напоминать заранее» — своё окно для отдельного продукта: мясо за неделю, крупа за день. Уведомление и карточка считают «скоро» по нему.
• Заморозить и разморозить. Перенос в морозилку предлагает новый срок (курица — 9 месяцев, фарш и рыба — 3, хлеб — 3), из морозилки — день-три. «Оставить как есть» — одно нажатие.
• Разделить партию. Переложить можно часть: половину фарша в морозилку, остальное — на ужин. Цена делится по количеству. Отмена собирает партию обратно.
• Календарь сроков («Ещё → Календарь сроков»): месяц сеткой, на каждом дне — сколько истекает, под сеткой — что именно.

Быстрее

• Ярлыки на иконке: долгое нажатие — «Сканировать», «Добавить», «Домашнее», «Покупки».
• Плитка «Сканировать» в шторке быстрых настроек.
• Список из мессенджера: «Поделиться» текстом → «В список покупок». Каждая строка или пункт через запятую становятся строкой списка, «x2» и «2 шт» — количеством, маркеры и галочки убираются, повторы сливаются.
• Подсказки названий в форме добавления: известные продукты подставляют бренд, категорию, единицы и штрихкод, и упаковка ложится на существующую карточку.
• «Купили снова?» на главном: частые покупки, которых сейчас нет дома, добавляются одним нажатием — сколько, куда и на сколько дней, как в прошлый раз.

Аналитика и данные

• Почему выбросили: при «Выбросить» можно (не обязательно) указать причину — испортилось, забыли, купили много, не понравилось. В аналитике — раздел «Почему выбрасываем».
• История цен в карточке: цена за единицу в последней покупке, средняя и насколько дороже или дешевле прошлого раза.
• Итоги недели: в воскресенье вечером уведомление — сколько съели, сколько выб

# v1.0.0 — Daily Ledger · 日常记账

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

Initial public preview for Windows and Android, published on 2026-10-12.

## Downloads

- `daily-ledger-1.0.0-android-debug.apk`: installable, debug-signed Android development build. Requires Android 7.0 / API 24 or newer, arm64-v8a or x86_64, and Android System WebView.
- `daily-ledger-1.0.0-windows-source.zip`: Windows source package. Requires Python with Tkinter, SQLite 3.37+, and CustomTkinter 6.0.0. Verified with Python 3.14.4. Extract it, install `requirements.txt`, and run `python app.py` or double-click `启动记账.cmd`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums for the APK and Windows ZIP.

Both source projects are included in the repository. All published guides and release descriptions present English first and Chinese second. The current app interfaces use Chinese.

## Included features

Expense CRUD and filters; exact RMB amounts up to six decimal places; annual calendar and daily/monthly/yearly totals; category statistics; monthly budgets; product prices and quantity calculations; filtered CSV export; complete SQLite backup and restore.

Each version stores data locally. Move data between versions by exporting a SQLite backup and restoring it on the other device. Restore replaces the complete ledger, budgets, and products. There is no automatic synchronization.

## Current limits

- Android is a debug build; Android 16/17 device acceptance is pending. Static APK checks and Python/browser tests do not establish device compatibility.
- Windows is distributed as source and requires Python. A standalone Windows EXE is not included.
- Restore requires the current ledger to be readable. It cannot repair a current database that is already too damaged to open.
- Android draft state covers page refresh, without guaranteeing recovery after process termination. Export an accessible backup before uninstalling or changing phones.

Personal databases, import records, backups, logs, local toolchains, and signing keys are exclude

## What changed

Every string you read in the app was rewritten. Not the words — the shape of the sentences.
Release notes used to be one long line with six fixes strung together by semicolons. The
licence page used a colon and a list, and ended with a sentence that said what the app does
*not* do in the most complicated way available. A few lines explained how honest the app was
being instead of simply stating the fact.

Chinese had its own version of the same problem: 分号串, 四字并列, 书面语 connectors. Those are

Nothing else. No behaviour, no feature, no fix, no setting, no data. The diff against
`0.1.0` touches two files — `values/strings.xml` and `values-zh/strings.xml` — and contains
no line that is not a string value. The only line of app code added is this release's own
history entry, which every release needs so that the version window can say what it changed.

The other seven languages still have the older phrasing, so their text is one voice behind.
Keys and format specifiers are unchanged everywhere, which is what the build checks.

release.name: v1.5.7
release.notes:
## What's new in 1.5.7

**Fixed: Attendance % could read too high, most visible when WFH days made up a big share of the month.** The app infers extra "leave taken" days when your reported leave balance drops by more than what you've explicitly marked as Leave on the Calendar — useful when leave gets taken and the balance updated without a matching tap on a day. But it wasn't checking whether there was actually a genuinely-unmarked day to explain that drop: if every weekday that month was already accounted for (Present, WFH, or an explicit Leave mark), it would still shave the inferred amount off Eligible working days without touching Attended — quietly inflating the percentage, and in some cases making Eligible read lower than Attended plus WFH, which never makes sense. It now only ever borrows from days that are genuinely still unmarked, and never more of them than actually exist. Every past month recalculates automatically — nothing to redo.

---
*Personal attendance tracker built for ANZ employees. Nothing leaves your device — no login, no backend, no analytics.*

release.name: KERNEL PANIC 3.2.0 — Mobile, Accessibility and Quality of Life
release.notes:
**Mobile gets its own interface.** 3.1 was built PC-first, and it showed: the phone ran a shrunken desktop menu, with options that did nothing and controls too small to hit. This release is the repair — plus the accessibility pass that measurement turned into something bigger than planned.

## The phone stops borrowing the PC's interface

- **Every option declares which platform it serves.** Aim mode, haptics and touch size no longer sit in a PC menu doing nothing — `effective_aim_mode()` is only ever read by the touch controls, so those rows were decoration on a desktop. Keybinds no longer take a whole section on a phone. CONTROLS became the controls section *of each platform*.
- **Left-handed touch.** `BUTTON SIDE` mirrors the entire layout: the move zone, the action buttons, the safe-area cutout they have to avoid, the patch dock that gets out of their way, and the onboarding labels that used to insist the left thumb moved when it no longer did.
- **`BUTTON OPACITY`** fades the on-screen controls without shrinking what responds to your thumb.
- **Settings became a list you can read.** Two columns — label left, value right — with a rule under each row, instead of a stack of loose sentences.
- **The touch controls are drawn, not pixels.** Dash, boost and pause were the last raster icons in the game, stuck there because the icon library never learned to draw overclock or pause. They scale with the button size now.

## Accessibility

- **`FLASH`: OFF / LOW / FULL.** Nothing controlled light before. The full-screen white, the palette inversion mid-dodge, the damage distortion and the CRT flicker all answer to one setting. What *informs* you — the damage pulse, the low-integrity vignette — is never dimmed: trading information for comfort is not a fix.
- **Colour assist that assists.** The old one made things *worse*. Measured against simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia, its two palette swaps degraded **29** pair-and-deficiency combinations: with assist on

release.name: VRAeroScan 0.1.1
release.notes:
**New**
- **Identify:** turn on a circle crosshair in the glasses and get a card describing the aircraft or satellite centred in it. Toggle it from the phone panel's **◎ Identify** button, from the glasses menu, or with the I key.
- **Reorganised controls:** the phone panel and the glasses menu now share one structure. Identify sits at the top, then **North** (set it), **Show** (what's drawn, label size) and **View** (where from). The tap/drag pad is on every tab.
- **Label sizes** (Small / Medium / Large), and your choices are kept between launches.
- **One app icon:** it starts on the glasses, or on the phone when no glasses are plugged in.

**Fixes**
- Location is now requested on the phone's screen. Before, the prompt appeared on the glasses, where it couldn't be answered, and the sky was silently drawn for a default position. The panel now says `NO GPS FIX` when there's no fix.
- Aircraft markers lagged behind the real aircraft, because the feed's position age was ignored.
- adsb.lol rate limiting: the app now honours Retry-After and slows down instead of being blocked repeatedly.
- The glasses menu now fits the glasses' field of view, and labels no longer cover it.

**Install:** download `VRAeroScan-0.1.1.apk` to the phone and open it, or `adb install -r VRAeroScan-0.1.1.apk`. It installs over 0.1.0. Then plug in the glasses (3D mode) and open **VRAeroScan**. See the [user's manual](https://github.com/parheliatech/VRAeroScan#readme).

**Notes:** experimental; arm64 Android only; debug-signed. Tested on a OnePlus 7 Pro (Android 16) with Viture Pro XR. The APK bundles Viture's freely available glasses libraries. Licensed MIT, apart from the Viture libraries.
